courses.title: Lessons 1–2: Excuse Me
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 8 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 这是谁的手提包？
statements.english: Whose handbag is it?

statements.chinese: 怎么了？
statements.english: Yes?

statements.chinese: 这是你的手提包吗？
statements.english: Is this your handbag?

statements.chinese: 抱歉？
statements.english: Pardon?

statements.chinese: 这是你的手提包吗？
statements.english: Is this your handbag?

statements.chinese: 是的，是我的。
statements.english: Yes it is.

statements.chinese: 非常感谢。
statements.english: Thank you very much.

courses.title: Lessons 3–4: Sorry, Sir
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 13 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 这位男士找回他的伞了吗？
statements.english: Does the man get his umbrella back?

statements.chinese: 请把我的大衣和雨伞给我。
statements.english: My coat and my umbrella please.

statements.chinese: 这是我的票。
statements.english: Here is my ticket.

statements.chinese: 谢谢您，先生。
statements.english: Thank you sir.

statements.chinese: 五号。
statements.english: Number five.

statements.chinese: 这是您的伞和大衣。
statements.english: Here's your umbrella and your coat.

statements.chinese: 这不是我的伞。
statements.english: This is not my umbrella.

statements.chinese: 这是您的伞吗？
statements.english: Is this your umbrella?

statements.chinese: 不，它不是。
statements.english: No it isn't.

statements.chinese: 是这把吗？
statements.english: Is this it?

statements.chinese: 是的，就是它。
statements.english: Yes it is.

statements.chinese: 非常感谢。
statements.english: Thank you very much.

courses.title: Lessons 5–6: Nice to Meet You
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 19 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 早上好，布莱克先生。
statements.english: Good morning, Mr. Blake.

statements.chinese: 这是爱丽丝·杜邦小姐。
statements.english: This is Miss Alice Dupont.

statements.chinese: 爱丽丝是一名新学生。
statements.english: Alice is a new student.

statements.chinese: 她是法国人。
statements.english: She is French.

statements.chinese: 爱丽丝，这是汉斯。
statements.english: Alice, this is Hans.

statements.chinese: 他是德国人。
statements.english: He is German.

statements.chinese: 你好！
statements.english: How do you do?

statements.chinese: 这是布里特。
statements.english: And this is Britt.

statements.chinese: 她是瑞典人。
statements.english: She is Swedish.

statements.chinese: 你好！
statements.english: How do you do?

statements.chinese: 这是迪米特里。
statements.english: And this is Dimitri.

statements.chinese: 他是希腊人。
statements.english: He is Greek.

statements.chinese: 你好！
statements.english: How do you do?

statements.chinese: 这是保罗。
statements.english: And this is Paul.

statements.chinese: 他是巴西人。
statements.english: He's Brazilian.

statements.chinese: 你好！
statements.english: How do you do?

statements.chinese: 这是斯特拉。
statements.english: And this is Stella.

statements.chinese: 她是西班牙人。
statements.english: She's Spanish.

statements.chinese: 你好！
statements.english: How do you do?

courses.title: Lessons 7–8: Are You a Teacher
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 17 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 罗伯特的工作是什么？
statements.english: What is Rober's job?

statements.chinese: 我是新学生。
statements.english: I am a new student.

statements.chinese: 我名叫罗伯特。
statements.english: My name's Robert.

statements.chinese: 很高兴见到你。
statements.english: Nice to meet you.

statements.chinese: 我名叫索菲。
statements.english: My name's Sophie.

statements.chinese: 你是法国人吗？
statements.english: Are you French?

statements.chinese: 是，我是。
statements.english: Yes I am.

statements.chinese: 你也是法国人吗？
statements.english: Are you French too?

statements.chinese: 不，我不是。
statements.english: No I am not.

statements.chinese: 你是哪国人？
statements.english: What nationality are you?

statements.chinese: 我是意大利人。
statements.english: I'm Italian.

statements.chinese: 不，我不是。
statements.english: No I'm not.

statements.chinese: 你是做什么工作的？
statements.english: What's your job?

statements.chinese: 我是打字员。
statements.english: I'm a keyboard operator.

statements.chinese: 你是做什么工作的？
statements.english: What's your job?

statements.chinese: 我是工程师。
statements.english: I'm an engineer.

courses.title: Lessons 9–10: How Are You Today
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 15 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 艾玛好吗？
statements.english: How is Emma?

statements.chinese: 你好，海伦。
statements.english: Hello Helen.

statements.chinese: 嗨，史蒂文。
statements.english: Hi Steven.

statements.chinese: 我很好，谢谢。
statements.english: I'm very well thank you.

statements.chinese: 你呢？
statements.english: And you?

statements.chinese: 我很好，谢谢。
statements.english: I'm fine thanks.

statements.chinese: 托尼好吗？
statements.english: How is Tony?

statements.chinese: 他很好，谢谢。
statements.english: He's fine thanks.

statements.chinese: 艾玛好吗？
statements.english: How's Emma?

statements.chinese: 她也很好，海伦。
statements.english: She's very well too Helen.

statements.chinese: 再见，海伦。
statements.english: Goodbye Helen.

statements.chinese: 很高兴见到你。
statements.english: Nice to see you.

statements.chinese: 史蒂文，我也很高兴见到你。
statements.english: Nice to see you too Steven.

statements.chinese: 再见。
statements.english: Goodbye.

courses.title: Lessons 11–12: Is This Your Shirt
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 17 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 谁的衬衫是白色的？
statements.english: Whose shirt is white?

statements.chinese: 那是谁的衬衫？
statements.english: Whose shirt is that?

statements.chinese: 戴夫，这是你的衬衫吗？
statements.english: Is this your shirt Dave?

statements.chinese: 不，先生。
statements.english: No. Sir.

statements.chinese: 它不是我的衬衫。
statements.english: It's not my shirt.

statements.chinese: 这是我的衬衫。
statements.english: This is my shirt.

statements.chinese: 我的衬衫是蓝色的。
statements.english: My shirt's blue.

statements.chinese: 这件衬衫是蒂姆的吗？
statements.english: Is this shirt Tim's?

statements.chinese: 也许是，先生。
statements.english: Perhaps it is sir.

statements.chinese: 蒂姆的衬衫是白色的。
statements.english: Tim's shirt's white.

statements.chinese: 蒂姆！
statements.english: Tim!

statements.chinese: 是，先生？
statements.english: Yes sir?

statements.chinese: 是的，先生。
statements.english: Yes sir.

statements.chinese: 给你。
statements.english: Here you are.

statements.chinese: 接住！
statements.english: Catch!

statements.chinese: 谢谢您，先生。
statements.english: Thank you sir.

courses.title: Lessons 13–14: A New Dress
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 15 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 安娜的帽子是什么颜色的？
statements.english: What colour is Anna's hat?

statements.chinese: 你的新连衣裙是什么颜色的？
statements.english: What colour's your new dress?

statements.chinese: 是绿色的。
statements.english: It's green.

statements.chinese: 到楼上来看看吧。
statements.english: Come upstairs and see it.

statements.chinese: 谢谢。
statements.english: Thank you.

statements.chinese: 看！
statements.english: Look!

statements.chinese: 在这儿呢！
statements.english: Here it is!

statements.chinese: 这件连衣裙真漂亮。
statements.english: That's a nice dress.

statements.chinese: 它很时髦。
statements.english: It's very smart.

statements.chinese: 我的帽子也是新的。
statements.english: My hat's new too.

statements.chinese: 它是什么颜色的？
statements.english: What colour is it?

statements.chinese: 是同样的颜色。
statements.english: It's the same colour.

statements.chinese: 也是绿色的。
statements.english: It's green too.

statements.chinese: 那真是一顶可爱的帽子！
statements.english: That is a lovely hat!

courses.title: Lessons 15–16: Your Passports, Please
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 19 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 海关官员有什么问题吗？
statements.english: Is there a problem with the Customs officer?

statements.chinese: 你们是瑞典人吗？
statements.english: Are you Swedish?

statements.chinese: 不，我们不是。
statements.english: No we are not.

statements.chinese: 我们是丹麦人。
statements.english: We are Danish.

statements.chinese: 你们的朋友也是丹麦人吗？
statements.english: Are your friends Danish too?

statements.chinese: 不，他们不是。
statements.english: No they aren't.

statements.chinese: 他们是挪威人。
statements.english: They are Norwegian.

statements.chinese: 都在这儿呢。
statements.english: Here they are.

statements.chinese: 这些是你们的箱子吗？
statements.english: Are these your cases?

statements.chinese: 不，它们不是。
statements.english: No they aren't.

statements.chinese: 我们的箱子是棕色的。
statements.english: Our cases are brown.

statements.chinese: 都在这儿呢。
statements.english: Here they are.

statements.chinese: 你们是游客吗？
statements.english: Are you tourists?

statements.chinese: 是的，我们是。
statements.english: Yes we are.

statements.chinese: 你们的朋友也是游客吗？
statements.english: Are your friends tourists too?

statements.chinese: 是的，他们是。
statements.english: Yes they are.

statements.chinese: 很好。
statements.english: That's fine.

statements.chinese: 非常感谢。
statements.english: Thank you very much.

courses.title: Lessons 17–18: How do you do
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 16 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 迈克尔·贝克和杰里米·肖特的职业是什么？
statements.english: What are Michael Baker and Jeremy Short's jobs?

statements.chinese: 理查兹先生，来见见我们的员工。
statements.english: Come and meet our employees Mr.Richards.

statements.chinese: 谢谢你，杰克逊先生。
statements.english: Thank you Mr. Jackson.
This is Nicola Grey and this is Claire Taylor.
statements.chinese: 这是尼古拉·格雷这是克莱尔·泰勒。
那些女士们非常勤奋。
statements.english: Those women are very hard-working.

statements.chinese: 她们的职业是什么？
statements.english: What are their jobs?

statements.chinese: 她们是键盘操作员。
statements.english: They're keyboard operators.
This is Michael Baker and this is Jeremy Short.
statements.chinese: 这是迈克尔·贝克这是杰里米·肖特。
他们不太忙！
statements.english: They aren't very busy!

statements.chinese: 他们的职业是什么？
statements.english: What are their jobs?

statements.chinese: 他们是销售代表。
statements.english: They're sales reps.

statements.chinese: 他们很懒惰。
statements.english: They're very lazy.

statements.chinese: 这个年轻人是谁？
statements.english: Who is this young man?

statements.chinese: 这是吉姆。
statements.english: This is Jim.

statements.chinese: 他是我们的办公室助理。
statements.english: He's our office assistant.

courses.title: Lessons 19–20: Tired and Thirsty
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 16 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 孩子们为什么感谢他们的妈妈？
statements.english: Why do the children thank their mother?

statements.chinese: 孩子们，怎么了？
statements.english: What's the matter children?

statements.chinese: 我们累了……
statements.english: We're tired ...

statements.chinese: ……而且渴了，妈妈。
statements.english: ... and thirsty Mum.

statements.chinese: 坐到这儿来。
statements.english: Sit down here.

statements.chinese: 你们现在好了吗？
statements.english: Are you all right now?

statements.chinese: 不，我们没有。
statements.english: No we aren't.

statements.chinese: 看！
statements.english: Look!

statements.chinese: 有个卖冰淇淋的。
statements.english: There's an ice cream man.

statements.chinese: 请来两个冰淇淋。
statements.english: Two ice cream please.

statements.chinese: 孩子们，给你们。
statements.english: Here you are children.

statements.chinese: 谢谢妈妈。
statements.english: Thanks Mum.

statements.chinese: 这些冰淇淋真好吃。
statements.english: These ice creams are nice.

statements.chinese: 你们现在好了吗？
statements.english: Are you all right now?

statements.chinese: 是的，我们好了，谢谢！
statements.english: Yes we are thank you!

courses.title: Lessons 21–22: Which Book
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 9 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 这位男士想要哪本书？
statements.english: Which book does the man want?

statements.chinese: 给我一本书，简。
statements.english: Give me a book please, Jane.

statements.chinese: 这本吗？
statements.english: This one?

statements.chinese: 不，不是那本。是红色的那本。
statements.english: No, not that one. The red one.

statements.chinese: 这本吗？
statements.english: This one?

statements.chinese: 是的，谢谢。
statements.english: Yes, please.

statements.chinese: 给你。
statements.english: Here you are.

statements.chinese: 谢谢你。
statements.english: Thank you.

courses.title: Lessons 23–24: Which Glasses
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 10 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 那个男人想要哪几副眼镜？
statements.english: Which glasses does the man want?

statements.chinese: 简，请给我几副眼镜。
statements.english: Give me some glasses please, Jane.

statements.chinese: 是这几副眼镜吗？
statements.english: These glasses?

statements.chinese: 不，不是那些。
statements.english: No, not those.

statements.chinese: 货架上的那些。
statements.english: The ones on the shelf.

statements.chinese: 是这些吗？
statements.english: These?

statements.chinese: 是的，请。
statements.english: Yes, please.

statements.chinese: 给你。
statements.english: Here you are.

statements.chinese: 谢谢。
statements.english: Thanks.

courses.title: Lessons 25–26: Mrs. Smith's Kitchen
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 14 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 电炉是什么颜色的？
statements.english: What colour is the electric cooker?

statements.chinese: 史密斯太太的厨房很小。
statements.english: Mrs. Smith's kitchen is small.

statements.chinese: 厨房里有台冰箱。
statements.english: There is a refrigerator in the kitchen.

statements.chinese: 冰箱是白色的。
statements.english: The refrigerator is white.

statements.chinese: 它在右边。
statements.english: It is on the right.

statements.chinese: 厨房里有个电炉。
statements.english: There is an electric cooker in the kitchen.

statements.chinese: 电炉是蓝色的。
statements.english: The cooker is blue.

statements.chinese: 它在左边。
statements.english: It is on the left.

statements.chinese: 房间的中间有张桌子。
statements.english: There is a table in the middle of the room.

statements.chinese: 桌子上有个瓶子。
statements.english: There is a bottle on the table.

statements.chinese: 瓶子是空的。
statements.english: The bottle is empty.

statements.chinese: 桌子上也有个杯子。
statements.english: There is a cup on the table, too.

statements.chinese: 杯子是干净的。
statements.english: The cup is clean.

courses.title: Lessons 27–28: Mrs. Smith's Living Room
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 15 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 书在哪里？
statements.english: Where are the books?

statements.chinese: 史密斯夫人的客厅很大。
statements.english: Mrs. Smith's living room is large.

statements.chinese: 房间里有一台电视机。
statements.english: There is a television in the room.

statements.chinese: 电视机在窗户旁边。
statements.english: The television is near the window.

statements.chinese: 电视机上有一些杂志。
statements.english: There are some magazines on the television.

statements.chinese: 房间里有一张桌子。
statements.english: There is a table in the room.

statements.chinese: 桌子上有一些报纸。
statements.english: There are some newspapers on the table.

statements.chinese: 房间里有一些扶手椅。
statements.english: There are some armchairs in the room.

statements.chinese: 扶手椅在桌子旁边。
statements.english: The armchairs are near the table.

statements.chinese: 房间里有一台立体声音响。
statements.english: There is a stereo in the room.

statements.chinese: 立体声音响在门旁边。
statements.english: The stereo is near the door.

statements.chinese: 立体声音响上有一些书。
statements.english: There are some books on the stereo.

statements.chinese: 房间里有一些画。
statements.english: There are some pictures in the room.

statements.chinese: 这些画在墙上。
statements.english: The pictures are on the wall.

courses.title: Lessons 29–30: Come In, Amy
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 10 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 艾米必须怎样打扫地板？
statements.english: How must Amy clean the floor?

statements.chinese: 请把门关上。
statements.english: Shut the door, please.

statements.chinese: 这间卧室真不整洁。
statements.english: This bedroom's very untidy.

statements.chinese: 琼斯夫人，我必须做什么？
statements.english: What must I do, Mrs. Jones?

statements.chinese: 把窗户打开，让房间通通风。
statements.english: Open the window and air the room.

statements.chinese: 然后把这些衣服放进衣柜里。
statements.english: Then put these clothes in the wardrobe.

statements.chinese: 然后铺床。
statements.english: Then make the bed.

statements.chinese: 擦拭梳妆台。
statements.english: Dust the dressing table.

statements.chinese: 然后扫地。
statements.english: Then sweep the floor.

courses.title: Lessons 31–32: Where's Sally
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 16 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 猫在爬树吗？
statements.english: Is the cat climbing the tree?

statements.chinese: 杰克，萨莉在哪儿？
statements.english: Where's Sally, Jack?

statements.chinese: 她在花园里，琼。
statements.english: She's in the garden, Jean.

statements.chinese: 她在做什么？
statements.english: What's she doing?

statements.chinese: 她坐在树下。
statements.english: She's sitting under the tree.

statements.chinese: 蒂姆也在花园里吗？
statements.english: Is Tim in the garden, too?

statements.chinese: 是的，他在。
statements.english: Yes, he is.

statements.chinese: 他在爬树。
statements.english: He's climbing the tree.

statements.chinese: 请再说一遍？
statements.english: I beg your pardon?

statements.chinese: 谁在爬树？
statements.english: Who's climbing the tree?

statements.chinese: 蒂姆在爬。
statements.english: Tim is.

statements.chinese: 那狗呢？
statements.english: What about the dog?

statements.chinese: 狗也在花园里。
statements.english: The dog's in the garden, too.

statements.chinese: 它正在草地上跑。
statements.english: It's running across the grass.

statements.chinese: 它在追一只猫。
statements.english: It's running after a cat.

courses.title: Lessons 33–34: A Fine Day
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 12 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 琼斯一家在哪里？
statements.english: Where is the Jones family?

statements.chinese: 今天天气很好。
statements.english: It is a fine day today.
There are some clouds in the sky, but the sun is shining.
statements.chinese: 天空中有些云，但是阳光普照。
琼斯先生和家人在一起。
statements.english: Mr. Jones is with his family.

statements.chinese: 他们正走过桥。
statements.english: They are walking over the bridge.

statements.chinese: 河上有一些船。
statements.english: There are some boats on the river.

statements.chinese: 琼斯先生和他的妻子正在看它们。
statements.english: Mr. Jones and his wife are looking at them.

statements.chinese: 萨莉正在看一艘大船。
statements.english: Sally is looking at a big ship.

statements.chinese: 船正在从桥下穿过。
statements.english: The ship is going under the bridge.

statements.chinese: 蒂姆正在看一架飞机。
statements.english: Tim is looking at an aeroplane.

statements.chinese: 飞机正在河上空飞过。
statements.english: The aeroplane is flying over the river.

courses.title: Lessons 35–36: Our Village
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 17 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 孩子们是走出公园还是走进公园？
statements.english: Are the children coming out of the park or going into it?

statements.chinese: 这是我们村庄的一张照片。
statements.english: This is a photograph of our village.

statements.chinese: 我们的村庄坐落在山谷里。
statements.english: Our village is in a valley.

statements.chinese: 它在两座山之间。
statements.english: It is between two hills.

statements.chinese: 村庄在一条河边。
statements.english: The village is on a river.

statements.chinese: 这是村庄的另一张照片。
statements.english: Here is another photograph of the village.

statements.chinese: 我妻子和我在河岸边散步。
statements.english: My wife and I are walking along the banks of the river.

statements.chinese: 我们在左边。
statements.english: We are on the left.

statements.chinese: 水里有个男孩。
statements.english: There is a boy in the water.

statements.chinese: 他正在横渡河流。
statements.english: He is swimming across the river.

statements.chinese: 这是另一张照片。
statements.english: Here is another photograph.

statements.chinese: 这是学校教学楼。
statements.english: This is the school building.

statements.chinese: 它在公园旁边。
statements.english: It is beside a park.

statements.chinese: 公园在右边。
statements.english: The park is on the right.

statements.chinese: 一些孩子正从教学楼里出来。
statements.english: Some children are coming out of the building.

statements.chinese: 他们中的一些人正走进公园。
statements.english: Some of them are going into the park.

courses.title: Lessons 37–38: Making a Bookcase
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 20 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 苏珊最喜欢的颜色是什么？
statements.english: What is Susan's favourite colour?

statements.chinese: 你工作得很努力啊，乔治。
statements.english: You're working hard, George.

statements.chinese: 你在做什么？
statements.english: What are you doing?

statements.chinese: 我正在做一个书架。
statements.english: I'm making a bookcase.

statements.chinese: 丹，请把那个锤子给我。
statements.english: Give me that hammer please, Dan.

statements.chinese: 哪个锤子？
statements.english: Which hammer?

statements.chinese: 这个吗？
statements.english: This one?

statements.chinese: 不，不是那个。
statements.english: No, not that one.

statements.chinese: 那个大的。
statements.english: The big one.

statements.chinese: 给你。
statements.english: Here you are.

statements.chinese: 谢谢，丹。
statements.english: Thanks, Dan.

statements.chinese: 乔治，你现在要做什么？
statements.english: What are you going to do now, George?

statements.chinese: 我要把它漆一下。
statements.english: I'm going to paint it.

statements.chinese: 你打算把它漆成什么颜色？
statements.english: What colour are you going to paint it?

statements.chinese: 我要把它漆成粉红色。
statements.english: I'm going to paint it pink.

statements.chinese: 粉红色！
statements.english: Pink!

statements.chinese: 这个书架不是给我的。
statements.english: This bookcase isn't for me.

statements.chinese: 是给我女儿苏珊的。
statements.english: It's for my daughter, Susan.

statements.chinese: 粉红色是她最喜欢的颜色。
statements.english: Pink's her favourite colour.

courses.title: Lessons 39–40: Don't Drop It
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 14 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 萨姆最后把花瓶放在了哪里？
statements.english: Where does Sam put the vase in the end?

statements.chinese: 你打算怎样处置那个花瓶，彭妮？
statements.english: What are you going to do with that vase, Penny?

statements.chinese: 萨姆，我准备把它放在这张桌子上。
statements.english: I'm going to put it on this table, Sam.

statements.chinese: 不要那样做。
statements.english: Don't do that.

statements.chinese: 把它给我。
statements.english: Give it to me.

statements.chinese: 你打算怎么处置它？
statements.english: What are you going to do with it?

statements.chinese: 我准备把它放在这儿，窗户前面。
statements.english: I'm going to put it here, in front of the window.

statements.chinese: 小心！别把它摔了！
statements.english: Be careful! Don't drop it!

statements.chinese: 萨姆，别把它放在那儿。
statements.english: Don't put it there, Sam.

statements.chinese: 把它放在这儿，这个架子上。
statements.english: Put it here, on this shelf.

statements.chinese: 好了！
statements.english: There we are!

statements.chinese: 这是一个漂亮的花瓶。
statements.english: It's a lovely vase.

statements.chinese: 那些花也很漂亮。
statements.english: Those flowers are lovely, too.

courses.title: Lessons 41–42: Penny's Bag
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 18 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 这听烟丝是给谁的？
statements.english: Who is the tin of tobacco for?

statements.chinese: 彭妮，那个包重吗？
statements.english: Is that bag heavy, Penny?

statements.chinese: 不太重。
statements.english: Not very.

statements.chinese: 好了！
statements.english: Here!

statements.chinese: 把它放在这把椅子上吧。
statements.english: Put it on this chair.

statements.chinese: 里面是什么？
statements.english: What's in it?

statements.chinese: 一块奶酪，
statements.english: A piece of cheese.

statements.chinese: 一条面包，
statements.english: A loaf of bread.

statements.chinese: 一块肥皂，
statements.english: A bar of soap.

statements.chinese: 一块巧克力，
statements.english: A bar of chocolate.

statements.chinese: 一瓶牛奶，
statements.english: A bottle of milk.

statements.chinese: 一磅糖，
statements.english: A pound of sugar.

statements.chinese: 半磅咖啡，
statements.english: Half a pound of coffee.

statements.chinese: 四分之一磅茶叶，
statements.english: A quarter of a pound of tea.

statements.chinese: 和一听烟丝。
statements.english: And a tin of tobacco.

statements.chinese: 那听烟丝是给我的吗？
statements.english: Is that tin of tobacco for me?

statements.chinese: 嗯，那当然不是给我的！
statements.english: Well, it's certainly not for me!

courses.title: Lessons 43–44: Hurry Up
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 19 条逐句练习

statements.english: English Listen to the tape then answer this question.
statements.chinese: 英语听录音，然后回答问题。
你怎么知道山姆不经常泡茶？
statements.english: How do you know Sam doesn't make the tea very often?

statements.chinese: 山姆，你会泡茶吗？
statements.english: Can you make the tea, Sam?

statements.chinese: 是的，我当然会，潘妮。
statements.english: Yes, of course I can, Penny.

statements.chinese: 这个水壶里有水吗？
statements.english: Is there any water in this kettle?

statements.chinese: 是的，有水。
statements.english: Yes, there is.

statements.chinese: 茶在哪里？
statements.english: Where's the tea?

statements.chinese: 它在那边，茶壶后面。
statements.english: It's over there, behind the teapot.

statements.chinese: 你能看到吗？
statements.english: Can you see it?

statements.chinese: 我能看到茶壶，但我看不到茶。
statements.english: I can see the teapot, but I can't see the tea.

statements.chinese: 它在那儿！
statements.english: There it is!

statements.chinese: 就在你面前！
statements.english: It's in front of you!

statements.chinese: 啊，是的，我现在看到了。
statements.english: Ah yes, I can see it now.

statements.chinese: 杯子在哪里？
statements.english: Where are the cups?

statements.chinese: 橱柜里有一些。
statements.english: There are some in the cupboard.

statements.chinese: 你能找到它们吗？
statements.english: Can you find them?

statements.chinese: 是的。它们在这里。
statements.english: Yes. Here they are.

statements.chinese: 快点，山姆！
statements.english: Hurry up, Sam!

statements.chinese: 水壶开了！
statements.english: The kettle's boiling!

courses.title: Lessons 45–46: The Boss's Letter
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 20 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 为什么帕梅拉不能打这封信？
statements.english: Why can't Pamela type the letter?

statements.chinese: 鲍勃，请你过来一下好吗？
statements.english: Can you come here a minute please, Bob?

statements.chinese: 好的，先生。
statements.english: Yes, sir?

statements.chinese: 帕梅拉在哪儿？
statements.english: Where's Pamela?

statements.chinese: 她在隔壁。
statements.english: She's next door.

statements.chinese: 她在她的办公室，先生。
statements.english: She's in her office, sir.

statements.chinese: 她能替我打这封信吗？
statements.english: Can she type this letter for me?

statements.chinese: 请你去问问她。
statements.english: Ask her please.

statements.chinese: 好的，先生。
statements.english: Yes, sir.

statements.chinese: 帕梅拉，请你替老板打这封信好吗？
statements.english: Can you type this letter for the boss please, Pamela?

statements.chinese: 好的，我当然能。
statements.english: Yes, of course I can.

statements.chinese: 给你。
statements.english: Here you are.

statements.chinese: 谢谢你，鲍勃。
statements.english: Thank you, Bob.

statements.chinese: 鲍勃！
statements.english: Bob!

statements.chinese: 什么事？
statements.english: Yes?

statements.chinese: 怎么回事？
statements.english: What's the matter?

statements.chinese: 我打不了这封信。
statements.english: I can't type this letter.

statements.chinese: 我看不懂！
statements.english: I can't read it!

statements.chinese: 老板的笔迹太糟糕了！
statements.english: The boss's handwriting is terrible!

courses.title: Lessons 47–48: A Cup of Coffee
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 16 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 安喜欢她的咖啡里放什么？
statements.english: How does Ann like her coffee?

statements.chinese: 安，你喜欢喝咖啡吗？
statements.english: Do you like coffee, Ann?

statements.chinese: 是的，我喜欢。
statements.english: Yes, I do.

statements.chinese: 你想来一杯吗？
statements.english: Do you want a cup?

statements.chinese: 好的，谢谢，克里斯廷。
statements.english: Yes, please, Christine.

statements.chinese: 你想放糖吗？
statements.english: Do you want any sugar?

statements.chinese: 好的，谢谢。
statements.english: Yes, please.

statements.chinese: 你想放牛奶吗？
statements.english: Do you want any milk?

statements.chinese: 不，谢谢。
statements.english: No, thank you.

statements.chinese: 我不喜欢咖啡里放牛奶。
statements.english: I don't like milk in my coffee.

statements.chinese: 我喜欢黑咖啡。
statements.english: I like black coffee.

statements.chinese: 你喜欢饼干吗？
statements.english: Do you like biscuits?

statements.chinese: 是的，我喜欢。
statements.english: Yes, I do.

statements.chinese: 你想来一块吗？
statements.english: Do you want one?

statements.chinese: 好的，谢谢。
statements.english: Yes, please.

courses.title: Lessons 49–50: At the Butcher's
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 17 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 伯德先生喜欢什么？
statements.english: What does Mr. Bird like?

statements.chinese: 伯德夫人，您今天想买些肉吗？
statements.english: Do you want any meat today, Mrs. Bird?

statements.chinese: 是的，请给我。
statements.english: Yes, please.

statements.chinese: 您想要牛肉还是羊肉？
statements.english: Do you want beef or lamb?

statements.chinese: 请给我牛肉。
statements.english: Beef, please.

statements.chinese: 这羊肉很好。
statements.english: This lamb's very good.

statements.chinese: 我喜欢羊肉，但我丈夫不喜欢。
statements.english: I like lamb, but my husband doesn't.

statements.chinese: 来点牛排怎么样？
statements.english: What about some steak?

statements.chinese: 这块很好。
statements.english: This is a nice piece.

statements.chinese: 请把那块给我。
statements.english: Give me that piece, please.

statements.chinese: 还有一磅肉末。
statements.english: And a pound of mince, too.

statements.chinese: 伯德夫人，您要只鸡吗？
statements.english: Do you want a chicken, Mrs. Bird?

statements.chinese: 这些鸡很好。
statements.english: They're very nice.

statements.chinese: 不，谢谢。
statements.english: No, thank you.
My husband likes steak, but he doesn't like chicken.
statements.chinese: 我丈夫喜欢牛排，但他不喜欢鸡肉。

statements.english: To tell you the truth, Mrs. Bird, I don't like chicken either!
statements.chinese: 说实话，伯德夫人，我也不喜欢鸡肉！

courses.title: Lessons 51–52: A Pleasant Climate
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 18 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 希腊下雪吗？
statements.english: Does it ever snow in Greece?

statements.chinese: 你来自哪里？
statements.english: Where do you come from?

statements.chinese: 我来自希腊。
statements.english: I come from Greece.

statements.chinese: 你们国家的气候怎么样？
statements.english: What's the climate like in your country?

statements.chinese: 非常宜人。
statements.english: It's very pleasant.

statements.chinese: 春天的天气怎么样？
statements.english: What's the weather like in spring?

statements.chinese: 三月经常刮风。
statements.english: It's often windy in March.

statements.chinese: 四月和五月总是很暖和，但有时会下雨。
statements.english: It's always warm in April and May, but it rains sometimes.

statements.chinese: 夏天怎么样？
statements.english: What's it like in summer?

statements.chinese: 六月、七月和八月总是很热。
statements.english: It's always hot in June, July and August.

statements.chinese: 每天阳光普照。
statements.english: The sun shines every day.

statements.chinese: 秋天是冷还是暖和？
statements.english: Is it cold or warm in autumn?

statements.chinese: 九月和十月总是很暖和。
statements.english: It's always warm in September and October.

statements.chinese: 十一月经常很冷，有时会下雨。
statements.english: It's often cold in November and it rains sometimes.

statements.chinese: 冬天很冷吗？
statements.english: Is it very cold in winter?

statements.chinese: 十二月、一月和二月经常很冷。
statements.english: It's often cold in December, January and February.

statements.chinese: 有时会下雪。
statements.english: It snows sometimes.

courses.title: Lessons 53–54: An Interesting Climate
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 17 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 在英国，人们最喜欢谈论什么？
statements.english: What is the favourite subject of conversation in England?

statements.chinese: 你来自哪里？
statements.english: Where do you come from?

statements.chinese: 我来自英格兰。
statements.english: I come from England.

statements.chinese: 你们国家的气候怎么样？
statements.english: What's the climate like in your country?

statements.chinese: 气候温和，但并非总是宜人的。
statements.english: It's mild, but it's not always pleasant.

statements.chinese: 北部常寒冷，东部常刮风。
statements.english: The weather's often cold in the North and windy in the East.

statements.chinese: 西部常潮湿，南部有时温暖。
statements.english: It's often wet in the West and sometimes warm in the South.

statements.chinese: 你最喜欢哪个季节？
statements.english: Which seasons do you like best?

statements.chinese: 我喜欢春天和夏天。
statements.english: I like spring and summer.

statements.chinese: 白天长，夜晚短。
statements.english: The days are long and the nights are short.

statements.chinese: 太阳升得早，落得晚。
statements.english: The sun rises early and sets late.

statements.chinese: 我不喜欢秋天和冬天。
statements.english: I don't like autumn and winter.

statements.chinese: 白天短，夜晚长。
statements.english: The days are short and the nights are long.

statements.chinese: 太阳升得晚，落得早。
statements.english: The sun rises late and sets early.

statements.chinese: 我们的气候不怎么样，但确实很有趣。
statements.english: Our climate is not very good, but it's certainly interesting.

statements.chinese: 这是我们最喜欢谈论的话题。
statements.english: It's our favourite subject of conversation.

courses.title: Lessons 55–56: The Sawyer Family
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 17 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 孩子们什么时候做家庭作业？
statements.english: When do the children do their homework?

statements.chinese: 索耶一家住在国王街87号。
statements.english: The Sawyers live at 87 King Street.

statements.chinese: 早上，索耶先生去上班，孩子们去上学。
statements.english: In the morning, Mr. Sawyer goes to work and the children go to school.

statements.chinese: 他们的父亲每天送他们上学。
statements.english: Their father takes them to school every day.

statements.chinese: 索耶夫人每天待在家里。
statements.english: Mrs. Sawyer stays at home every day.

statements.chinese: 她做家务。
statements.english: She does the housework.

statements.chinese: 她总是在中午吃午饭。
statements.english: She always eats her lunch at noon.

statements.chinese: 下午，她通常会见朋友。
statements.english: In the afternoon, she usually sees her friends.

statements.chinese: 他们经常一起喝茶。
statements.english: They often drink tea together.

statements.chinese: 晚上，孩子们从学校回家。
statements.english: In the evening, the children come home from school.

statements.chinese: 他们早早到家。
statements.english: They arrive home early.

statements.chinese: 索耶先生下班回家。
statements.english: Mr. Sawyer comes home from work.

statements.chinese: 他很晚才到家。
statements.english: He arrives home late.

statements.chinese: 晚上，孩子们总是做家庭作业。
statements.english: At night, the children always do their homework.

statements.chinese: 然后他们去睡觉。
statements.english: Then they go to bed.

statements.chinese: 索耶先生通常看报纸，但有时他和妻子会看电视。
statements.english: Mr. Sawyer usually reads his newspaper, but sometimes he and his wife watch television.

courses.title: Lessons 57–58: An Unusual Day
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 16 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 萨维尔先生今晚在做什么？
statements.english: What is Mr. Sawyer doing tonight?

statements.chinese: 八点了。
statements.english: It is eight o'clock.
The children go to school by car every day, but today, they are going to school on foot.
statements.chinese: 孩子们每天都乘车上学，但今天他们步行上学。
十点了。
statements.english: It is ten o'clock.
Mrs. Sawyer usually stays at home in the morning, but this morning, she is going to the shops.
statements.chinese: 萨维尔夫人通常上午呆在家里，但今天上午她要去商店。
四点了。
statements.english: It is four o'clock.

statements.chinese: 下午，萨维尔夫人通常在客厅里喝茶。
statements.english: In the afternoon, Mrs. Sawyer usually drinks tea in the living room.

statements.chinese: 但今天下午，她在花园里喝茶。
statements.english: But this afternoon, she is drinking tea in the garden.

statements.chinese: 六点了。
statements.english: It is six o'clock.
In the evening, the children usually do their homework, but this evening, they are not doing their homework.
statements.chinese: 晚上，孩子们通常做作业，但今晚他们没有做作业。
此刻，他们正在花园里玩耍。
statements.english: At the moment, they are playing in the garden.

statements.chinese: 九点了。
statements.english: It is nine o'clock.

statements.chinese: 萨维尔先生通常晚上看报纸。
statements.english: Mr. Sawyer usually reads his newspaper at night.

statements.chinese: 但今晚他没有看报纸。
statements.english: But he's not reading his newspaper tonight.

statements.chinese: 此刻，他正在读一本有趣的书。
statements.english: At the moment, he's reading an interesting book.

courses.title: Lessons 59–60: Is That All
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 20 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 这位女士买粉笔了吗？
statements.english: Does the lady buy any chalk?

statements.chinese: 我要一些信封。
statements.english: I want some envelopes, please.

statements.chinese: 您要大的还是小的？
statements.english: Do you want the large size or the small size?

statements.chinese: 请给我大的。
statements.english: The large size, please.

statements.chinese: 您有信纸吗？
statements.english: Do you have any writing paper?

statements.chinese: 有，我们有。
statements.english: Yes, we do.

statements.chinese: 我没有小本的。
statements.english: I don't have any small pads.

statements.chinese: 我只有大本的。
statements.english: I only have large ones.

statements.chinese: 您要一本吗？
statements.english: Do you want a pad?

statements.chinese: 是的，谢谢。
statements.english: Yes, please.

statements.chinese: 我还要一些胶水。
statements.english: And I want some glue.

statements.chinese: 一瓶胶水。
statements.english: A bottle of glue.

statements.chinese: 我还要一大盒粉笔。
statements.english: And I want a large box of chalk, too.

statements.chinese: 我只有小盒的。
statements.english: I only have small boxes.

statements.chinese: 您要一盒吗？
statements.english: Do you want one?

statements.chinese: 不，谢谢。
statements.english: No, thank you.

statements.chinese: 就这些，谢谢。
statements.english: That's all, thank you.

statements.chinese: 您还想要什么？
statements.english: What else do you want?

statements.chinese: 我要我的零钱。
statements.english: I want my change.

courses.title: Lessons 61–62: A Bad Cold
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 20 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 吉米在哪里？
statements.english: Where's Jimmy?

statements.chinese: 他在床上。
statements.english: He's in bed.

statements.chinese: 他怎么了？
statements.english: What's the matter with him?

statements.chinese: 他感觉不舒服。
statements.english: He feels ill.

statements.chinese: 他看起来不舒服。
statements.english: He looks ill.

statements.chinese: 我们必须叫医生。
statements.english: We must call the doctor.

statements.chinese: 是的，我们必须。
statements.english: Yes, we must.

statements.chinese: 你能记住医生的电话号码吗？
statements.english: Can you remember the doctor's telephone number?

statements.chinese: 是的。
statements.english: Yes.

statements.chinese: 张开嘴，吉米。
statements.english: Open your mouth, Jimmy.

statements.chinese: 给我看看你的舌头。
statements.english: Show me your tongue.

statements.chinese: 说“啊”。
statements.english: Say ah.

statements.chinese: 医生，他怎么了？
statements.english: What's the matter with him, doctor?

statements.chinese: 他得了重感冒，威廉姆斯先生。
statements.english: He has a bad cold, Mr. Williams.

statements.chinese: 所以他必须卧床一周。
statements.english: So he must stay in bed for a week.

statements.chinese: 这对吉米来说是个好消息。
statements.english: That's good news for Jimmy.

statements.chinese: 好消息？
statements.english: Good news?

statements.chinese: 为什么？
statements.english: Why?

statements.chinese: 因为他不喜欢学校。
statements.english: Because he doesn't like school.

courses.title: Lessons 63–64: Thank You, Doctor
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 21 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 今天还有谁躺在床上？为什么？
statements.english: Who else is in bed today? Why?

statements.chinese: 吉米今天怎么样了？
statements.english: How's Jimmy today?

statements.chinese: 好多了。
statements.english: Better.

statements.chinese: 我能看看他吗，威廉斯夫人？
statements.english: Can I see him please, Mrs. Williams?

statements.chinese: 当然可以，医生。
statements.english: Certainly, doctor.

statements.chinese: 上楼来吧。
statements.english: Come upstairs.

statements.chinese: 你看上去很好，吉米。
statements.english: You look very well, Jimmy.

statements.chinese: 你现在好些了，但是还不能起床。
statements.english: You are better now, but you mustn't get up yet.

statements.chinese: 你必须再卧床两天。
statements.english: You must stay in bed for another two days.

statements.chinese: 这孩子还不能去上学，威廉斯夫人。
statements.english: The boy mustn't go to school yet, Mrs. Williams.

statements.chinese: 他也不能吃油腻的食物。
statements.english: And he mustn't eat rich food.

statements.chinese: 他发烧吗，医生？
statements.english: Does he have a temperature, doctor?

statements.chinese: 不，他没有。
statements.english: No, he doesn't.

statements.chinese: 他必须卧床吗？
statements.english: Must he stay in bed?

statements.chinese: 是的。他必须再卧床两天。
statements.english: Yes. He must remain in bed for another two days.

statements.chinese: 他每天可以起床大约两小时，但是你必须保持房间温暖。
statements.english: He can get up for about two hours each day, but you must keep the room warm.

statements.chinese: 威廉斯先生今晚在哪儿？
statements.english: Where's Mr. Williams this evening?

statements.chinese: 他在床上，医生。
statements.english: He's in bed, doctor.

statements.chinese: 您能去看看他吗？
statements.english: Can you see him please?

statements.chinese: 他也得了重感冒！
statements.english: He has a bad cold, too!

courses.title: Lessons 65–66: Not a Baby
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 24 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 吉尔拿走了前门的钥匙吗？
statements.english: Does Jill take the key to the front door?

statements.chinese: 吉尔，你今晚打算做什么？
statements.english: What are you going to do this evening, Jill?

statements.chinese: 爸爸，我打算去见几个朋友。
statements.english: I'm going to meet some friends, Dad.

statements.chinese: 你不许回来太晚。
statements.english: You mustn't come home late.

statements.chinese: 你必须在十点半之前到家。
statements.english: You must be home at half past ten.

statements.chinese: 爸爸，我不能那么早回家！
statements.english: I can't get home so early, Dad!

statements.chinese: 我能拿前门的钥匙吗？
statements.english: Can I have the key to the front door, please?

statements.chinese: 不，你不能。
statements.english: No, you can't.

statements.chinese: 吉尔已经十八岁了，汤姆。
statements.english: Jill's eighteen years old, Tom.

statements.chinese: 她不是小孩子。
statements.english: She's not a baby.

statements.chinese: 把钥匙给她吧。
statements.english: Give her the key.

statements.chinese: 她总是回家很早的。
statements.english: She always comes home early.

statements.chinese: 哦，好吧！
statements.english: Oh, all right!

statements.chinese: 给你。
statements.english: Here you are.

statements.chinese: 但是你不能在十一点一刻之后回家。
statements.english: But you mustn't come home after a quarter past eleven.

statements.chinese: 听到了吗？
statements.english: Do you hear?

statements.chinese: 是的，爸爸。
statements.english: Yes, Dad.

statements.chinese: 谢谢，妈妈。
statements.english: Thanks, Mum.

statements.chinese: 没关系。
statements.english: That's all right.

statements.chinese: 再见。
statements.english: Goodbye.

statements.chinese: 玩得开心！
statements.english: Enjoy yourself!

statements.chinese: 妈妈，我们总是玩得很开心的。
statements.english: We always enjoy ourselves, Mum.

statements.chinese: 再见。
statements.english: Bye-bye.

courses.title: Lessons 67–68: The Weekend
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 18 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 约翰逊一家周末打算做什么？
statements.english: What are the Johnsons going to do at the weekend?

statements.chinese: 你好。你刚才在肉店吗？
statements.english: Hello. Were you at the butcher's?

statements.chinese: 是的，我在那里。
statements.english: Yes, I was.

statements.chinese: 你也在肉店吗？
statements.english: Were you at the butcher's, too?

statements.chinese: 不，我不在。
statements.english: No, I wasn't.

statements.chinese: 我在蔬菜店。
statements.english: I was at the greengrocer's.

statements.chinese: 吉米今天怎么样？
statements.english: How's Jimmy today?

statements.chinese: 他很好，谢谢你。
statements.english: He's very well, thank you.

statements.chinese: 他上周没去上学吗？
statements.english: Was he absent from school last week?

statements.chinese: 是的，他没去。
statements.english: Yes, he was.

statements.chinese: 他周一、周二、周三和周四都没去。
statements.english: He was absent on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

statements.chinese: 你们都好吗？
statements.english: How are you all keeping?

statements.chinese: 我们都很好，谢谢。
statements.english: Very well, thank you.

statements.chinese: 我们要去乡下待三天！
statements.english: We're going to spend three days in the country!

statements.chinese: 这个周末我们要待在我妈妈家。
statements.english: We're going to stay at my mother's for the weekend.

statements.chinese: 周五、周六和周日在乡下！
statements.english: Friday, Saturday and Sunday in the country!

statements.chinese: 你们真幸运！
statements.english: Aren't you lucky!

courses.title: Lessons 69–70: The Car Race
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 17 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 哪辆车赢得了1995年的比赛？
statements.english: Which car was the winner in 1995?

statements.chinese: 每年我们镇附近都有一场赛车比赛。
statements.english: There is a car race near our town every year.

statements.chinese: 1995年，那里举行了一场非常盛大的比赛。
statements.english: In 1995, there was a very big race.

statements.chinese: 那里有数百人。
statements.english: There were hundreds of people there.

statements.chinese: 我妻子和我在赛场。
statements.english: My wife and I were at the race.

statements.chinese: 我们的朋友朱莉和杰克也在那里。
statements.english: Our friends Julie and Jack were there, too.

statements.chinese: 你可以在人群中看到我们。
statements.english: You can see us in the crowd.

statements.chinese: 我们站在左边。
statements.english: We are standing on the left.

statements.chinese: 比赛中有二十辆车。
statements.english: There were twenty cars in the race.

statements.chinese: 有英国车、法国车、德国车、意大利车、美国车和日本车。
statements.english: There were English cars, French cars, German cars, Italian cars, American cars and Japanese cars.

statements.chinese: 那是一个激动人心的结局。
statements.english: It was an exciting finish.

statements.chinese: 获胜者是比利·斯图尔特。
statements.english: The winner was Billy Stewart.

statements.chinese: 他在15号车里。
statements.english: He was in car number fifteen.

statements.chinese: 其他五辆车紧随其后。
statements.english: Five other cars were just behind him.

statements.chinese: 在回家的路上，我妻子对我说：“别开那么快！
statements.english: On the way home, my wife said to me, 'Don't drive so quickly!

statements.chinese: 你又不是比利·斯图尔特！”
statements.english: You're not Billy Stewart!'

courses.title: Lessons 71–72: He's Awful
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 20 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 9点钟时，波琳是怎样接电话的？
statements.english: How did Pauline answer the telephone at nine o'clock?

statements.chinese: 罗恩·马斯顿是什么样的人，波琳？
statements.english: What's Ron Marston like, Pauline?

statements.chinese: 他昨天给我打了4次电话，前天打了3次。
statements.english: He telephoned me four times yesterday and three times the day before yesterday.

statements.chinese: 他昨天上午和昨天下午都把电话打到办公室去了。
statements.english: He telephoned the office yesterday morning and yesterday afternoon.

statements.chinese: 我的老板接的电话。
statements.english: My boss answered the telephone.

statements.chinese: 你老板对他说什么了？
statements.english: What did your boss say to him?

statements.chinese: 他说：“波琳正在打字。
statements.english: He said, 'Pauline is typing letters.

statements.chinese: 她现在不能跟你讲话！”
statements.english: She can't speak to you now!'

statements.chinese: 昨天晚上6点我回到家。
statements.english: Then I arrived home at six o'clock yesterday evening.

statements.chinese: 他又打电话来了。
statements.english: He telephoned again.

statements.chinese: 可我没接电话！
statements.english: But I didn't answer the phone!

statements.chinese: 昨晚他又打电话了吗？
statements.english: Did he telephone again last night?

statements.chinese: 是的，打了。
statements.english: Yes, he did.

statements.chinese: 他在9点钟打电话来了。
statements.english: He telephoned at nine o'clock.

statements.chinese: 你对他说了什么？
statements.english: What did you say to him?

statements.chinese: 我说：“我是波琳的妈妈。
statements.english: I said, 'This is Pauline's mother.

statements.chinese: 请不要再给我女儿打电话了！”
statements.english: Please don't telephone my daughter again!'

statements.chinese: 他又打电话了吗？
statements.english: Did he telephone again?

statements.chinese: 没有！
statements.english: No, he didn't!

courses.title: Lessons 73–74: The Way to King Street
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 17 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 为什么那个男人需要一本常用语手册？
statements.english: Why did the man need a phrasebook?

statements.chinese: 上周，米尔斯夫人去了伦敦。
statements.english: Last week Mrs. Mills went to London.

statements.chinese: 她对伦敦不熟悉，迷路了。
statements.english: She does not know London very well, and she lost her way.

statements.chinese: 突然，她看到一个男人在公交车站附近。
statements.english: Suddenly, she saw a man near a bus stop.

statements.chinese: “我可以问他路，”她自言自语道。
statements.english: 'I can ask him the way,' she said to herself.

statements.chinese: “打扰一下，”她说。
statements.english: 'Excuse me,' she said.

statements.chinese: “请问，你能告诉我国王街怎么走吗？”
statements.english: 'Can you tell me the way to King Street, please?'

statements.chinese: 那个男人友好地笑了笑。
statements.english: The man smiled pleasantly.

statements.chinese: 他不懂英语！
statements.english: He did not understand English!

statements.chinese: 他说德语。
statements.english: He spoke German.

statements.chinese: 他是一名游客。
statements.english: He was a tourist.

statements.chinese: 然后他把手伸进口袋，掏出了一本常用语手册。
statements.english: Then he put his hand into his pocket, and took out a phrasebook.

statements.chinese: 他翻开书，找到了一句话。
statements.english: He opened the book and found a phrase.

statements.chinese: 他慢慢地读着这句话。
statements.english: He read the phrase slowly.

statements.chinese: “对不起，”他说。
statements.english: 'I am sorry,' he said.

statements.chinese: “我不会说英语。”
statements.english: 'I do not speak English.'

courses.title: Lessons 75–76: Uncomfortable Shoes
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 21 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 这些时髦的鞋有什么问题？
statements.english: What's wrong with the fashionable shoes?

statements.chinese: 你们有这种鞋吗？
statements.english: Do you have any shoes like these?

statements.chinese: 多少尺码？
statements.english: What size?
Size five.

statements.chinese: 什么颜色？
statements.english: What colour?

statements.chinese: 黑色。
statements.english: Black.

statements.chinese: 很抱歉。
statements.english: I'm sorry.

statements.chinese: 我们没有。
statements.english: We don't have any.

statements.chinese: 可是我姐姐上个月买了一双这种鞋。
statements.english: But my sister bought this pair last month.

statements.chinese: 她是在这儿买的吗？
statements.english: Did she buy them here?

statements.chinese: 不，她是在美国买的。
statements.english: No, she bought them in the U. S.

statements.chinese: 一个月前我们有这种鞋，但现在没有了。
statements.english: We had some shoes like those a month ago, but we don't have any now.

statements.chinese: 您能给我进一双吗？
statements.english: Can you get a pair for me, please?

statements.chinese: 恐怕不能。
statements.english: I'm afraid that I can't.

statements.chinese: 这种鞋去年和前年很流行。
statements.english: They were in fashion last year and the year before last.

statements.chinese: 但今年不流行了。
statements.english: But they're not in fashion this year.

statements.chinese: 现在这种鞋很流行。
statements.english: These shoes are in fashion now.

statements.chinese: 这种鞋看起来很不舒服。
statements.english: They look very uncomfortable.

statements.chinese: 它们是很不舒服。
statements.english: They are very uncomfortable.

statements.chinese: 但是女士们总是穿不舒服的鞋！
statements.english: But women always wear uncomfortable shoes!

courses.title: Lessons 77–78: Terrible Toothache
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 21 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音带，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 你认为现在是几点？你是怎么知道的？
statements.english: What time of day is it, do you think? How do you know?

statements.chinese: 早上好，克罗夫特先生。
statements.english: Good morning, Mr. Croft.

statements.chinese: 早上好，护士。
statements.english: Good morning, nurse.

statements.chinese: 我想看牙医。
statements.english: I want to see the dentist, please.

statements.chinese: 你预约了吗？
statements.english: Do you have an appointment?

statements.chinese: 没有。
statements.english: No, I don't.

statements.chinese: 情况紧急吗？
statements.english: Is it urgent?

statements.chinese: 是的，很紧急。
statements.english: Yes, it is.

statements.chinese: 非常紧急。
statements.english: It's very urgent.

statements.chinese: 我感觉糟透了。
statements.english: I feel awful.

statements.chinese: 我牙痛得厉害。
statements.english: I have a terrible toothache.

statements.chinese: 你能在4月24日星期一上午10点来吗？
statements.english: Can you come at 10 a.m. on Monday, April 24th?

statements.chinese: 护士，我必须现在就看牙医。
statements.english: I must see the dentist now, nurse.

statements.chinese: 牙医现在很忙。
statements.english: The dentist is very busy at the moment.

statements.chinese: 你能在下午2点来吗？
statements.english: Can you come at 2 p.m. ?

statements.chinese: 那太晚了。
statements.english: That's very late.

statements.chinese: 牙医现在能给我看病吗？
statements.english: Can the dentist see me now?

statements.chinese: 克罗夫特先生，恐怕他不能。
statements.english: I'm afraid that he can't, Mr. Croft.

statements.chinese: 你不能等到今天下午吗？
statements.english: Can't you wait till this afternoon?

statements.chinese: 我能等，但我的牙痛不能等！
statements.english: I can wait, but my toothache can't!

courses.title: Lessons 79–80: Carol's Shopping List
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 20 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 卡罗尔不打算买什么？
statements.english: What is Carol not going to buy?

statements.chinese: 你在干什么，卡罗尔？
statements.english: What are you doing, Carol?

statements.chinese: 我正在列购物清单，汤姆。
statements.english: I'm making a shopping list, Tom.

statements.chinese: 我们需要什么？
statements.english: What do we need?

statements.chinese: 我们这周需要很多东西。
statements.english: We need a lot of things this week.

statements.chinese: 我必须去杂货店。
statements.english: I must go to the grocer's.

statements.chinese: 我们没有多少茶叶和咖啡了，糖和果酱也没有了。
statements.english: We haven't got much tea or coffee, and we haven't got any sugar or jam.

statements.chinese: 蔬菜呢？
statements.english: What about vegetables?

statements.chinese: 我必须去蔬菜水果店。
statements.english: I must go to the greengroce's.

statements.chinese: 我们没有多少西红柿了，但我们有很多土豆。
statements.english: We haven't got many tomatoes, but we've got a lot of potatoes.

statements.chinese: 我也必须去肉店。
statements.english: I must go to the butcher's, too.

statements.chinese: 我们需要一些肉。
statements.english: We need some meat.

statements.chinese: 我们一点肉都没有了。
statements.english: We haven't got any meat at all.

statements.chinese: 我们有啤酒和葡萄酒吗？
statements.english: Have we got any beer and wine?

statements.chinese: 不，没有。
statements.english: No, we haven't.

statements.chinese: 而且我也不打算买！
statements.english: And I'm not going to get any!

statements.chinese: 我希望你有点钱。
statements.english: I hope that you've got some money.

statements.chinese: 我没有多少钱。
statements.english: I haven't got much.

statements.chinese: 嗯，我也没多少钱！
statements.english: Well, I haven't got much either!

courses.title: Lessons 81–82: Roast Beef and Potatoes
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 25 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 卡罗尔为什么感到失望？
statements.english: Why is Carol disappointed?

statements.chinese: 嗨，卡罗尔！汤姆在哪儿？
statements.english: Hi, Carol! Where's Tom?

statements.chinese: 他在楼上。
statements.english: He's upstairs.

statements.chinese: 他正在洗澡。
statements.english: He's having a bath.

statements.chinese: 汤姆！
statements.english: Tom!

statements.chinese: 怎么了？
statements.english: Yes?

statements.chinese: 山姆来了。
statements.english: Sam's here.

statements.chinese: 我快好了。
statements.english: I'm nearly ready.

statements.chinese: 你好，山姆。
statements.english: Hello, Sam.

statements.chinese: 来根烟吧。
statements.english: Have a cigarette.

statements.chinese: 不了，谢谢你，汤姆。
statements.english: No, thanks, Tom.

statements.chinese: 那来杯威士忌吧。
statements.english: Have a glass of whisky then.

statements.chinese: 好的。
statements.english: OK.

statements.chinese: 谢谢。
statements.english: Thanks.

statements.chinese: 晚饭准备好了吗，卡罗尔？
statements.english: Is dinner ready, Carol?

statements.chinese: 差不多好了。
statements.english: It's nearly ready.

statements.chinese: 我们七点可以吃晚饭。
statements.english: We can have dinner at seven o'clock.

statements.chinese: 山姆和我今天一起吃了午饭。
statements.english: Sam and I had lunch together today.

statements.chinese: 我们去了一家餐馆。
statements.english: We went to a restaurant.

statements.chinese: 你们吃了什么？
statements.english: What did you have?

statements.chinese: 我们吃了烤牛肉和土豆。
statements.english: We had roast beef and potatoes.

statements.chinese: 哦！
statements.english: Oh!

statements.chinese: 怎么了，卡罗尔？
statements.english: What's the matter, Carol?

statements.chinese: 呃，你们今晚又要吃烤牛肉和土豆了！
statements.english: Well, you're going to have roast beef and potatoes again tonight!

courses.title: Lessons 83–84: Going on Holiday
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 26 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 萨姆今年去哪里度假了？
statements.english: Where did Sam go for his holiday this year?

statements.chinese: 你好，萨姆。
statements.english: Hello, Sam.

statements.chinese: 进来。
statements.english: Come in.

statements.chinese: 嗨，萨姆。
statements.english: Hi, Sam.

statements.chinese: 我们正在吃午饭。
statements.english: We're having lunch.

statements.chinese: 你想和我们一起吃午饭吗？
statements.english: Do you want to have lunch with us?

statements.chinese: 不用了，谢谢你，汤姆。
statements.english: No, thank you, Tom.

statements.chinese: 我已经吃过午饭了。
statements.english: I've already had lunch.

statements.chinese: 我十二点半吃午饭的。
statements.english: I had lunch at half past twelve.

statements.chinese: 那喝杯咖啡吧。
statements.english: Have a cup of coffee then.

statements.chinese: 我刚喝了一杯，谢谢。
statements.english: I've just had a cup, thank you.

statements.chinese: 我午饭后喝的。
statements.english: I had one after my lunch.

statements.chinese: 凯罗尔，我们去客厅吧。
statements.english: Let's go into the living room, Carol.

statements.chinese: 我们可以在那儿喝咖啡。
statements.english: We can have our coffee there.

statements.chinese: 萨姆，请原谅这儿有点乱。
statements.english: Excuse the mess, Sam.

statements.chinese: 这房间太不整洁了。
statements.english: This room's very untidy.

statements.chinese: 我们正在打包行李箱。
statements.english: We're packing our suitcases.

statements.chinese: 我们明天要走了。
statements.english: We're going to leave tomorrow.

statements.chinese: 汤姆和我要去度假了。
statements.english: Tom and I are going to have a holiday.

statements.chinese: 你们真幸运！
statements.english: Aren't you lucky!

statements.chinese: 萨姆，你什么时候去度假？
statements.english: When are you going to have a holiday, Sam?

statements.chinese: 我不知道。
statements.english: I don't know.

statements.chinese: 我今年已经度过假了。
statements.english: I've already had my holiday this year.

statements.chinese: 你去哪儿了？
statements.english: Where did you go?

statements.chinese: 我待在家里！
statements.english: I stayed at home!

courses.title: Lessons 85–86: Paris in the Spring
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 19 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 肯是在一年中的什么时候访问巴黎的？
statements.english: At what time of year did Ken visit Paris?

statements.chinese: 你好，肯。
statements.english: Hello, Ken.

statements.chinese: 嗨，乔治。
statements.english: Hi, George.

statements.chinese: 你刚去电影院了吗？
statements.english: Have you just been to the cinema?

statements.chinese: 是的，我去了。
statements.english: Yes, I have.

statements.chinese: 正在放映什么？
statements.english: What's on?

statements.chinese: 哦，我已经看过了。
statements.english: Oh, I've already seen it.

statements.chinese: 我去年在电视上看过。
statements.english: I saw it on television last year.

statements.chinese: 那是一部老电影，但非常好。
statements.english: It's an old film, but it's very good.

statements.chinese: 巴黎是一座美丽的城市。
statements.english: Paris is a beautiful city.

statements.chinese: 我从未去过那里。
statements.english: I've never been there.

statements.chinese: 你去过那里吗，肯？
statements.english: Have you ever been there, Ken?

statements.chinese: 是的，我去过。
statements.english: Yes, I have.

statements.chinese: 我是四月份去的。
statements.english: I was there in April.

statements.chinese: 春天的巴黎，是吗？
statements.english: Paris in the spring, eh?

statements.chinese: 那是春天，但天气很糟糕。
statements.english: It was spring, but the weather was awful.

statements.chinese: 一直在下雨。
statements.english: It rained all the time.

statements.chinese: 就像伦敦一样！
statements.english: Just like London!

courses.title: Lessons 87–88: A Car Crash
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 20 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 机械师能修好伍德先生的车吗？
statements.english: Can the mechanics repair Mr. Wood's car?

statements.chinese: 我的车修好了吗？
statements.english: Is my car ready yet?

statements.chinese: 我不知道，先生。
statements.english: I don't know, sir.

statements.chinese: 您的车牌号是多少？
statements.english: What's the number of your car?

statements.chinese: 是 LFZ 312 G。
statements.english: It's LFZ 312 G.

statements.chinese: 您什么时候把它送来的？
statements.english: When did you bring it to us?

statements.chinese: 我三天前把它送来的。
statements.english: I brought it here three days ago.

statements.chinese: 啊，是的，我现在想起来了。
statements.english: Ah yes, I remember now.

statements.chinese: 您的机械师修好了吗？
statements.english: Have your mechanics finished yet?

statements.chinese: 没有，他们还在修。
statements.english: No, they're still working on it.

statements.chinese: 我们去车库看看吧。
statements.english: Let's go into the garage and have a look at it.

statements.chinese: 那不是你的车吗？
statements.english: Isn't that your car?

statements.chinese: 嗯，那是我的车。
statements.english: Well, it was my car.

statements.chinese: 你没有出车祸吗？
statements.english: Didn't you have a crash?

statements.chinese: 是的。
statements.english: That's right.

statements.chinese: 我把它撞到了路灯柱上。
statements.english: I drove it into a lamp-post.

statements.chinese: 你的机械师能修好它吗？
statements.english: Can your mechanics repair it?

statements.chinese: 嗯，先生，他们正在努力修。
statements.english: Well, they're trying to repair it, sir.

statements.chinese: 但说实话，你需要一辆新车了！
statements.english: But to tell you the truth, you need a new car!

courses.title: Lessons 89–90: For Sale
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 23 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 为什么奈杰尔不能决定？
statements.english: Why couldn't Nigel decide?

statements.chinese: 下午好。
statements.english: Good afternoon.

statements.chinese: 我想这栋房子是待售的。
statements.english: I believe that this house is for sale.

statements.chinese: 没错。
statements.english: That's right.

statements.chinese: 我能进去看看吗？
statements.english: May I have a look at it, please?

statements.chinese: 当然可以。
statements.english: Yes, of course.

statements.chinese: 请进。
statements.english: Come in.

statements.chinese: 你在这里住了多久了？
statements.english: How long have you lived here?

statements.chinese: 我在这里住了二十年了。
statements.english: I've lived here for twenty years.

statements.chinese: 二十年了！
statements.english: Twenty years!

statements.chinese: 那可真久啊。
statements.english: That's a long time.

statements.chinese: 是的，我从1976年就住在这里了。
statements.english: Yes, I've been here since 1976.

statements.chinese: 那你为什么要卖掉它呢？
statements.english: Then why do you want to sell it?

statements.chinese: 因为我刚退休。
statements.english: Because I've just retired.

statements.chinese: 我想在乡下买一栋小房子。
statements.english: I want to buy a small house in the country.

statements.chinese: 这栋房子多少钱？
statements.english: How much does this house cost?

statements.chinese: 那可真是一大笔钱！
statements.english: That's a lot of money!

statements.chinese: 它值这个价。
statements.english: It's worth every penny of it.

statements.chinese: 嗯，我喜欢这栋房子，但我还不能决定。
statements.english: Well, I like the house, but I can't decide yet.

statements.chinese: 我妻子必须先看看。
statements.english: My wife must see it first.

statements.chinese: 女人总是说了算。
statements.english: Women always have the last word.

courses.title: Lessons 91–92: Poor Ian
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 24 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 威斯特先生把他的房子卖了吗？
statements.english: Has Mr. West sold his house yet?

statements.chinese: 是的，他卖了。
statements.english: Yes, he has.

statements.chinese: 他上星期把它卖掉了。
statements.english: He sold it last week.

statements.chinese: 他搬进新家了吗？
statements.english: Has he moved to his new house yet?

statements.chinese: 不，还没有。
statements.english: No, not yet.

statements.chinese: 他还在这儿。
statements.english: He's still here.

statements.chinese: 他打算明天搬家。
statements.english: He's going to move tomorrow.

statements.chinese: 什么时候？
statements.english: When?

statements.chinese: 明天上午吗？
statements.english: Tomorrow morning?

statements.chinese: 不。
statements.english: No.

statements.chinese: 明天下午。
statements.english: Tomorrow afternoon.

statements.chinese: 我会想念他的。
statements.english: I shall miss him.

statements.chinese: 他一直是个好邻居。
statements.english: He has always been a good neighbour.

statements.chinese: 他是个很好的人。
statements.english: He's a very nice person.

statements.chinese: 我们都会想念他的。
statements.english: We shall all miss him.

statements.chinese: 新房客什么时候搬进这所房子？
statements.english: When will the new people move into this house?

statements.chinese: 我想他们会在后天搬进来。
statements.english: I think that they will move in the day after tomorrow.

statements.chinese: 布朗夫人，你今天会见到威斯特先生吗？
statements.english: Will you see Mr. West today, Mrs. Brown?

statements.chinese: 是的，我会的。
statements.english: Yes, I shall.

statements.chinese: 请代我向他问好。
statements.english: Please give him my regards.

statements.chinese: 可怜的威斯特先生！
statements.english: Poor Mr. West!

statements.chinese: 他不想离开这所房子。
statements.english: He didn't want to leave this house.

statements.chinese: 不。
statements.english: No.

statements.chinese: 他不想离开，可他妻子想。
statements.english: He didn't want to leave, but his wife did.

courses.title: Lessons 93–94: Our New Neighbour
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 14 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 为什么奈杰尔是个幸运的人？
statements.english: Why is Nigel a lucky man?

statements.chinese: 奈杰尔是我们的新邻居。
statements.english: Nigel is our new next-door neighbour.

statements.chinese: 他是一名飞行员。
statements.english: He's a pilot.

statements.chinese: 他曾服役于皇家空军。
statements.english: He was in the R.A.F.

statements.chinese: 下个月他将飞往纽约。
statements.english: He will fly to New York next month.

statements.chinese: 下下个月他将飞往东京。
statements.english: The month after next he'll fly to Tokyo.

statements.chinese: 此刻，他在马德里。
statements.english: At the moment, he's in Madrid.

statements.chinese: 一周前他飞往西班牙。
statements.english: He flew to Spain a week ago.

statements.chinese: 下下周他将返回伦敦。
statements.english: He'll return to London the week after next.
He's only forty-one years old, and he has already been to nearly every country in the world.
statements.chinese: 他只有四十一岁，而且他已经去过世界上几乎每一个国家。
奈杰尔是一个非常幸运的人。
statements.english: Nigel is a very lucky man.

statements.chinese: 但是他的妻子却不那么幸运。
statements.english: But his wife isn't very lucky.

statements.chinese: 她通常待在家里！
statements.english: She usually stays at home!

courses.title: Lessons 95–96: Tickets, Please
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 23 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 乔治和肯为什么误了火车？
statements.english: Why did George and Ken miss the train?

statements.chinese: 请给我两张到伦敦的往返票。
statements.english: Two return tickets to London, please.

statements.chinese: 下一班火车什么时候开？
statements.english: What time will the next train leave?

statements.chinese: 八点十九分。
statements.english: At nineteen minutes past eight.

statements.chinese: 哪个站台？
statements.english: Which platform?

statements.chinese: 二号站台。
statements.english: Platform Two.

statements.chinese: 从天桥过去。
statements.english: Over the bridge.

statements.chinese: 下一班火车什么时候开？
statements.english: What time will the next train leave?

statements.chinese: 八点十九分。
statements.english: At eight nineteen.

statements.chinese: 我们时间很充裕。
statements.english: We've got plenty of time.

statements.chinese: 现在才差三分钟八点。
statements.english: It's only three minutes to eight.

statements.chinese: 我们去喝一杯吧。
statements.english: Let's go and have a drink.

statements.chinese: 车站旁边有个酒吧。
statements.english: There's a bar next door to the station.

statements.chinese: 肯，我们现在最好回车站了。
statements.english: We had better go back to the station now, Ken.

statements.chinese: 我们想乘八点十九分去伦敦的火车。
statements.english: We want to catch the eight nineteen to London.

statements.chinese: 你们刚错过了！
statements.english: You've just missed it!

statements.chinese: 什么！
statements.english: What!

statements.chinese: 现在才八点十五分。
statements.english: It's only eight fifteen.

statements.chinese: 对不起，先生。
statements.english: I'm sorry, sir.

statements.chinese: 那个钟慢了十分钟。
statements.english: That clock's ten minutes slow.

statements.chinese: 下一班火车什么时候开？
statements.english: When's the next train?

statements.chinese: 五个小时以后！
statements.english: In five hours' time!

courses.title: Lessons 97–98: A Small Blue Case
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 35 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 前几天我把一个手提箱忘在了去伦敦的火车上。
statements.english: I left a suitcase on the train to London the other day.

statements.chinese: 您能描述一下它吗，先生？
statements.english: Can you describe it, sir?

statements.chinese: 它是一个小的蓝色箱子，上面有拉链。
statements.english: It's a small blue case and it's got a zip.

statements.chinese: 把手上有一个标签，上面有我的姓名和地址。
statements.english: There's a label on the handle with my name and address on it.

statements.chinese: 这个箱子是您的吗？
statements.english: Is this case yours?

statements.chinese: 不，那不是我的。
statements.english: No, that's not mine.

statements.chinese: 这个呢？
statements.english: What about this one?

statements.chinese: 这个上面有标签。
statements.english: This one's got a label.

statements.chinese: 让我看看。
statements.english: Let me see it.

statements.chinese: 您的姓名和地址是什么？
statements.english: What's your name and address?

statements.chinese: 大卫·霍尔，布里奇街83号。
statements.english: David Hall, 83 Bridge Street.

statements.chinese: 对了。
statements.english: That's right.

statements.chinese: D. N. 霍尔，布里奇街83号。
statements.english: D N Hall, 83 Bridge Street.

statements.chinese: 请付五先令。
statements.english: Five shillings, please.

statements.chinese: 给你。
statements.english: Here you are.

statements.chinese: 谢谢。
statements.english: Thank you.

statements.chinese: 嘿！
statements.english: Hey!

statements.chinese: 怎么了？
statements.english: What's the matter?

statements.chinese: 这个箱子不是我的。
statements.english: This case doesn't belong to me.

statements.chinese: 你给我拿错了箱子。
statements.english: You've given me the wrong case.

statements.chinese: 噢！
statements.english: Oh!

statements.chinese: 怎么了，特德？
statements.english: What's the matter, Ted?

statements.chinese: 我滑倒了，摔下了楼。
statements.english: I slipped and fell downstairs.

statements.chinese: 你伤到自己了吗？
statements.english: Have you hurt yourself?

statements.chinese: 是的，我伤到了。
statements.english: Yes, I have.

statements.chinese: 我想我伤到了背。
statements.english: I think that I've hurt my back.

statements.chinese: 试着站起来。
statements.english: Try and stand up.

statements.chinese: 你能站起来吗？
statements.english: Can you stand up?

statements.chinese: 来，我来帮你。
statements.english: Here, let me help you.

statements.chinese: 对不起，帕特。
statements.english: I'm sorry, Pat.

statements.chinese: 我恐怕站不起来。
statements.english: I'm afraid that I can't get up.

statements.chinese: 我想你最好让医生看看。
statements.english: I think that the doctor had better see you.

statements.chinese: 我给卡特医生打电话。
statements.english: I'll telephone Doctor Carter.

statements.chinese: 医生说他会马上过来。
statements.english: The doctor says that he will come at once.

statements.chinese: 我确信你需要拍X光，特德。
statements.english: I'm sure that you need an X-ray, Ted.

courses.title: Lessons 99–100: Ow
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 17 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 安迪必须去看医生吗？
statements.english: Must Andy go to see the doctor?

statements.chinese: 怎么了，安迪？
statements.english: What's the matter, Andy?

statements.chinese: 我滑了一下，从楼上摔下来了。
statements.english: I slipped and fell downstairs.

statements.chinese: 你摔伤了吗？
statements.english: Have you hurt yourself?

statements.chinese: 是的，我摔伤了。
statements.english: Yes, I have.

statements.chinese: 我想我伤了背。
statements.english: I think that I've hurt my back.

statements.chinese: 试试站起来。
statements.english: Try and stand up.

statements.chinese: 你能站起来吗？
statements.english: Can you stand up?

statements.chinese: 来。
statements.english: Here.

statements.chinese: 我来帮你。
statements.english: Let me help you.

statements.chinese: 对不起，露西。
statements.english: I'm sorry, Lucy.

statements.chinese: 恐怕我站不起来。
statements.english: I'm afraid that I can't get up.

statements.chinese: 我认为你最好去看医生。
statements.english: I think that the doctor had better see you.

statements.chinese: 我给卡特医生打电话。
statements.english: I'll phone Dr. Carter.

statements.chinese: 医生说他马上就来。
statements.english: The doctor says that he will come at once.

statements.chinese: 安迪，我肯定你需要拍X光片。
statements.english: I'm sure that you need an X-ray, Andy.

courses.title: Lessons 101–102: A Card From Jimmy
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 22 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 奶奶收到吉米的明信片似乎很高兴吗？为什么/为什么不？
statements.english: Does grandmother seem pleased to get a card from Jimmy? Why/Why not?

statements.chinese: 请把吉米的明信片读给我听，潘妮。
statements.english: Read Jimmy's card to me please, Penny.

statements.chinese: “我刚到苏格兰，住在青年旅社。”
statements.english: 'I have just arrived in Scotland and I'm staying at a Youth Hostel.'

statements.chinese: 嗯？
statements.english: Eh?

statements.chinese: 他说他刚到苏格兰。
statements.english: He says he's just arrived in Scotland.

statements.chinese: 他说他住在青年旅社。
statements.english: He says he's staying at a Youth Hostel.

statements.chinese: 你知道他是青年旅社协会的成员。
statements.english: You know he's a member of the Y.H.A.

statements.chinese: 什么？
statements.english: The what?

statements.chinese: 青年旅社协会，妈妈。
statements.english: The Y.H.A., Mum.

statements.chinese: 青年旅社协会。
statements.english: The Youth Hostels Association.

statements.chinese: 他还说了些什么？
statements.english: What else does he say?

statements.chinese: “我很快会写信的。
statements.english: 'I'll write a letter soon.

statements.chinese: 希望你们都好。”
statements.english: I hope you are all well.'

statements.chinese: 什么？大声点，潘妮。
statements.english: What? Speak up, Penny.

statements.chinese: 我恐怕听不清你说什么。
statements.english: I'm afraid I can't hear you.

statements.chinese: 他说他很快会写信。
statements.english: He says he'll write a letter soon.

statements.chinese: 他希望我们都好。
statements.english: He hopes we are all well.

statements.chinese: “爱你的，吉米。”
statements.english: 'Love, Jimmy.'

statements.chinese: 就这些吗？
statements.english: Is that all?

statements.chinese: 他没说多少，是吧？
statements.english: He doesn't say very much, does he?

statements.chinese: 他在明信片上写不了很多，妈妈。
statements.english: He can't write very much on a card, Mum.

courses.title: Lessons 103–104: The French Test
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 23 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 考试持续了多长时间？
statements.english: How long did the exam last?

statements.chinese: 考试怎么样，理查德？
statements.english: How was the exam, Richard?

statements.chinese: 不太糟。
statements.english: Not too bad.

statements.chinese: 我想我英语和数学都及格了。
statements.english: I think I passed in English and Mathematics.

statements.chinese: 题目很简单。
statements.english: The questions were very easy.

statements.chinese: 你怎么样，加里？
statements.english: How about you, Gary?

statements.chinese: 英语和数学试卷对我来说都不够简单。
statements.english: The English and Maths papers weren't easy enough for me.

statements.chinese: 我希望我没考砸。
statements.english: I hope I haven't failed.

statements.chinese: 我想我法语没及格。
statements.english: I think I failed the French paper.

statements.chinese: 我能回答十六道题。
statements.english: I could answer sixteen of the questions.

statements.chinese: 它们很简单。
statements.english: They were very easy.

statements.chinese: 但我回答不了剩下的题。
statements.english: But I couldn't answer the rest.

statements.chinese: 它们对我来说太难了。
statements.english: They were too difficult for me.

statements.chinese: 法语考试糟透了，不是吗？
statements.english: French tests are awful, aren't they?

statements.chinese: 我讨厌它们。
statements.english: I hate them.

statements.chinese: 我肯定我得了低分。
statements.english: I'm sure I've got a low mark.

statements.chinese: 哦，振作起来！
statements.english: Oh, cheer up!

statements.chinese: 也许我们考得没那么糟。
statements.english: Perhaps we didn't do too badly.

statements.chinese: 我旁边那个家伙在试卷顶部写了他的名字。
statements.english: The guy next to me wrote his name at the top of the paper.

statements.chinese: 然后呢？
statements.english: Yes?

statements.chinese: 然后他坐在那里看了三个小时！
statements.english: Then he sat there and looked at it for three hours!

statements.chinese: 他一个字也没写！
statements.english: He didn't write a word!

courses.title: Lessons 105–106: Full of Mistakes
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 23 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 桑德拉的礼物是什么？
statements.english: What was Sandra's present?

statements.chinese: 桑德拉在哪里，鲍勃？
statements.english: Where's Sandra, Bob?

statements.chinese: 我找她。
statements.english: I want her.

statements.chinese: 你想和她说话吗？
statements.english: Do you want to speak to her?

statements.chinese: 是的，我想。
statements.english: Yes, I do.

statements.chinese: 我要她到我办公室来。
statements.english: I want her to come to my office.

statements.chinese: 告诉她马上过来。
statements.english: Tell her to come at once.

statements.chinese: 你想见我吗？
statements.english: Did you want to see me?

statements.chinese: 啊，是的，桑德拉。
statements.english: Ah, yes, Sandra.

statements.chinese: 'intelligent'怎么拼写？
statements.english: How do you spell 'intelligent'?

statements.chinese: 你能告诉我吗？
statements.english: Can you tell me?

statements.chinese: I-N-T-E-L-L-I-G-E-N-T。
statements.english: I-N-T-E-L-L-I-G-E-N-T.

statements.chinese: 对了。
statements.english: That's right.

statements.chinese: 你只打了一个'L'。
statements.english: You've typed it with only one 'L'.

statements.chinese: 这封信错误百出。
statements.english: This letter's full of mistakes.

statements.chinese: 我要你再打一遍。
statements.english: I want you to type it again.

statements.chinese: 好的，我会的。
statements.english: Yes, I'll do that.
