statements.chinese: 对此我很抱歉。
statements.english: I'm sorry about that.

statements.chinese: 这是给你的一份小礼物。
statements.english: And here's a little present for you.

statements.chinese: 这是什么？
statements.english: What is it?

statements.chinese: 是本词典。
statements.english: It's a dictionary.

statements.chinese: 我希望它能帮到你。
statements.english: I hope it'll help you.

courses.title: Lessons 107–108: It's Too Small
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 20 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 这位女士想要什么样的连衣裙？
statements.english: What kind of dress does the Lady want?

statements.chinese: 您喜欢这件连衣裙吗，夫人？
statements.english: Do you like this dress, madam?

statements.chinese: 我非常喜欢这个颜色。
statements.english: I like the colour very much.

statements.chinese: 这是一件很漂亮的连衣裙，但它对我来说太小了。
statements.english: It's a lovely dress, but it's too small for me.

statements.chinese: 这件怎么样？
statements.english: What about this one?

statements.chinese: 这是一件漂亮的连衣裙。
statements.english: It's a lovely dress.

statements.chinese: 它很时髦。
statements.english: It's very smart.

statements.chinese: 短裙现在很流行。
statements.english: Short skirts are in fashion now.

statements.chinese: 您想试试吗？
statements.english: Would you like to try it?

statements.chinese: 好的。
statements.english: All right.

statements.chinese: 恐怕这件绿色的连衣裙也对我来说太小了。
statements.english: I'm afraid this green dress is too small for me as well.

statements.chinese: 它比那件蓝色的还要小。
statements.english: It's smaller than the blue one.

statements.chinese: 我也不喜欢这个颜色。
statements.english: I don't like the colour either.

statements.chinese: 它一点都不适合我。
statements.english: It doesn't suit me at all.

statements.chinese: 我觉得那件蓝色的连衣裙更漂亮。
statements.english: I think the blue dress is prettier.

statements.chinese: 您能给我看看另一件蓝色的连衣裙吗？
statements.english: Could you show me another blue dress?

statements.chinese: 我想要一件像那件一样的连衣裙，但它必须是我的尺码。
statements.english: I want a dress like that one, but it must be my size.

statements.chinese: 恐怕我没有更大尺码的连衣裙了。
statements.english: I'm afraid I haven't got a larger dress.

statements.chinese: 这是店里最大尺码的连衣裙了。
statements.english: This is the largest dress in the shop.

courses.title: Lessons 109–110: A Good Idea
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 25 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 简喝咖啡时会吃什么？
statements.english: What does Jane have with her coffee?

statements.chinese: 简，我来煮些咖啡好吗？
statements.english: Shall I make some coffee, Jane?

statements.chinese: 好主意，夏洛特。
statements.english: That's a good idea, Charlotte.

statements.chinese: 咖啡煮好了。
statements.english: It's ready.

statements.chinese: 你要加奶吗？
statements.english: Do you want any milk?

statements.chinese: 请加一点点。
statements.english: Just a little, please.

statements.chinese: 加糖吗？
statements.english: What about some sugar?

statements.chinese: 两小勺？
statements.english: Two teaspoonfuls?

statements.chinese: 不，少一点。
statements.english: No, less than that.

statements.chinese: 请加一勺半。
statements.english: One and a half teaspoonfuls, please.

statements.chinese: 对我来说够了。
statements.english: That's enough for me.

statements.chinese: 真是太好了。
statements.english: That was very nice.

statements.chinese: 你还要再来点吗？
statements.english: Would you like some more?

statements.chinese: 是的，请。
statements.english: Yes, please.

statements.chinese: 我也想抽支烟。
statements.english: I'd like a cigarette, too.

statements.chinese: 我可以来一支吗？
statements.english: May I have one?

statements.chinese: 当然。
statements.english: Of course.

statements.chinese: 我想那个盒子里有几支。
statements.english: I think there are a few in that box.

statements.chinese: 恐怕是空的。
statements.english: I'm afraid it's empty.

statements.chinese: 真可惜！
statements.english: What a pity!

statements.chinese: 没关系。
statements.english: It doesn't matter.

statements.chinese: 那就吃块饼干吧。
statements.english: Have a biscuit instead.

statements.chinese: 多吃少抽！
statements.english: Eat more and smoke less!

statements.chinese: 这是非常好的建议！
statements.english: That's very good advice!

courses.title: Lessons 111–112: The Most Expensive Model
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 21 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 请听录音，然后回答以下问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 弗里斯先生能分期付款买电视吗？具体怎么操作？
statements.english: Can Mr. Frith buy the television on instalments? How does it work?

statements.chinese: 我非常喜欢这台电视机。
statements.english: I like this television very much.

statements.chinese: 它多少钱？
statements.english: How much does it cost?

statements.chinese: 这是店里最贵的型号。
statements.english: It's the most expensive model in the shop.

statements.chinese: 它要五百英镑。
statements.english: It costs five hundred pounds.

statements.chinese: 那对我们来说太贵了。
statements.english: That's too expensive for us.

statements.chinese: 我们付不起那么多钱。
statements.english: We can't afford all that money.

statements.chinese: 这款型号比那款便宜。
statements.english: This model's less expensive than that one.

statements.chinese: 它只要三百英镑。
statements.english: It's only three hundred pounds.

statements.chinese: 但是，当然，它不如那款贵的。
statements.english: But, of course, it's not as good as the expensive one.

statements.chinese: 我不喜欢这款型号。
statements.english: I don't like this model.

statements.chinese: 另一款型号更贵，但物有所值。
statements.english: The other model's more expensive, but it's worth the money.

statements.chinese: 我们可以分期付款买吗？
statements.english: Can we buy it on instalments?

statements.chinese: 当然可以。
statements.english: Of course.
You can pay a deposit of thirty pounds, and then fourteen pounds a month for three years.
statements.chinese: 你可以先付三十英镑定金，然后每月十四英镑，分三年付清。
亲爱的，你喜欢吗？
statements.english: Do you like it, dear?

statements.chinese: 我当然喜欢，但我不喜欢这个价格。
statements.english: I certainly do, but I don't like the price.

statements.chinese: 你总是想要最好的，但我们负担不起。
statements.english: You always want the best, but we can't afford it.

statements.chinese: 有时候你以为自己是百万富翁！
statements.english: Sometimes you think you're a millionaire!

statements.chinese: 百万富翁可不会分期付款买东西！
statements.english: Millionaires don't buy things on instalments!

courses.title: Lessons 113–114: Small Change
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 23 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 谁有零钱？
statements.english: Who has got some small change?

statements.chinese: 请买票！
statements.english: Fares, please!

statements.chinese: 请到特拉法尔加广场。
statements.english: Trafalgar Square, please.

statements.chinese: 对不起，先生。
statements.english: I'm sorry, sir.

statements.chinese: 我没法找开这张十英镑的钞票。
statements.english: I can't change a ten-pound note.

statements.chinese: 你没有零钱吗？
statements.english: Haven't you got any small change?
I've got no small change, I am afraid.
statements.chinese: 我没有零钱，恐怕是这样。
我去问问其他乘客。
statements.english: I'll ask some of the passengers.

statements.chinese: 先生，您有零钱吗？
statements.english: Have you any small change, sir?

statements.chinese: 对不起。
statements.english: I'm sorry.

statements.chinese: 我没有。
statements.english: I've got none.

statements.chinese: 我也没有。
statements.english: I haven't got any either.

statements.chinese: 女士，您能找开这张十英镑的钞票吗？
statements.english: Can you change this ten-pound note, madam?

statements.chinese: 恐怕我不能。
statements.english: I'm afraid I can't.

statements.chinese: 我也不能。
statements.english: Neither can I.

statements.chinese: 我非常抱歉，先生。
statements.english: I'm very sorry, sir.

statements.chinese: 您必须下车。
statements.english: You must get off the bus.

statements.chinese: 我们没有一个乘客能找开这张钞票。
statements.english: None of our passengers can change this note.

statements.chinese: 他们都是百万富翁！
statements.english: They're all millionaires!

statements.chinese: 除了我们。
statements.english: Except us.

statements.chinese: 我有一些零钱。
statements.english: I've got some small change.

statements.chinese: 我也有。
statements.english: So have I.

courses.title: Lessons 115–116: Knock, Knock
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 25 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 吉姆喝什么？
statements.english: What does Jim have to drink?

statements.chinese: 家里没人吗？
statements.english: Isn't there anyone at home?

statements.chinese: 海伦，我再敲一次。
statements.english: I'll knock again, Helen.

statements.chinese: 一切都很安静。
statements.english: Everything's very quiet.

statements.chinese: 我确信家里没人。
statements.english: I'm sure there's no one at home.

statements.chinese: 但那不可能。
statements.english: But that's impossible.

statements.chinese: 卡罗尔和汤姆邀请我们吃午饭。
statements.english: Carol and Tom invited us to lunch.

statements.chinese: 看看窗户。
statements.english: Look through the window.

statements.chinese: 你能看到什么吗？
statements.english: Can you see anything?

statements.chinese: 什么都没有。
statements.english: Nothing at all.

statements.chinese: 我们试试后门吧。
statements.english: Let's try the back door.

statements.chinese: 看！大家都在花园里。
statements.english: Look! Everyone's in the garden.

statements.chinese: 大家都想在花园里吃午饭。
statements.english: Everybody wants to have lunch in the garden.

statements.chinese: 这里又好又暖和。
statements.english: It's nice and warm out here.

statements.chinese: 来喝点什么吧。
statements.english: Come and have something to drink.

statements.chinese: 谢谢，卡罗尔。
statements.english: Thanks, Carol.

statements.chinese: 请给我一杯啤酒好吗？
statements.english: May I have a glass of beer please?

statements.chinese: 啤酒？
statements.english: Beer?

statements.chinese: 没剩下了。
statements.english: There's none left.

statements.chinese: 你可以喝些柠檬水。
statements.english: You can have some lemonade.

statements.chinese: 柠檬水！
statements.english: Lemonade!

statements.chinese: 别信她，吉姆。
statements.english: Don't believe her, Jim.

statements.chinese: 她只是开玩笑。
statements.english: She's only joking.

statements.chinese: 喝点啤酒！
statements.english: Have some beer!

courses.title: Lessons 117–118: Tommy's Breakfast
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 12 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 在最后一句话中，她说的“零钱”是什么意思？
statements.english: What does she mean by 'change' in the last sentence?
When my husband was going into the dining room this morning, he dropped some coins on the floor.
statements.chinese: 今天早上我丈夫走进饭厅时，他把一些硬币掉在地板上了。
到处都是硬币。
statements.english: There were coins everywhere.

statements.chinese: 我们找了找，但没有把它们全都找到。
statements.english: We looked for them, but we could not find them all.
While we were having breakfast, our little boy, Tommy, found two small coins on the floor.
statements.chinese: 我们吃早饭的时候，我们的小儿子汤米在地板上找到了两枚小硬币。
他把两枚硬币都放进了嘴里。
statements.english: He put them both into his mouth.

statements.chinese: 我们俩都想把硬币拿出来，但是太晚了。
statements.english: We both tried to get the coins, but it was too late.

statements.chinese: 汤米已经把它们吞下去了！
statements.english: Tommy had already swallowed them!
Late that morning, when I was doing the housework, My husband phoned me from the office.
statements.chinese: 早上晚些时候，我正在做家务时，我丈夫从办公室给我打了个电话。
“汤米怎么样了？”他问。
statements.english: 'How's Tommy?' he asked.
'I don't know,' I answered, 'Tommy's been to the toilet three times this morning, but I haven't had any change yet!'
statements.chinese: “我不知道，”我回答说，“今天上午汤米已经上过三次厕所了，但我还没见到有任何‘零钱’呢！”

courses.title: Lessons 119–120: A True Story
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 18 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 谁在黑暗中对窃贼叫喊？
statements.english: Who called out to the thieves in the dark?

statements.chinese: 你喜欢故事吗？
statements.english: Do you like stories?

statements.chinese: 我想给你讲一个真实的故事。
statements.english: I want to tell you a true story.

statements.chinese: 一年前，它发生在我的一位朋友身上。
statements.english: It happened to a friend of mine a year ago.
While my friend, George, was reading in bed, two thieves climbed into his kitchen.
statements.chinese: 我的朋友乔治正在床上看书时，两个窃贼爬进了他的厨房。

statements.english: After they had entered the house, they went into the dining room.
statements.chinese: 他们进入房子后，他们去了饭厅。
天很黑，所以他们打开了一个手电筒。
statements.english: It was very dark, so they turned on a torch.

statements.chinese: 突然，他们听到身后有个声音。
statements.english: Suddenly, they heard a voice behind them.

statements.chinese: “怎么了？怎么了？”有人叫道。
statements.english: 'What's up? What's up?' someone called.

statements.chinese: 窃贼们扔下手电筒，尽可能快地跑走了。
statements.english: The thieves dropped the torch and ran away as quickly as they could.

statements.chinese: 乔治听到响声，迅速下了楼。
statements.english: George heard the noise and came downstairs quickly.

statements.chinese: 他打开灯，但没看到任何人。
statements.english: He turned on the light, but he couldn't see anyone.

statements.chinese: 窃贼们已经走了。
statements.english: The thieves had already gone.

statements.chinese: 但乔治的鹦鹉亨利还在那儿。
statements.english: But George's parrot, Henry, was still there.

statements.chinese: “怎么了，乔治？”它叫道。
statements.english: What's up, George? he called.

statements.chinese: “没什么，亨利，”乔治说着笑了。
statements.english: 'Nothing, Henry,' George said and smiled.

statements.chinese: “回去睡觉吧。”
statements.english: 'Go back to sleep.'

courses.title: Lessons 121–122: The Man in a Hat
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 18 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 为什么卡罗琳没有立刻认出这位顾客？
statements.english: Why didn't Caroline recognize the customer straight away?

statements.chinese: 半小时前我在这儿买了词典，可是我忘记把它们带走了。
statements.english: I bought two expensive dictionaries here half an hour ago, but I forgot to take them with me.

statements.chinese: 是谁为您服务的，先生？
statements.english: Who served you, sir?

statements.chinese: 是那位站在柜台后面的女士。
statements.english: The lady who is standing behind the counter.

statements.chinese: 您买的是哪些书？
statements.english: Which books did you buy?

statements.chinese: 是柜台上的那些书。
statements.english: The books which are on the counter.

statements.chinese: 半小时前你为这位先生服务过吗，卡罗琳？
statements.english: Did you serve this gentleman half an hour ago, Caroline?

statements.chinese: 他说他就是买这些书的人。
statements.english: He says he's the man who bought these books.

statements.chinese: 我记不起来了。
statements.english: I can't remember.

statements.chinese: 我为之服务的那个人戴着一顶帽子。
statements.english: The man who I served was wearing a hat.

statements.chinese: 您有帽子吗，先生？
statements.english: Have you got a hat, sir?

statements.chinese: 是的，我有。
statements.english: Yes, I have.

statements.chinese: 请您戴上好吗？
statements.english: Would you put it on, please?

statements.chinese: 好的。
statements.english: All right.

statements.chinese: 卡罗琳，这就是您为之服务过的那个人吗？
statements.english: Is this the man that you served, Caroline?

statements.chinese: 是的。
statements.english: Yes.

statements.chinese: 我现在认出他了。
statements.english: I recognize him now.

courses.title: Lessons 123–124: A Trip to Australia
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 23 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 留胡子的男人是谁？
statements.english: Who is the man with the beard?

statements.chinese: 瞧，斯科特。
statements.english: Look, Scott.

statements.chinese: 这是我澳大利亚之行时拍的照片。
statements.english: This is a photograph I took during my trip to Australia.

statements.chinese: 让我看看，迈克。
statements.english: Let me see it, Mike.

statements.chinese: 这张照片拍得不错。
statements.english: This is a good photograph.

statements.chinese: 这些人是谁？
statements.english: Who are these people?

statements.chinese: 他们是我旅行中遇到的人。
statements.english: They're people I met during the trip.

statements.chinese: 那是我们乘坐的船。
statements.english: That's the ship we travelled on.

statements.chinese: 多么漂亮的船啊！
statements.english: What a beautiful ship!

statements.chinese: 这是谁？
statements.english: Who's this?

statements.chinese: 这就是我告诉过你的那个人。
statements.english: That's the man I told you about.

statements.chinese: 记得吗？
statements.english: Remember?

statements.chinese: 哦，是的。
statements.english: Ah yes.

statements.chinese: 就是那个在澳大利亚给你提供工作的人。
statements.english: The one who offered you a job in Australia.

statements.chinese: 对了。
statements.english: That's right.

statements.chinese: 这是谁？
statements.english: Who's this?

statements.chinese: 猜猜看！
statements.english: Guess!

statements.chinese: 不是你吧？
statements.english: It's not you, is it?

statements.chinese: 对了。
statements.english: That's right.

statements.chinese: 旅行期间我留了胡子，但回家后就刮掉了。
statements.english: I grew a beard during the trip, but I shaved it off when I came home.

statements.chinese: 你为什么要刮掉它？
statements.english: Why did you shave it off?

statements.chinese: 我妻子不喜欢！
statements.english: My wife didn't like it!

courses.title: Lessons 125–126: Tea for Two
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 22 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 苏珊独自一人喝茶吗？
statements.english: Does Susan have tea by herself?

statements.chinese: 彼得，你现在不能进来喝茶吗？
statements.english: Can't you come in and have tea now, Peter?

statements.chinese: 还不能。
statements.english: Not yet.

statements.chinese: 我必须先浇花园。
statements.english: I must water the garden first.

statements.chinese: 你现在非浇不可吗？
statements.english: Do you have to water it now?

statements.chinese: 恐怕非浇不可。
statements.english: I'm afraid I must.

statements.chinese: 你瞧！
statements.english: Look at it!

statements.chinese: 干得厉害。
statements.english: It's terribly dry.

statements.chinese: 真讨厌！
statements.english: What a nuisance!

statements.chinese: 去年夏天也是很干。
statements.english: Last summer it was very dry, too.

statements.chinese: 你不记得了吗？
statements.english: Don't you remember?

statements.chinese: 我不得不每天浇水。
statements.english: I had to water it every day.

statements.chinese: 哎，我一个人喝茶了。
statements.english: Well, I'll have tea by myself.

statements.chinese: 真快！
statements.english: That was quick!

statements.chinese: 你已经浇完了吗？
statements.english: Have you finished already?

statements.chinese: 是的。
statements.english: Yes.

statements.chinese: 你往窗外看。
statements.english: Look out of the window.

statements.chinese: 下雨了！
statements.english: It's raining!

statements.chinese: 这意味着你不用浇花园了。
statements.english: That means you don't need to water the garden.

statements.chinese: 这真是个意外的惊喜。
statements.english: That was a pleasant surprise.

statements.chinese: 这意味着我可以去喝茶了。
statements.english: It means I can have tea, instead.

courses.title: Lessons 127–128: A Famous Actress
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 23 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 谁才29岁？为什么这点不清楚？
statements.english: Who is only twenty-nine, and why is it so unclear?

statements.chinese: 莉兹，你认得出那个女人吗？
statements.english: Can you recognize that woman, Liz?

statements.chinese: 我想我认得，凯特。
statements.english: I think I can, Kate.

statements.chinese: 她肯定是女演员卡伦·马什。
statements.english: It must be Karen Marsh, the actress.

statements.chinese: 我也这么想。
statements.english: I thought so.

statements.chinese: 她旁边的那个人是谁？
statements.english: Who's that beside her?

statements.chinese: 那肯定是康拉德·里夫斯。
statements.english: That must be Conrad Reeves.

statements.chinese: 演员康拉德·里夫斯？
statements.english: Conrad Reeves, the actor?

statements.chinese: 不可能。
statements.english: It can't be.

statements.chinese: 我再看看。
statements.english: Let me have another look.

statements.chinese: 我想你是对的！
statements.english: I think you're right!

statements.chinese: 他不是她的第三任丈夫吗？
statements.english: Isn't he her third husband?

statements.chinese: 不。
statements.english: No.

statements.chinese: 他肯定是她的第四任或第五任丈夫。
statements.english: He must be her fourth or fifth.

statements.chinese: 卡伦·马什看起来真老啊！
statements.english: Doesn't Karen Marsh look old!

statements.chinese: 是啊，她看起来确实老！
statements.english: She does, doesn't she!

statements.chinese: 我读到她29岁，但她至少有40岁了。
statements.english: I read she's twenty-nine, but she must be at least forty.

statements.chinese: 我敢肯定她是。
statements.english: I'm sure she is.

statements.chinese: 我还在上学的时候，她就是一位著名的女演员了。
statements.english: She was a famous actress when I was still at school.

statements.chinese: 那是很久以前的事了，不是吗？
statements.english: That was a long time ago, wasn't it?

statements.chinese: 没那么久！
statements.english: Not that long ago!

statements.chinese: 我自己也不超过29岁。
statements.english: I'm not more than twenty-nine myself.

courses.title: Lessons 129–130: Seventy Miles an Hour
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 24 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 安建议她丈夫下次做什么？
statements.english: What does Ann advise her husband to do next time?

statements.chinese: 瞧，加里！
statements.english: Look, Gary!

statements.chinese: 那个警察在向你招手。
statements.english: That policeman's waving to you.

statements.chinese: 他要你停车。
statements.english: He wants you to stop.

statements.chinese: 你以为你在哪里？
statements.english: Where do you think you are?

statements.chinese: 在赛车场上吗？
statements.english: On a race track?

statements.chinese: 你刚才一定是以每小时七十英里的速度行驶。
statements.english: You must have been driving at seventy miles an hour.

statements.chinese: 我不可能开那么快。
statements.english: I can't have been.

statements.chinese: 我超过你的时候，我开的是八十。
statements.english: I was doing eighty when I overtook you.

statements.chinese: 你没看到限速标志吗？
statements.english: Didn't you see the speed limit?

statements.chinese: 恐怕我没有，警官。
statements.english: I'm afraid I didn't, officer.

statements.chinese: 我当时一定是在做梦。
statements.english: I must have been dreaming.

statements.chinese: 他没在做梦，警官。
statements.english: He wasn't dreaming, officer.

statements.chinese: 我当时正在叫他慢点开。
statements.english: I was telling him to drive slowly.

statements.chinese: 那就是我没看到标志的原因。
statements.english: That's why I didn't see the sign.

statements.chinese: 让我看看你的驾照。
statements.english: Let me see your driving licence.

statements.chinese: 这次我不罚你。
statements.english: I won't charge you this time.

statements.chinese: 但你最好别再犯了！
statements.english: But you'd better not do it again!

statements.chinese: 谢谢你。
statements.english: Thank you.

statements.chinese: 我一定会更小心的。
statements.english: I'll certainly be more careful.

statements.chinese: 我叫你慢点开的，加里。
statements.english: I told you to drive slowly, Gary.

statements.chinese: 你总是叫我慢点开，亲爱的。
statements.english: You always tell me to drive slowly, darling.

statements.chinese: 嗯，下次你最好听我的劝告！
statements.english: Well, next time you'd better take my advice!

courses.title: Lessons 131–132: Don't be So Sure
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 20 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 决定度假有什么问题？
statements.english: What's the problem about deciding on a holiday?

statements.chinese: 盖瑞，今年你打算去哪儿度假？
statements.english: Where are you going to spend your holidays this year, Gary?

statements.chinese: 我们可能会出国。
statements.english: We may go abroad.

statements.chinese: 我不确定。
statements.english: I'm not sure.

statements.chinese: 我妻子想去埃及。
statements.english: My wife wants to go to Egypt.

statements.chinese: 我也想去那儿。
statements.english: I'd like to go there, too.

statements.chinese: 我们拿不定主意。
statements.english: We can't make up our minds.

statements.chinese: 你们是坐船去还是坐飞机去？
statements.english: Will you travel by sea or by air?

statements.chinese: 我们可能会坐船去。
statements.english: We may travel by sea.

statements.chinese: 坐船便宜些，不是吗？
statements.english: It's cheaper, isn't it?

statements.chinese: 也许便宜些，但要花很多时间。
statements.english: It may be cheaper, but it takes a long time.

statements.chinese: 我相信你们会玩得开心的。
statements.english: I'm sure you'll enjoy yourselves.

statements.chinese: 我们可能哪儿都去不了。
statements.english: We might not go anywhere.

statements.chinese: 我妻子总是忧虑太多。
statements.english: My wife always worries too much.

statements.chinese: 谁来照看狗呢？
statements.english: Who's going to look after the dog?

statements.chinese: 谁来照看房子呢？
statements.english: Who's going to look after the house?

statements.chinese: 谁来照看花园呢？
statements.english: Who's going to look after the garden?

statements.chinese: 我们每年都有这个问题。
statements.english: We have this problem every year.

statements.chinese: 结果，我们待在家里照看一切！
statements.english: In the end, we stay at home and look after everything!

courses.title: Lessons 133–134: Sensational News
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 20 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 凯伦·马什给出哪些理由想要退休？
statements.english: What reasons did Karen Marsh give for wanting to retire?

statements.chinese: 马什小姐，您刚拍了一部新电影吗？
statements.english: Have you just made a new film, Miss Marsh?

statements.chinese: 是的，我拍了。
statements.english: Yes, I have.

statements.chinese: 您还要再拍一部吗？
statements.english: Are you going to make another?

statements.chinese: 不，我不拍了。
statements.english: No, I'm not.

statements.chinese: 我要退休了。
statements.english: I'm going to retire.

statements.chinese: 我觉得很累。
statements.english: I feel very tired.

statements.chinese: 我很长时间都不想再拍电影了。
statements.english: I don't want to make another film for a long time.

statements.chinese: 丽兹，我们买份报纸吧。
statements.english: Let's buy a newspaper, Liz.

statements.chinese: 听听这个！
statements.english: Listen to this!

statements.chinese: “凯伦·马什：轰动新闻！
statements.english: 'Karen Marsh: Sensational News!

statements.chinese: 记者：艾伦·琼斯。
statements.english: By our reporter, Alan Jones.

statements.chinese: 凯伦·马什今天抵达伦敦机场。
statements.english: Karen Marsh arrived at London Airport today.

statements.chinese: 她穿着一件蓝色连衣裙和一件貂皮大衣。
statements.english: She was wearing a blue dress and a mink coat.

statements.chinese: 她告诉我她刚拍了一部新电影。
statements.english: She told me she had just made a new film.

statements.chinese: 她说她不会再拍了。
statements.english: she said she was not going to make another.

statements.chinese: 她说她要退休了。
statements.english: She said she was going to retire.

statements.chinese: 她告诉记者她感到非常疲倦，并且很长时间都不想再拍电影了。”
statements.english: She told reporters she felt very tired and didn't want to make another film for a long time.'

statements.chinese: 我想知道为什么！
statements.english: I wonder why!

courses.title: Lessons 135–136: The Latest Report
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 23 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 你认为卡伦·马什会退休吗？
statements.english: Is Karen Marsh going to retire, do you think?

statements.chinese: 马什小姐，您真的要退休了吗？
statements.english: Are you really going to retire, Miss Marsh?

statements.chinese: 我可能会。
statements.english: I may.

statements.chinese: 我还没下定决心。
statements.english: I can't make up my mind.

statements.chinese: 我得问问我未来的丈夫。
statements.english: I will have to ask my future husband.

statements.chinese: 他不会让我再拍电影了。
statements.english: He won't let me make another film.

statements.chinese: 您未来的丈夫？马什小姐？
statements.english: Your future husband, Miss Marsh?

statements.chinese: 是的。
statements.english: Yes.

statements.chinese: 让我把他介绍给你们。
statements.english: Let me introduce him to you.

statements.chinese: 他叫卡洛斯。
statements.english: His name is Carlos.

statements.chinese: 我们下周结婚。
statements.english: We're going to get married next week.

statements.chinese: 看，莉兹！
statements.english: Look, Liz!

statements.chinese: 这是关于卡伦·马什的另一篇报道。
statements.english: Here's another report about Karen Marsh.

statements.chinese: 听着：“卡伦·马什：最新报道。
statements.english: Listen: 'Karen Marsh: The latest.

statements.chinese: 今天，马什小姐在伦敦的饭店告诉记者，她可能会退休。
statements.english: At her London Hotel today Miss Marsh told reporters she might retire.

statements.chinese: 她说她还没下定决心。
statements.english: She said she couldn't make up her mind.

statements.chinese: 她说她得问问她未来的丈夫。
statements.english: She said she would have to ask her future husband.

statements.chinese: 她说她未来的丈夫不会让她再拍电影了。
statements.english: She said her future husband would not let her make another film.

statements.chinese: 然后她把卡洛斯介绍给我们，并告诉我们他们下周结婚。”
statements.english: Then she introduced us to Carlos and told us they would get married next week.'

statements.chinese: 这真是个爆炸性新闻，不是吗，凯特？
statements.english: That's sensational news, isn't it, Kate?

statements.chinese: 当然是。
statements.english: It certainly is.

statements.chinese: 他将是她的第六任丈夫！
statements.english: He'll be her sixth husband!

courses.title: Lessons 137–138: A Pleasant Dream
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 18 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 如果有钱，朱莉想做什么？
statements.english: What would Julie like to do, if she had the money?

statements.chinese: 布莱恩，你在填写足球彩票吗？
statements.english: Are you doing the football pools, Brain?

statements.chinese: 是的，我快填完了，朱莉。
statements.english: Yes, I've nearly finished, Julie.

statements.chinese: 我相信这星期我们一定会中奖。
statements.english: I'm sure we'll win something this week.

statements.chinese: 你总是那么说，可我们从来没中过奖！
statements.english: You always say that, but we never win anything!

statements.chinese: 如果你赢了许多钱，你准备做什么？
statements.english: What will you do if you win a lot of money?

statements.chinese: 如果我赢了许多钱，我给你买件貂皮大衣。
statements.english: If I win a lot of money I'll buy you a mink coat.

statements.chinese: 我不想要貂皮大衣！
statements.english: I don't want a mink coat!

statements.chinese: 我想去周游世界。
statements.english: I want to see the world.

statements.chinese: 好吧。
statements.english: All right.

statements.chinese: 如果我们赢了许多钱，我们就周游世界，住最好的宾馆。
statements.english: If we win a lot of money we'll travel round the world and we'll stay at the best hotels.

statements.chinese: 然后我们回家，在乡下买幢大房子。
statements.english: Then we'll return home and buy a big house in the country.

statements.chinese: 我们要有一个漂亮的花园，还有……
statements.english: We'll have a beautiful garden and...

statements.chinese: 可是，如果我们把钱都花光了，我们不又会变穷吗？
statements.english: But if we spend all that money we'll be poor again.

statements.chinese: 那时我们怎么办呢？
statements.english: What'll we do then?

statements.chinese: 如果我们把钱都花光了，我们再争取赢一次足球彩票。
statements.english: If we spend all the money we'll try and win the football pools again.

statements.chinese: 这是个美梦，但一切都取决于“如果”！
statements.english: It's a pleasant dream but everything depends on 'if' !

courses.title: Lessons 139–140: Is That You, John
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 19 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 格雷厄姆·特纳认为他正在和哪位约翰·史密斯通话？
statements.english: Which John Smith does Graham Turner think he is talking to?

statements.chinese: 是的，我就是。
statements.english: Yes, speaking.

statements.chinese: 告诉玛丽，我们今晚晚饭会迟到。
statements.english: Tell Mary we'll be late for dinner this evening.

statements.chinese: 恐怕我不明白。
statements.english: I'm afraid I don't understand.

statements.chinese: 玛丽没告诉你吗？
statements.english: Hasn't Mary told you?

statements.chinese: 她邀请夏洛特和我今晚吃饭。
statements.english: She invited Charlotte and me to dinner this evening.

statements.chinese: 我说我六点钟会到你家，但老板要我加班。
statements.english: I said I would be at your house at six o'clock, but the boss wants me to do some extra work.

statements.chinese: 我得留在办公室。
statements.english: I'll have to stay at the office.

statements.chinese: 我不知道什么时候能完。
statements.english: I don't know when I'll finish.

statements.chinese: 哦，顺便说一下，我妻子想知道玛丽是否需要帮忙。
statements.english: Oh, and by the way, my wife wants to know if Mary needs any help.

statements.chinese: 我不知道你在说什么。
statements.english: I don't know what you're talking about.

statements.chinese: 你是约翰·史密斯，对吗？
statements.english: That is John Smith, isn't it?

statements.chinese: 是的，我就是约翰·史密斯。
statements.english: Yes, I'm John Smith.

statements.chinese: 你是工程师约翰·史密斯，对吗？
statements.english: You are John Smith, the engineer, aren't you?

statements.chinese: 没错。
statements.english: That's right.

statements.chinese: 你在海外工程公司工作，对吗？
statements.english: You work for the Overseas Engineering Company, don't you?

statements.chinese: 不，我不是。
statements.english: No, I don't.

statements.chinese: 我是电话工程师约翰·史密斯，我正在修理你的电话线。
statements.english: I'm John Smith the telephone engineer and I'm repairing your telephone line.

courses.title: Lessons 141–142: Sally's First Train Ride
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 17 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 妈妈为什么感到难为情？
statements.english: Why was the mother embarrassed?

statements.chinese: 上周，我四岁的女儿萨莉应邀参加了一个儿童聚会。
statements.english: Last week, my four-year-old daughter, Sally, was invited to a children's party.

statements.chinese: 我决定带她坐火车去。
statements.english: I decided to take her by train.

statements.chinese: 萨莉非常兴奋，因为她以前从未坐过火车。
statements.english: Sally was very excited because she had never travelled on a train before.

statements.chinese: 她坐在窗边，对看到的一切都问个不停。
statements.english: She sat near the window and asked questions about everything she saw.

statements.chinese: 突然，一位中年妇女上了火车，坐在萨莉对面。
statements.english: Suddenly, a middle-age lady got on the train and sat opposite Sally.

statements.chinese: “你好，小姑娘。”她说。
statements.english: 'Hello, little girl,' she said.

statements.chinese: 萨莉没有回答，只是好奇地看着她。
statements.english: Sally did not answer, but looked at her curiously.

statements.chinese: 那位女士穿着一件蓝色外套，戴着一顶又大又滑稽的帽子。
statements.english: The lady was dressed in a blue coat and a large, funny hat.

statements.chinese: 火车离开车站后，那位女士打开手提包，拿出她的粉饼盒。
statements.english: After the train had left the station, the lady opened her handbag and took out her powder compact.

statements.chinese: 然后她开始化妆。
statements.english: She then began to make up her face.

statements.chinese: “你为什么要那样做？”萨莉问道。
statements.english: 'Why are you doing that?' Sally asked.

statements.chinese: “为了让自己变漂亮。”那位女士回答。
statements.english: 'To make myself beautiful,' the lady answered.

statements.chinese: 她收起粉饼盒，和蔼地笑了笑。
statements.english: She put away her compact and smiled kindly.

statements.chinese: “但你还是很难看。”萨莉说。
statements.english: 'But you are still ugly,' Sally said.

statements.chinese: 萨莉觉得很有趣，但我却感到非常难为情！
statements.english: Sally was amused, but I was very embarrassed!

courses.title: Lessons 143–144: A Walk Through the Woods
courses.description: 新概念英语第一册 · 12 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
statements.english: Listen to the tape then answer this question.

statements.chinese: 牌子上的字有什么好笑的？
statements.english: What was so funny about the words on the sign?

statements.chinese: 我住在一个非常古老的小镇，它被美丽的树林环绕着。
statements.english: I live in a very old town which is surrounded by beautiful woods.

statements.chinese: 这是一个著名的风景区。
statements.english: It is a famous beauty spot.

statements.chinese: 每到星期天，成百上千的人从城里赶来参观我们的小镇，并在树林中散步。
statements.english: On Sundays, hundreds of people come from the city to see our town and to walk through the woods.

statements.chinese: 游客们被要求保持树林的清洁整齐。
statements.english: Visitors have been asked to keep the woods clean and tidy.

statements.chinese: 树下放置了垃圾筐，但人们仍然随处乱扔垃圾。
statements.english: Litter baskets have been placed under the trees, but people still throw their rubbish everywhere.

statements.chinese: 上个星期三，我到树林里散步。
statements.english: Last Wednesday, I went for a walk in the woods.

statements.chinese: 我看到的一切让我很难过。
statements.english: What I saw made me very sad.

statements.chinese: 我数出了七辆旧汽车和三台旧冰箱。
statements.english: I counted seven old cars and three old refrigerators.
The little baskets were empty and the ground was covered with pieces of paper, cigarette ends, old tyres, empty bottles and rusty tins.
statements.chinese: 那些垃圾筐都是空的，地上却铺满了碎纸片，烟头、旧轮胎、空瓶子和生锈的罐头盒。
在这些垃圾中，我发现了一个牌子，上面写着：“凡在此树林中乱扔垃圾者，将受到起诉！”
statements.english: Among the rubbish, I found a sign which said, 'Anyone who leaves litter in these woods will be prosecuted!'

packs.title: 新概念英语第二册
packs.description: 获授权教材课程 · 实践与进步 · 96 课

courses.title: Lesson 1: A Private Conversation
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 17 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 作者为什么要向他身后的人抱怨？
statements.english: Why did the writer complain to the people behind him?

statements.chinese: 上周我去了剧院。
statements.english: Last week I went to the theatre.

statements.chinese: 我有一个很好的座位。
statements.english: I had a very good seat.

statements.chinese: 戏很有趣。
statements.english: The play was very interesting.

statements.chinese: 我却没有享受到乐趣。
statements.english: I did not enjoy it.

statements.chinese: 一对年轻的男女坐在我身后。
statements.english: A young man and a young woman were sitting behind me.

statements.chinese: 他们大声地说着话。
statements.english: They were talking loudly.

statements.chinese: 我非常生气。
statements.english: I got very angry.

statements.chinese: 我听不见演员的讲话。
statements.english: I could not hear the actors.

statements.chinese: 我转过身。
statements.english: I turned round.

statements.chinese: 我怒气冲冲地看着那一男一女。
statements.english: I looked at the man and the woman angrily.

statements.chinese: 他们却不理不睬。
statements.english: They did not pay any attention.

statements.chinese: 最后，我忍不住了。
statements.english: In the end, I could not bear it.

statements.chinese: 我又转过身去。
statements.english: I turned round again.

statements.chinese: “我一个字也听不见了！”我生气地说。
statements.english: 'I can't hear a word!' I said angrily.
'It's none of your business,' the young man said rudely.
statements.chinese: “不关你的事，”那个年轻人粗鲁地说。
“这是私人谈话！”
statements.english: 'This is a private conversation!'

courses.title: Lesson 2: Breakfast or Lunch
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 19 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 作家的阿姨为什么感到惊讶？
statements.english: Why was the writer's aunt surprised?

statements.chinese: 那是星期天。
statements.english: It was Sunday.

statements.chinese: 我星期天从不起早。
statements.english: I never get up early on Sundays.

statements.chinese: 我有时会一直睡到午饭时间。
statements.english: I sometimes stay in bed until lunchtime.

statements.chinese: 上个星期天我起得很晚。
statements.english: Last Sunday I got up very late.

statements.chinese: 我向窗外望去。
statements.english: I looked out of the window.

statements.chinese: 外面天很黑。
statements.english: It was dark outside.

statements.chinese: “这是什么天气啊！”我想。
statements.english: 'What a day!' I thought.

statements.chinese: “又下雨了。”
statements.english: 'It's raining again.'

statements.chinese: 就在那时，电话响了。
statements.english: Just then, the telephone rang.

statements.chinese: 是我的露西姨妈。
statements.english: It was my aunt Lucy.

statements.chinese: 她说：“我刚乘火车到了。”
statements.english: 'I've just arrived by train,' she said.

statements.chinese: “我要来看你。”
statements.english: 'I'm coming to see you.'

statements.chinese: “可是我还在吃早饭呢。”我说。
statements.english: 'But I'm still having breakfast,' I said.

statements.chinese: 她问：“你在做什么？”
statements.english: 'What are you doing?' she asked.

statements.chinese: “我在吃早饭。”我重复道。
statements.english: 'I'm having breakfast,' I repeated.

statements.chinese: “哎呀！”她说。
statements.english: 'Dear me,' she said.

statements.chinese: “你总是起这么晚吗？
statements.english: 'Do you always get up so late?

statements.chinese: 已经一点钟了！”
statements.english: It's one o'clock!'

courses.title: Lesson 3: Please Send Me a Card
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 12 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 作者寄了多少张明信片？
statements.english: How many cards did the writer send?

statements.chinese: 明信片总是破坏我的假期。
statements.english: Postcards always spoil my holidays.

statements.chinese: 去年夏天，我去了意大利。
statements.english: Last summer, I went to Italy.

statements.chinese: 我参观了博物馆，并坐在公共花园里。
statements.english: I visited museums and sat in public gardens.

statements.chinese: 一位友好的服务员教了我几句意大利语。
statements.english: A friendly waiter taught me a few words of Italian.

statements.chinese: 然后他借给我一本书。
statements.english: Then he lent me a book.

statements.chinese: 我读了几行，但一个字也看不懂。
statements.english: I read a few lines, but I did not understand a word.

statements.chinese: 每天我都想着明信片。
statements.english: Everyday I thought about postcards.
My holidays passed quickly, but I did not send cards to my friends.
statements.chinese: 我的假期过得很快，但我没有给朋友们寄明信片。
在最后一天，我做了一个重大决定。
statements.english: On the last day I made a big decision.

statements.chinese: 我起得很早，买了三十七张明信片。
statements.english: I got up early and bought thirty-seven cards.
I spent the whole day in my room, but I did not write a single card!
statements.chinese: 我在房间里待了一整天，但我一张明信片也没写！

courses.title: Lesson 4: An Exciting Trip
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 10 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 蒂姆为什么觉得这次旅行令人兴奋？
statements.english: Why is Tim finding this trip exciting?

statements.chinese: 我刚收到我哥哥蒂姆的一封信。
statements.english: I have just received a letter from my brother, Tim.

statements.chinese: 他在澳大利亚。
statements.english: He is in Australia.

statements.chinese: 他在那里已经六个月了。
statements.english: He has been there for six months.

statements.chinese: 蒂姆是一名工程师。
statements.english: Tim is an engineer.
He is working for a big firm and he has already visited a great number of different places in Australia.
statements.chinese: 他在一家大公司工作，并且他已经参观了澳大利亚的许多不同地方。

statements.english: He has just bought an Australian car and has gone to Alice Springs, a small town in the centre of Australia.
statements.chinese: 他刚买了一辆澳大利亚汽车，然后去了爱丽丝泉，一个位于澳大利亚中部的小镇。
他很快将参观达尔文。
statements.english: He will soon visit Darwin.

statements.chinese: 从那里，他将飞往珀斯。
statements.english: From there, he will fly to Perth.
My brother has never been abroad before, so he is finding this trip very exciting.
statements.chinese: 我哥哥以前从未出过国，所以他觉得这次旅行非常令人兴奋。

courses.title: Lesson 5: No Wrong Numbers
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 8 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 詹姆斯·斯科特先生在西尔伯里有一家车库。
statements.english: Mr James Scott has a garage in Silverbury.

statements.chinese: 现在他又在平赫斯特购买了另一家车库。
statements.english: And now he has just bought another garage in Pinherst.
Pinherst is only five miles from Silverbury, but Mr Scott cannot get a telephone for his new garage.
statements.chinese: 平赫斯特距离西尔伯里只有五英里，可是斯科特先生无法为他的新车库安装电话。
因此他刚刚买了12只鸽子。
statements.english: So he has just bought 12 pigeons.

statements.chinese: 昨天，一只鸽子把第一封信从平赫斯特带到了西尔伯里。
statements.english: Yesterday, a pigeon carried the first message from Pinherst to Silverbury.

statements.chinese: 这只鸟在三分钟内飞完了这段距离。
statements.english: The bird covered the distance in three minutes.

statements.chinese: 到目前为止，斯科特先生已经发出了许多关于备件和其他紧急消息的请求，从一个车库发到另一个车库。
statements.english: Up to now, Mr Scott has sent a great many requests for spare parts and other urgent messages from one garage to the other.

statements.chinese: 这样一来，他就开通了自己的私人电话服务。
statements.english: In this way, he has begun his own private telephone service.

courses.title: Lesson 6: Percy Buttons
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 12 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 谁是珀西·巴顿斯？
statements.english: Who is Percy Buttons?

statements.chinese: 我刚搬到桥街的一所房子里。
statements.english: I have just moved to a house in Bridge Street.

statements.chinese: 昨天一个乞丐敲我的门。
statements.english: Yesterday a beggar knocked at my door.

statements.chinese: 他向我要一顿饭和一杯啤酒。
statements.english: He asked me for a meal and a glass of beer.
In return for this, the beggar stood on his head and sang songs.
statements.chinese: 作为回报，乞丐倒立着唱歌。
我给了他一顿饭。
statements.english: I gave him a meal.

statements.chinese: 他吃了食物，喝了啤酒。
statements.english: He ate the food and drank the beer.

statements.chinese: 然后他把一块奶酪放进口袋里，走了。
statements.english: Then he put a piece of cheese in his pocket and went away.

statements.chinese: 后来一位邻居告诉我关于他的事。
statements.english: Later a neighbour told me about him.

statements.chinese: 每个人都认识他。
statements.english: Everybody knows him.

statements.chinese: 他的名字叫珀西·巴顿斯。
statements.english: His name is Percy Buttons.
He calls at every house in the street once a month and always asks for a meal and a glass of beer.
statements.chinese: 他每个月到街上的每家每户拜访一次并且总是要求一顿饭和一杯啤酒。

courses.title: Lesson 7: Too Late
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 8 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 侦探们保住钻石了吗？
statements.english: Did the detectives save the diamonds?

statements.chinese: 飞机晚点了，侦探们在机场等了一上午。
statements.english: The plane was late and detectives were waiting at the airport all morning.

statements.chinese: 他们正在等一个从南非寄来的贵重钻石包裹。
statements.english: They were expecting a valuable parcel of diamonds from South Africa.
A few hours earlier, someone had told the police that thieves would try to steal the diamonds.
statements.chinese: 几个小时前，有人告诉警方，小偷会设法偷走这些钻石。

statements.english: When the plane arrived, some of the detectives were waiting inside the main building while others were waiting on the airfield.
statements.chinese: 飞机抵达时，一些侦探在主楼里等候，另一些则在机场跑道上等候。

statements.english: Two men took the parcel off the plane and carried it into the Customs House.
statements.chinese: 两名男子把包裹从飞机上卸下来，并把它搬进了海关。

statements.english: While two detectives were keeping guard at the door, two others opened the parcel.
statements.chinese: 两名侦探在门口守卫，另外两名打开了包裹。

statements.english: To their surprise, the precious parcel was full of stones and sand!
statements.chinese: 令他们吃惊的是，这个贵重包裹里装满了石头和沙子！

courses.title: Lesson 8: The Best and the Worst
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 8 条逐句练习

statements.english: Why is Joe's garden the most beautiful one in the town?
statements.chinese: 为什么乔的花园是镇上最漂亮的一个？

statements.english: Joe Sanders has the most beautiful garden in our town.
statements.chinese: 乔·桑德斯拥有最美丽的花园在我们镇上。

statements.english: Nearly everybody enters for 'The Nicest Garden Competition' each year, but Joe wins every time.
statements.chinese: 几乎每个人都报名参加每年的“最美花园竞赛”，但乔每次都赢。
比尔·弗里斯的花园比乔的花园大。
statements.english: Bill Frith's garden is larger than Joe's.
Bill works harder than Joe and grows more flowers and vegetables, but Joe's garden is more interesting.
statements.chinese: 比尔比乔更努力工作并且种植更多的花卉和蔬菜，但乔的花园更有趣。

statements.english: He has made neat paths and has built a wooden bridge over a pool.
statements.chinese: 他修建了整齐的小径并在池塘上架起了一座木桥。

statements.english: I like gardens too, but I do not like hard work.
statements.chinese: 我也喜欢花园，但我不喜欢辛苦劳作。

statements.english: Every year I enter for the garden competition too, and I always win a little prize for the worst garden in the town!
statements.chinese: 每年我也参加花园竞赛，我总是赢得一个小奖因为我是镇上最差的花园！

courses.title: Lesson 9: A Cold Welcome
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 14 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: “冷淡的欢迎”指的是什么？
statements.english: What does 'a cold welcome' refer to?

statements.chinese: 星期三晚上，我们去了市政厅。
statements.english: On Wednesday evening, we went to the Town Hall.
It was the last day of the year and a large crowd of people had gathered under the Town Hall clock.
statements.chinese: 那是今年的最后一天，一大群人聚集在市政厅大钟下面。
再过二十分钟，大钟就要敲响十二点了。
statements.english: It would strike twelve in twenty minutes' time.
Fifteen minutes passed and then, at five to twelve, the clock stopped.
statements.chinese: 十五分钟过去了，接着，在十二点差五分的时候，大钟停了。
巨大的分针一动不动。
statements.english: The big minute hand did not move.
We waited and waited, but nothing happened.
statements.chinese: 我们等啊等，但什么也没有发生。
突然有人喊道：
statements.english: Suddenly someone shouted.

statements.chinese: “已经十二点过两分了！
statements.english: 'It's two minutes past twelve!

statements.chinese: 大钟停了！”
statements.english: The clock has stopped!'

statements.chinese: 我看了看我的表。
statements.english: I looked at my watch.

statements.chinese: 果然如此。
statements.english: It was true.

statements.chinese: 那座大钟拒不迎接新年。
statements.english: The big clock refused to welcome the New Year.

statements.chinese: 就在那一刻，所有人都开始笑啊唱啊。
statements.english: At that moment, everybody began to laugh and sing.

courses.title: Lesson 10: Not for Jazz
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 12 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 我们有一件古老的乐器。
statements.english: We have an old musical instrument.

statements.chinese: 它被称为击弦古钢琴。
statements.english: It is called a clavichord.

statements.chinese: 它于1681年在德国制造。
statements.english: It was made in Germany in 1681.

statements.chinese: 我们的击弦古钢琴放在客厅里。
statements.english: Our clavichord is kept in the living room.

statements.chinese: 它已经属于我们家很长时间了。
statements.english: It has belonged to our family for a long time.

statements.chinese: 这件乐器是多年前我祖父买的。
statements.english: The instrument was bought by my grandfather many years ago.

statements.chinese: 最近，它被一位访客损坏了。
statements.english: Recently, it was damaged by a visitor.

statements.chinese: 她试图在上面演奏爵士乐。
statements.english: She tried to play jazz on it.

statements.chinese: 她敲击琴键太用力，导致两根琴弦断裂了。
statements.english: She struck the keys too hard and two of the strings were broken.

statements.chinese: 我父亲很震惊。
statements.english: My father was shocked.

statements.chinese: 现在我们不被允许碰它。
statements.english: Now we are not allowed to touch it.

statements.chinese: 它正在由我父亲的一位朋友修理。
statements.english: It is being repaired by a friend of my father's.

courses.title: Lesson 11: One Good Turn Deserves Another
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 9 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 谁付了托尼的晚餐钱？
statements.english: Who paid for Tony's dinner?

statements.chinese: 我正在一家餐馆吃饭，这时托尼·斯蒂尔走了进来。
statements.english: I was having dinner at a restaurant when Tony Steele came in.
Tony worked in a lawyer's office years ago, but he is now working at a bank.
statements.chinese: 托尼多年前在一家律师事务所工作，但他现在在一家银行工作。

statements.english: He gets a good salary, but he always borrows money from his friends and never pays it back.
statements.chinese: 他薪水很高，但他总是向朋友借钱，从不还。
托尼看到了我，走过来坐在同一张桌子旁。
statements.english: Tony saw me and came and sat at the same table.

statements.chinese: 他从没向我借过钱。
statements.english: He has never borrowed money from me.

statements.chinese: 他吃饭的时候，我请他借给我二十英镑。
statements.english: While he was eating, I asked him to lend me twenty pounds.

statements.chinese: 令我惊讶的是，他立刻把钱给了我。
statements.english: To my surprise, he gave me the money immediately.
'I have never borrowed any money from you,' Tony said, 'so now you can pay for my dinner!'
statements.chinese: “我从没向你借过钱，”托尼说，“所以现在你可以为我的晚餐付钱了！”

courses.title: Lesson 12: Goodbye and Good Luck
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 11 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 艾莉森船长要去哪里，怎么去？
statements.english: Where is Captain Alison going and how?

statements.chinese: 我们的邻居，查尔斯·艾莉森船长，明天将从朴茨茅斯启航。
statements.english: Our neighbour, Captain Charles Alison, will sail from Portsmouth tomorrow.

statements.chinese: 我们明天一早将在港口与他会合。
statements.english: We'll meet him at the harbour early in the morning.

statements.chinese: 他将乘坐他的小船“上帆号”。
statements.english: He will be in his small boat, Topsail.

statements.chinese: “上帆号”是一艘著名的小船。
statements.english: Topsail is a famous little boat.

statements.chinese: 它已经多次横渡大西洋。
statements.english: It has sailed across the Atlantic many times.
Captain Alison will set out at eight o'clock, so we'll have plenty of time.
statements.chinese: 艾莉森船长将在八点钟出发，所以我们有充足的时间。
我们将去看他的船，然后向他告别。
statements.english: We'll see his boat and then we'll say goodbye to him.

statements.chinese: 他将离开两个月。
statements.english: He will be away for two months.

statements.chinese: 我们为他感到非常自豪。
statements.english: We are very proud of him.

statements.chinese: 他将参加一场重要的横渡大西洋的比赛。
statements.english: He will take part in an important race across the Atlantic.

courses.title: Lesson 13: The Greenwood Boys
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 11 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 警察为什么会遇到困难？
statements.english: Why will the police have a difficult time?

statements.chinese: “格林伍德少年”是一个流行歌手组合。
statements.english: The Greenwood Boys are a group of pop singers.

statements.chinese: 目前，他们正在全国各地巡回演出。
statements.english: At present, they are visiting all parts of the country.

statements.chinese: 他们明天将抵达这里。
statements.english: They will be arriving here tomorrow.

statements.chinese: 他们将乘火车来，镇上的大部分年轻人会去车站迎接他们。
statements.english: They will be coming by train and most of the young people in the town will be meeting them at the station.

statements.chinese: 明天晚上，他们将在工人俱乐部演唱。
statements.english: Tomorrow evening they will be singing at the Workers' Club.

statements.chinese: “格林伍德少年”将停留5天。
statements.english: The Greenwood Boys will be staying for five days.

statements.chinese: 在此期间，他们将演出5场。
statements.english: During this time, they will give five performances.

statements.chinese: 和往常一样，警察将遇到很多麻烦。
statements.english: As usual, the police will have a difficult time.

statements.chinese: 他们将尽力维持秩序。
statements.english: They will be trying to keep order.

statements.chinese: 每逢这种场合，情况总是如此。
statements.english: It is always the same on these occasions.

courses.title: Lesson 14: Do You Speak English
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 9 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 那个年轻人会说英语吗？
statements.english: Did the young man speak English?

statements.chinese: 去年我有一个有趣的经历。
statements.english: I had an amusing experience last year.
After I had left a small village in the south of France, I drove on to the next town.
statements.chinese: 在我离开法国南部的一个小村庄后，我驱车前往下一个城镇。
在路上，一个年轻人向我招手。
statements.english: On the way, a young man waved to me.

statements.chinese: 我停了下来，他请求我搭他一程。
statements.english: I stopped and he asked me for a lift.
As soon as he had got into the car, I said good morning to him in French and he replied in the same language.
statements.chinese: 他一上车，我就用法语向他问好，他也用同样的语言回答我。

statements.english: Apart from a few words, I do not know any French at all.
statements.chinese: 除了一些词语，我一点法语也不会。
在旅途中，我们两人都没有说话。
statements.english: Neither of us spoke during the journey.
I had nearly reached the town, when the young man suddenly said, very slowly, As I soon learnt, he was English himself!
statements.chinese: 我快到城镇时，那个年轻人突然非常缓慢地说，我很快了解到，他自己就是英国人！

courses.title: Lesson 15: Good News
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 11 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 好消息是什么？
statements.english: What was the good news?

statements.chinese: 秘书告诉我哈姆斯沃思先生会见我。
statements.english: The secretary told me that Mr. Harmsworth would see me.

statements.chinese: 当我走进他的办公室时，我感到非常紧张。
statements.english: I felt very nervous when I went into his office.

statements.chinese: 我进去时，他没有从办公桌上抬起头。
statements.english: He did not look up from his desk when I entered.
After I had sat down, he said that business was very bad.
statements.chinese: 我坐下后，他说生意很糟。
他告诉我公司负担不起支付如此高的薪水。
statements.english: He told me that the firm could not afford to pay such large salaries.

statements.chinese: 已经有二十人离开了。
statements.english: Twenty people had already left.

statements.chinese: 我知道轮到我了。
statements.english: I knew that my turn had come.

statements.chinese: “哈姆斯沃思先生，”我用微弱的声音说。
statements.english: 'Mr. Harmsworth,' I said in a weak voice.

statements.chinese: “不要打断，”他说。
statements.english: 'Don't interrupt,' he said.

statements.chinese: 然后他笑了，告诉我每年将额外获得一千英镑！
statements.english: Then he smiled and told me I would receive an extra thousand pounds a year!

courses.title: Lesson 16: A Polite Request
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 10 条逐句练习

statements.english: If you park your car in the wrong place, a traffic policeman will soon find it.
statements.chinese: 如果你把车停错了地方，交通警察很快就会发现它。
如果他让你不贴罚单就走，你就算非常幸运了。
statements.english: You will be very lucky if he lets you go without a ticket.

statements.chinese: 然而，这并不总是发生。
statements.english: However, this does not always happen.

statements.chinese: 交通警察有时非常礼貌。
statements.english: Traffic police are sometimes very polite.

statements.chinese: 在瑞典度假期间，我在我的车上发现了这张纸条。
statements.english: During a holiday in Sweden, I found this note on my car.

statements.chinese: 先生，我们欢迎您来到我们的城市。
statements.english: Sir, we welcome you to our city.

statements.chinese: 这里是禁止停车区。
statements.english: This is a no parking area.

statements.chinese: 如果您留意我们的路标，您会在这里度过愉快的时光。
statements.english: You will enjoy your stay here if you pay attention to our street signs.

statements.chinese: 这张纸条只是一个提醒。
statements.english: This note is only a reminder.
If you receive a request like this, you cannot fail to obey it.
statements.chinese: 如果你收到这样的请求，你就不能不遵守。

courses.title: Lesson 17: Always Young
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 9 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 珍妮弗姨妈为什么不告诉任何人她多大了？
statements.english: Why doesn't Aunt Jennifer tell anyone how old she is?

statements.chinese: 我的珍妮弗姨妈是个演员。
statements.english: My aunt Jennifer is an actress.

statements.chinese: 她肯定至少35岁了。
statements.english: She must be at least thirty-five years old.

statements.chinese: 尽管如此，她还是经常在舞台上扮演一个年轻姑娘。
statements.english: In spite of this, she often appears on the stage as a young girl.

statements.chinese: 珍妮弗很快就要参加一个新剧的演出了。
statements.english: Jennifer will have to take part in a new play soon.

statements.chinese: 这次，她将扮演一个17岁的姑娘。
statements.english: This time, she will be a girl of seventeen.

statements.chinese: 在剧中，她必须穿一件鲜红的连衣裙和一双长长的黑丝袜。
statements.english: In the play, she must appear in a bright red dress and long black stockings.
Last year in another play, she had to wear short socks and a bright, orange-coloured dress.
statements.chinese: 去年在另一个剧中，她不得不穿短袜和一件鲜艳的橙色连衣裙。

statements.english: If anyone ever asks her how old she is, she always answers, 'Darling, it must be terrible to be grown up!'
statements.chinese: 如果有人问起她多大了，她总是回答说：“亲爱的，长大成人真是太可怕了！”

courses.title: Lesson 18: He Often does This
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 10 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 作家的包怎么了？
statements.english: What had happened to the writer's bag?

statements.chinese: 我在一家乡村酒吧吃过午饭后，就去找我的包。
statements.english: After I had had lunch at a village pub, I looked for my bag.

statements.chinese: 我把它放在门旁边的一把椅子上，现在它不在那里了！
statements.english: I had left it on a chair beside the door and now it wasn't there!

statements.chinese: 当我正在找它的时候，房东进来了。
statements.english: As I was looking for it, the landlord came in.

statements.chinese: “你吃得好吗？”他问。
statements.english: 'Did you have a good meal?' he asked.

statements.chinese: “是的，谢谢你，”我回答说，“但我付不了账单。我没有我的包。”
statements.english: 'Yes, thank you,' I answered, 'but I can't pay the bill. I haven't got my bag.'

statements.chinese: 房东笑了，立刻出去了。
statements.english: The landlord smiled and immediately went out.

statements.chinese: 几分钟后，他带着我的包回来了，并把它还给了我。
statements.english: In a few minutes he returned with my bag and gave it back to me.

statements.chinese: “我非常抱歉，”他说。
statements.english: 'I'm very sorry,' he said.

statements.chinese: “我的狗把它叼到花园里去了。它经常这样做！”
statements.english: 'My dog had taken it into the garden. He often does this!'

courses.title: Lesson 19: Sold Out
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 15 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 作者什么时候会看这部戏？
statements.english: When will the writer see the play?

statements.chinese: “这出戏随时都可能开始，”我说。
statements.english: 'The play may begin at any moment,' I said.

statements.chinese: “可能已经开始了，”苏珊回答说。
statements.english: 'It may have begun already,' Susan answered.

statements.chinese: 我赶紧跑到售票处。
statements.english: I hurried to the ticket office.

statements.chinese: “请给我两张票好吗？”我问道。
statements.english: 'May I have two tickets please?' I asked.

statements.chinese: “对不起，票已经卖完了，”那个女孩说。
statements.english: 'I'm sorry, we've sold out,' the girl said.

statements.chinese: “真可惜！”苏珊惊呼道。
statements.english: 'What a pity!' Susan exclaimed.

statements.chinese: 就在那时，一个男人匆匆跑到售票处。
statements.english: Just then, a man hurried to the ticket office.

statements.chinese: “我能退这两张票吗？”他问道。
statements.english: 'Can I return these two tickets?' he asked.

statements.chinese: “当然可以，”那个女孩说。
statements.english: 'Certainly,' the girl said.

statements.chinese: 我立刻回到了售票处。
statements.english: I went back to the ticket office at once.

statements.chinese: “我能要那两张票吗？”我问道。
statements.english: 'Could I have those two tickets please?' I asked.
'Certainly,' the girl said, 'but they're for next Wednesday's performance.
statements.chinese: “当然可以，”那个女孩说，“但那是下周三演出的票。
你还要吗？”
statements.english: Do you still want them?'

statements.chinese: “我还是把它们拿走吧，”我伤心地说。
statements.english: 'I might as well have them,' I said sadly.

courses.title: Lesson 20: One Man in a Boat
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 13 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 为什么钓鱼是作者最喜欢的运动？
statements.english: Why is fishing the writer's favourite sport?

statements.chinese: 钓鱼是我最喜欢的运动。
statements.english: Fishing is my favourite sport.

statements.chinese: 我经常钓好几个小时，却什么也钓不到。
statements.english: I often fish for hours without catching anything.

statements.chinese: 但这并不困扰我。
statements.english: But this does not worry me.

statements.chinese: 有些渔夫运气不好。
statements.english: Some fishermen are unlucky.
Instead of catching fish, they catch old boots and rubbish.
statements.chinese: 他们不是钓到鱼，而是钓到旧靴子和垃圾。
我甚至更不走运。
statements.english: I am even less lucky.

statements.chinese: 我什么也钓不到——甚至连旧靴子都钓不到。
statements.english: I never catch anything -- not even old boots.
After having spent whole mornings on the river, I always go home with an empty bag.
statements.chinese: 在河上度过整个上午之后，我总是空手回家。
“你必须放弃钓鱼！”我的朋友们说，“这简直是浪费时间。”
statements.english: 'You must give up fishing!' my friends say. 'It's a waste of time.'

statements.chinese: 但他们没有意识到一件重要的事情。
statements.english: But they don't realize one important thing.

statements.chinese: 我对钓鱼并不真正感兴趣。
statements.english: I'm not really interested in fishing.

statements.chinese: 我只对坐在船上什么也不做感兴趣！
statements.english: I am only interested in sitting in a boat and doing nothing at all!

courses.title: Lesson 21: Mad or Not
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 10 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 为什么人们认为这位作者疯了？
statements.english: Why do people think the writer is mad?

statements.chinese: 飞机正慢慢地把我逼疯。
statements.english: Aeroplanes are slowly driving me mad.

statements.chinese: 我住在一个机场附近，飞机从早到晚轰鸣而过。
statements.english: I live near an airport and passing planes can be heard night and day.

statements.chinese: 机场是多年前修建的，但由于某种原因，那时无法投入使用。
statements.english: The airport was built years ago, but for some reason it could not be used then.

statements.chinese: 然而，去年它投入使用了。
statements.english: Last year, however, it came into use.

statements.chinese: 一百多人一定是被噪音逼离了家园。
statements.english: Over a hundred people must have been driven away from their homes by the noise.

statements.chinese: 我是少数留下来的人之一。
statements.english: I am one of the few people left.

statements.chinese: 有时我想这房子会被一架路过的飞机撞倒。
statements.english: Sometimes I think this house will be knocked down by a passing plane.

statements.chinese: 有人给我一大笔钱让我搬走，但我决心留在这里。
statements.english: I have been offered a large sum of money to go away, but I am determined to stay here.

statements.chinese: 大家都说我一定疯了，他们可能是对的。
statements.english: Everybody says I must be mad and they are probably right.

courses.title: Lesson 22: A Glass Envelope
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 8 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 简是如何收到陌生人的来信的？
statements.english: How did Jane receive a letter from a stranger?

statements.chinese: 我的女儿简从未想过会收到一个荷兰同龄女孩的来信。
statements.english: My daughter, Jane, never dreamed of receiving a letter from a girl of her own age in Holland.

statements.chinese: 去年，我们渡海旅行，简把一张写有她姓名和地址的纸条放进了一个瓶子里。
statements.english: Last year, we were travelling across the Channel and Jane put a piece of paper with her name and address on it into a bottle.

statements.chinese: 她把瓶子扔进了海里。
statements.english: She threw the bottle into the sea.

statements.chinese: 她再也没想起这件事，但十个月后，她收到了一个荷兰女孩的来信。
statements.english: She never thought of it again, but ten months later, she received a letter from a girl in Holland.

statements.chinese: 现在两个女孩定期通信。
statements.english: Both girls write to each other regularly now.

statements.chinese: 然而，她们决定使用邮局。
statements.english: However, they have decided to use the post office.

statements.chinese: 信件会贵一点，但肯定会更快到达。
statements.english: Letters will cost a little more, but they will certainly travel faster.

courses.title: Lesson 23: A New House
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 12 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 这新房子有什么特别之处？
statements.english: Why is the new house special?

statements.chinese: 昨天我收到了我姐姐的一封信。
statements.english: I had a letter from my sister yesterday.

statements.chinese: 她住在尼日利亚。
statements.english: She lives in Nigeria.

statements.chinese: 在信中她说她明年将来英国。
statements.english: In her letter, she said that she would come to England next year.

statements.chinese: 如果她来了，她会大吃一惊的。
statements.english: If she comes, she will get a surprise.

statements.chinese: 我们现在正住在这乡下一所漂亮的新房子里。
statements.english: We are now living in a beautiful new house in the country.

statements.chinese: 这所房子的建造在我姐姐离开之前就动工了。
statements.english: Work on it had begun before my sister left.

statements.chinese: 房子在5个月前就竣工了。
statements.english: The house was completed five months ago.

statements.chinese: 我在信中告诉她，她可以和我们住在一起。
statements.english: In my letter, I told her that she could stay with us.

statements.chinese: 这所房子有许多大房间，还有一个漂亮的花园。
statements.english: The house has many large rooms and there is a lovely garden.

statements.chinese: 这是一座很现代化的房子，所以有些人觉得它样子很怪。
statements.english: It is a very modern house, so it looks strange to some people.

statements.chinese: 它肯定是这个地区唯一的一座现代化住宅。
statements.english: It must be the only modern house in the district.

courses.title: Lesson 24: It Could be Worse
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 10 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 作者的钱被偷了吗？
statements.english: Had the writer's money been stolen?

statements.chinese: 我走进旅馆经理的办公室，坐了下来。
statements.english: I entered the hotel manager's office and sat down.

statements.chinese: 我刚刚丢失了50英镑，感到非常沮丧。
statements.english: I had just lost ￡50 and I felt very upset.
'I left the money in my room,' I said, 'and it's not there now. ' The manager was sympathetic, but he could do nothing.
statements.chinese: “我把钱落在房间里了，”我说，“现在它不在那儿了。”经理深表同情，但他无能为力。
“现在大家都在丢钱，”他说。
statements.english: 'Everyone's losing money these days,' he said.

statements.chinese: 他开始抱怨这个邪恶的世界，但被一阵敲门声打断了。
statements.english: He started to complain about this wicked world but was interrupted by a knock at the door.

statements.chinese: 一个女孩走了进来，在他的桌上放了一个信封。
statements.english: A girl came in and put an envelope on his desk.

statements.chinese: 里面装着50英镑。
statements.english: It contained ￡50.

statements.chinese: “我在这位先生的房间外面发现了这个，”她说。
statements.english: 'I found this outside this gentleman's room,' she said.

statements.chinese: “噢，”我对经理说，“这世界上还是有诚实可言的！”
statements.english: 'Well,' I said to the manager,'there is still some honesty in this world!'

courses.title: Lesson 25: Do the English Speak English
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 18 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 他们说英语吗？
statements.english: Do they speak English?

statements.chinese: 为什么作者听不懂搬运工的话？
statements.english: Why does the writer not understand the porter?

statements.chinese: 我终于抵达伦敦了。
statements.english: I arrived in London at last.

statements.chinese: 火车站又大，又黑，又暗。
statements.english: The railway station was big, black and dark.

statements.chinese: 我不知道去旅馆的路，所以我问了一位搬运工。
statements.english: I did not know the way to my hotel, so I asked a porter.

statements.chinese: 我不仅非常仔细地说英语，而且说得非常清楚。
statements.english: I not only spoke English very carefully, but very clearly as well.

statements.chinese: 然而，那个搬运工却听不懂我。
statements.english: The porter, however, could not understand me.

statements.chinese: 我重复了我的问题好几次，最后他终于明白了。
statements.english: I repeated my question several times and at last he understood.

statements.chinese: 他回答了我，但他既说得不慢也不清楚。
statements.english: he answered me, but he spoke neither slowly nor clearly.

statements.chinese: “我是一个外国人，”我说。
statements.english: 'I am a foreigner,' I said.

statements.chinese: 然后他慢慢地说，但我仍然听不懂他。
statements.english: Then he spoke slowly, but I could not understand him.

statements.chinese: 我的老师从来没有那样说过英语！
statements.english: My teacher never spoke English like that!

statements.chinese: 搬运工和我互相对视，然后笑了。
statements.english: The porter and I looked at each other and smiled.

statements.chinese: 然后他说了一些话，我听懂了。
statements.english: Then he said something and I understood it.

statements.chinese: “你很快就会学好英语的！”他说。
statements.english: 'You'll soon learn English!' he said.

statements.chinese: 我怀疑。
statements.english: I wonder.

statements.chinese: 在英国，每个人都说着不同的语言。
statements.english: In England, each person speaks a different language.

statements.chinese: 英国人彼此听得懂，但我听不懂他们！
statements.english: The English understand each other, but I don't understand them!

courses.title: Lesson 26: The Best Art Critics
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 22 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 我是一名艺术系学生，我画了很多画。
statements.english: I am an art student and I paint a lot of pictures.

statements.chinese: 许多人假装他们懂现代艺术。
statements.english: Many people pretend that they understand modern art.

statements.chinese: 他们总是告诉你一幅画是关于什么的。
statements.english: They always tell you what a picture is about.

statements.chinese: 当然，许多画根本不是关于任何东西的。
statements.english: Of course, many pictures are not about anything.

statements.chinese: 它们只是漂亮的图案。
statements.english: They are just pretty patterns.

statements.chinese: 我们喜欢它们，就像我们喜欢漂亮的窗帘布一样。
statements.english: We like them in the same way that we like pretty curtain material.

statements.chinese: 我认为小孩子往往比其他人更能欣赏现代画。
statements.english: I think that young children often appreciate modern pictures better than anyone else.

statements.chinese: 他们注意得更多。
statements.english: They notice more.

statements.chinese: 我妹妹只有七岁，但她总是告诉我我的画好不好。
statements.english: My sister is only seven, but she always tells me whether my pictures are good or not.

statements.chinese: 昨天她走进我的房间。
statements.english: She came into my room yesterday.

statements.chinese: 你在做什么？
statements.english: What are you doing?

statements.chinese: 她问。
statements.english: she asked.

statements.chinese: 我正把这幅画挂在墙上。
statements.english: I'm hanging this picture on the wall.

statements.chinese: 我回答。
statements.english: I answered.

statements.chinese: 这是新画的。
statements.english: It's a new one.

statements.chinese: 你喜欢吗？
statements.english: Do you like it?

statements.chinese: 她批判性地看了一会儿。
statements.english: She looked at it critically for a moment.

statements.chinese: “还行，”她说。
statements.english: It's all right, she said.

statements.chinese: 但它是不是倒了？
statements.english: But isn't it upside down?

statements.chinese: 我又看了一眼。
statements.english: I looked at it again.

statements.chinese: 她是对的。
statements.english: She was right.

statements.chinese: 确实是。
statements.english: It was.

courses.title: Lesson 27: A Wet Night
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 13 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 晚上男孩们发生了什么事？
statements.english: What happened to the boys in the night?

statements.chinese: 下午很晚的时候，男孩们把帐篷搭在了田野中央。
statements.english: Late in the afternoon, the boys put up their tent in the middle of a field.

statements.chinese: 这一切刚弄好，他们就在篝火上做了一顿饭。
statements.english: As soon as this was done, they cooked a meal over an open fire.

statements.chinese: 他们都饿了，食物闻起来很香。
statements.english: They were all hungry and the food smelled good.

statements.chinese: 美餐一顿之后，他们围着篝火讲故事，唱歌。
statements.english: After a wonderful meal, they told stories and sang songs by the campfire.

statements.chinese: 但过了一会儿，天开始下雨了。
statements.english: But some time later it began to rain.

statements.chinese: 男孩们感到疲倦了，于是他们熄灭了篝火，钻进了帐篷。
statements.english: The boys felt tired so they put out the fire and crept into their tent.

statements.chinese: 他们的睡袋又暖和又舒服，所以他们都睡得很香。
statements.english: Their sleeping bags were warm and comfortable, so they all slept soundly.

statements.chinese: 半夜里，两个男孩醒了，开始大叫起来。
statements.english: In the middle of the night, two boys woke up and began shouting.

statements.chinese: 帐篷里全是水！
statements.english: The tent was full of water!

statements.chinese: 他们都跳出睡袋，匆匆忙忙跑到了外面。
statements.english: They all leapt out of their sleeping bags and hurried outside.

statements.chinese: 雨下得很大，他们发现田野里形成了一条小溪。
statements.english: It was raining heavily and they found that a stream had formed in the field.

statements.chinese: 小溪蜿蜒穿过田野，然后正好从他们的帐篷下面流过！
statements.english: The stream wound its way across the field and then flowed right under their tent!

courses.title: Lesson 28: No Parking
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 11 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 贾斯珀·怀特有什么问题？
statements.english: What is Jasper White's problem?

statements.chinese: 贾斯珀·怀特是那种相信古代神话的稀有人物之一。
statements.english: Jasper White is one of those rare people who believes in ancient myths.

statements.chinese: 他刚在城里买了新房子，但自从他搬进来后，他就一直被汽车和它们的车主所困扰。
statements.english: He has just bought a new house in the city, but ever since he moved in, he has had trouble with cars and their owners.

statements.chinese: 每当他晚上回家时，他总是发现有人把车停在他家门口。
statements.english: When he returns home at night, he always finds that someone has parked a car outside his gate.

statements.chinese: 因此，他甚至一次都没能把自己的车开进车库。
statements.english: Because of this, he has not been able to get his own car into his garage even once.

statements.chinese: 贾斯珀在他家门口竖起了“禁止停车”的牌子，但这些都没有任何效果。
statements.english: Jasper has put up 'No Parking' signs outside his gate, but these have not had any effect.

statements.chinese: 现在他在门上放了一个丑陋的石头脑袋。
statements.english: Now he has put an ugly stone head over the gate.

statements.chinese: 这是我见过的最丑陋的脸之一。
statements.english: It is one of the ugliest faces I have ever seen.

statements.chinese: 我问他那是什么，他告诉我那是美杜莎，那个戈尔贡女妖。
statements.english: I asked him what it was and he told me that it was Medusa, the Gorgon.

statements.chinese: 贾斯珀希望她能把汽车和它们的车主变成石头。
statements.english: Jasper hopes that she will turn cars and their owners to stone.

statements.chinese: 但他们中还没有人变成石头！
statements.english: But none of them has been turned to stone yet!

courses.title: Lesson 29: Taxi
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 10 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 福西特上尉认为有哪次飞行会太危险吗？
statements.english: Does Captain Fawcett think any trip is too dangerous?

statements.chinese: 本·福西特上尉购买了一架不同寻常的“出租车”，并开始了一项新业务。
statements.english: Captain Ben Fawcett has bought an unusual taxi and has begun a new service.

statements.chinese: 这架“出租车”是一架名为“皮拉图斯搬运工”的瑞士小型飞机。
statements.english: The 'taxi' is a small Swiss aeroplane called a 'Pilatus Porter'.

statements.chinese: 这架奇妙的飞机能载七名乘客。
statements.english: This wonderful plane can carry seven passengers.

statements.chinese: 然而，它最令人惊讶的地方是它能降落在任何地方：雪地、水面，甚至是一块耕过的田地。
statements.english: The most surprising thing about it, however, is that it can land anywhere: on snow, water, or even on a ploughed field.

statements.chinese: 福西特上尉的第一位乘客是一位医生，他从伯明翰飞到威尔士山区的一个偏僻村庄。
statements.english: Captain Fawcett's first passenger was a doctor who flew from Birmingham to a lonely village in the Welsh mountains.

statements.chinese: 从那以后，福西特上尉已载送乘客去过许多不寻常的地方。
statements.english: Since then, Captain Fawcett has flown passengers to many unusual places.

statements.chinese: 他曾有一次降落在公寓楼的屋顶上，还有一次降落在废弃的停车场里。
statements.english: Once he landed on the roof of a block of flats and on another occasion, he landed in a deserted car park.

statements.chinese: 福西特上尉刚刚拒绝了一位商人提出的一个奇怪请求。
statements.english: Captain Fawcett has just refused a strange request from a businessman.
The man wanted to fly to Rockall, a lonely island in the Atlantic Ocean, but Captain Fawcett did not take him because the trip was too dangerous.
statements.chinese: 那位商人想飞到大西洋中的一座孤岛——罗科尔岛，但福西特上尉没有载他，因为那次飞行太危险了。

courses.title: Lesson 30: Football or Polo
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 11 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 船上的那个人怎么了？
statements.english: What happened to the man in the boat?

statements.chinese: 威勒河是一条小河，它横穿过我家附近的公园。
statements.english: The Wayle is a small river that cuts across the park near my home.

statements.chinese: 我喜欢在天气晴朗的下午坐在威勒河边。
statements.english: I like sitting by the Wayle on fine afternoons.

statements.chinese: 上个星期天天气很暖和，于是我像往常一样去坐在了河岸上。
statements.english: It was warm last Sunday, so I went and sat on the river bank as usual.

statements.chinese: 一些孩子在岸边玩游戏，河里有一些人在划船。
statements.english: Some children were playing games on the bank and there were some people rowing on the river.

statements.chinese: 突然，一个孩子非常用力地踢了一个球，球飞向了一艘路过的船。
statements.english: Suddenly, one of the children kicked a ball very hard and it went towards a passing boat.

statements.chinese: 岸边的一些人向船上的那个人大声喊叫，但他没有听到。
statements.english: Some people on the bank called out to the man in the boat, but he did not hear them.

statements.chinese: 球重重地打在他身上，他差点儿掉进水里。
statements.english: The ball struck him so hard that he nearly fell into the water.

statements.chinese: 我转身去看孩子们，但一个也看不见了：他们都跑掉了！
statements.english: I turned to look at the children, but there weren't any in sight: they had all run away!

statements.chinese: 当那个人意识到发生了什么事时，他笑了。
statements.english: The man laughed when he realized what had happened.

statements.chinese: 他冲孩子们喊了一声，把球扔回了岸边。
statements.english: He called out to the children and threw the ball back to the bank.

courses.title: Lesson 31: Success Story
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 12 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 昨天下午，弗兰克·霍金斯向我讲述了他年轻时的经历。
statements.english: Yesterday afternoon, Frank Hawkins was telling me about his experiences as a young man.

statements.chinese: 弗兰克现在是一家大型商业公司的负责人。
statements.english: Frank is now the head of a very large business company.

statements.chinese: 但在少年时代，他曾在一家小商店工作。
statements.english: But as a boy, he used to work in a small shop.

statements.chinese: 他的工作是修理自行车。
statements.english: It was his job to repair bicycles.

statements.chinese: 那时，他每天工作14个小时。
statements.english: And at that time, he used to work 14 hours a day.

statements.chinese: 他多年来省吃俭用，1938年买下了自己的一个小作坊。
statements.english: He saved money for years, and in 1938, he bought a small workshop of his own.

statements.chinese: 战争期间，弗兰克为飞机制造备件。
statements.english: During the war, Frank used to make spare parts for airplanes.

statements.chinese: 那时，他有两个帮手。
statements.english: At that time, he had two helpers.

statements.chinese: 战争结束时，那个小作坊已经变成了一家大工厂，雇佣了728名员工。
statements.english: By the end of the war, the small workshop had become a large factory, which employed 728 people.

statements.chinese: 弗兰克回想起他艰难的早年岁月和漫长的成功之路时，露出了笑容。
statements.english: Frank smiled when he remembered his hard early years and the long road to success.

statements.chinese: 当门打开，他的妻子走进来时，他仍在微笑。
statements.english: He was still smiling when the door opened and his wife came in.

statements.chinese: 她想让他修理他们儿子的自行车。
statements.english: She wanted him to repair their son's bicycle.

courses.title: Lesson 32: Shopping Made Easy
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 10 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 谁是小偷？
statements.english: Who was the thief?
People are not so honest as they once were.
statements.chinese: 人们不像从前那样诚实，曾经是那样。

statements.english: The temptation to steal is greater than ever before--especially in large shops.
statements.chinese: 偷窃的诱惑比以往任何时候都更大——尤其是在大型商店里。

statements.english: A detective recently watched a well-dressed woman who always went into a large store on Monday mornings.
statements.chinese: 一名侦探最近发现一名穿着考究的妇女，她总是周一上午去一家大商店。

statements.english: One Monday, there were fewer people in the shop than usual when the woman came in, so it was easier for the detective to watch her.
statements.chinese: 有一个周一，商店里的人比平时少，当时那个妇女进来了，因此侦探更容易监视她。
这名妇女首先买了几件小商品。
statements.english: The woman first bought a few small articles.
After a little time, she chose one of the most expensive dresses in the shop and handed it to an assistant who wrapped it up for her as quickly as possible.
statements.chinese: 过了一会儿，她选择了一件店里最昂贵的连衣裙，并把它递给了一名店员，店员尽快地为她包好了。

statements.english: Then the woman simply took the parcel and walked out of the shop without paying.
statements.chinese: 然后，这名妇女只是拿起包裹没有付钱就走出了商店。

statements.english: When she was arrested, the detective found out that the shop assistant was her daughter.
statements.chinese: 当她被捕时，侦探发现这名店员是她的女儿。

statements.english: The girl 'gave' her mother a free dress once a week!
statements.chinese: 这女孩每周“送给”她母亲一件免费连衣裙！

courses.title: Lesson 33: Out of the Darkness
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 11 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 女孩为什么住院了？
statements.english: Why was the girl in hospital?
Nearly a week passed before the girl was able to explain what had happened to her.
statements.chinese: 将近一个星期过去了女孩才能解释发生在她身上的事情。

statements.english: One afternoon she set out from the coast in a small boat and was caught in a storm.
statements.chinese: 一个下午，她出发了乘小船从海岸出发结果遭遇了暴风雨。

statements.english: Towards evening, the boat struck a rock and the girl jumped into the sea.
