statements.chinese: 傍晚时分，小船撞上了一块礁石女孩跳入了海中。

statements.english: Then she swam to the shore after spending the whole night in the water.
statements.chinese: 然后她游向岸边在水里待了一整夜。

statements.english: During that time she covered a distance of eight miles.
statements.chinese: 在那段时间里，她游了八英里的距离。

statements.english: Early next morning, she saw a light ahead.
statements.chinese: 第二天一早，她看到前方有灯光。

statements.english: She knew she was near the shore because the light was high up on the cliffs.
statements.chinese: 她知道她靠近岸边了因为灯光在高高的悬崖上。

statements.english: On arriving at the shore, the girl struggled up the cliff towards the light she had seen.
statements.chinese: 到达岸边后，女孩艰难地爬上悬崖朝着她看到的灯光。
这就是她所记得的一切。
statements.english: That was all she remembered.
When she woke up a day later, she found herself in hospital.
statements.chinese: 一天后她醒来时，她发现自己躺在医院里。

courses.title: Lesson 34: Quick Work
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 12 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 泰德·罗宾逊整个星期都忧心忡忡。
statements.english: Ted Robinson has been worried all the week.

statements.chinese: 上周二，他收到当地警方的来信。
statements.english: Last Tuesday, he received a letter from the local police.

statements.chinese: 信中要求他去警察局报到。
statements.english: In the letter, he was asked to call at the station.

statements.chinese: 泰德想知道为什么警察要找他。
statements.english: Ted wondered why he was wanted by the police.

statements.chinese: 但他昨天去了警察局，现在他不再担心了。
statements.english: But he went to the station yesterday and now he is not worried any more.

statements.chinese: 在警察局，一位面带微笑的警察告诉他，他的自行车找到了。
statements.english: At the station, he was told by a smiling policeman that his bicycle had been found.

statements.chinese: 警察告诉他，五天前，那辆自行车在400英里外的一个小村庄被找到了。
statements.english: Five days ago, the policeman told him, the bicycle was picked up in a small village 400 miles away.

statements.chinese: 现在正通过火车运往他家。
statements.english: It is now being sent to his home by train.

statements.chinese: 泰德听到这个消息时非常惊讶。
statements.english: Ted was most surprised when he heard the news.

statements.chinese: 他也觉得很好笑。
statements.english: He was amused too.

statements.chinese: 因为他从未想过自行车能被找回。
statements.english: Because he never expected the bicycle to be found.

statements.chinese: 那是20年前，泰德15岁时被偷的。
statements.english: It was stolen 20 years ago when Ted was a boy of 15.

courses.title: Lesson 35: Stop Thief
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 12 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 罗伊是怎样制止小偷的？
statements.english: How did Roy stop the thieves?

statements.chinese: 罗伊·特伦顿以前是开出租车的。
statements.english: Roy Trenton used to drive a taxi.
A short while ago, however, he became a bus driver and he has not regretted it.
statements.chinese: 然而，不久前，他当上了一名公共汽车司机，他一点也不后悔。
他觉得自己的新工作更加激动人心。
statements.english: He is finding his new work far more exciting.
When he was driving along Catford Street recently, he saw two thieves rush out of a shop and run towards a waiting car.
statements.chinese: 最近，当他开着车沿卡特福德大街行驶时，他看见两个小偷从一家商店里冲出来，朝一辆等在那里的汽车跑去。
其中一个提着一满袋钱。
statements.english: One of them was carrying a bag full of money.
Roy acted quickly and drove the bus straight at the thieves.
statements.chinese: 罗伊迅速行动，把公共汽车径直朝小偷开去。

statements.english: The one with the money got such a fright that he dropped the bag.
statements.chinese: 拿钱的那个小偷吓了一大跳，把袋子都弄掉了。

statements.english: As the thieves were trying to get away in their car, Roy drove his bus into the back of it.
statements.chinese: 当小偷们试图乘车逃跑时，罗伊开着公共汽车撞在小偷汽车的尾部。

statements.english: While the battered car was moving away, Roy stopped his bus and telephoned the police.
statements.chinese: 就在那辆被撞坏的汽车开走的时候，罗伊停下公共汽车给警察打了电话。
小偷的汽车已严重受损，很容易辨认。
statements.english: The thieves' car was badly damaged and easy to recognize.
Shortly afterwards, the police stopped the car and both men were arrested.
statements.chinese: 不久，警察截住了那辆汽车，两名男子都被捕了。

courses.title: Lesson 36: Across the Channel
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 12 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 黛比将要尝试做什么？
statements.english: What is Debbie going to try to do?
Debbie Hart is going to swim across the English Channel tomorrow.
statements.chinese: 黛比·哈特将于明天横渡英吉利海峡。

statements.english: She is going to set out from the French coast at five o'clock in the morning.
statements.chinese: 她将于明天凌晨5点从法国海岸出发。

statements.english: Debbie is only eleven years old and she hopes to set up a new world record.
statements.chinese: 黛比年仅11岁，她希望能创造一个新的世界纪录。

statements.english: She is a strong swimmer and many people feel that she is sure to succeed.
statements.chinese: 她是一名出色的游泳运动员，许多人觉得她一定会成功。

statements.english: Debbie's father will set out with her in a small boat.
statements.chinese: 黛比的父亲将与她一起乘一艘小船出发。
哈特先生训练他的女儿已经多年了。
statements.english: Mr. Hart has trained his daughter for years.
Tomorrow he will be watching her anxiously as she swims the long distance to England.
statements.chinese: 明天，他将焦急地看着她游过那漫长的距离去英国。
黛比打算每两小时短暂停歇一次。
statements.english: Debbie intends to take short rests every two hours.
She will have something to drink but she will not eat any solid food.
statements.chinese: 她会喝些东西，但不吃任何固体食物。

statements.english: Most of Debbie's school friends will be waiting for her on the English coast.
statements.chinese: 黛比的大部分同学都将在英国海岸等候她。

statements.english: Among them will be Debbie's mother, who swam the Channel herself when she was a girl.
statements.chinese: 其中包括黛比的母亲，她本人在还是个女孩的时候也曾游过英吉利海峡。

courses.title: Lesson 37: The Olympic Games
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 10 条逐句练习

statements.english: When was the last time this country hosted the Olympic Games?
statements.chinese: 这个国家上次是何时举办奥运会的？

statements.english: The Olympic Games will be held in our country in four years' time.
statements.chinese: 奥运会将在四年后在我国举行。

statements.english: As a great many people will be visiting the country, the government will be building new hotels, an immense stadium, and a new Olympic-standard swimming pool.
statements.chinese: 由于很多人将会访问这个国家，政府将建造新酒店、一个巨大的体育场，和一个符合奥运标准的新游泳池。

statements.english: They will also be building new roads and a special railway line.
statements.chinese: 他们还将修建新道路和一条专用铁路线。

statements.english: The Games will be held just outside the capital and the whole area will be called 'Olympic City'.
statements.chinese: 奥运会将在首都郊外举行，整个地区将被命名为“奥运城”。

statements.english: Workers will have completed the new roads by the end of this year.
statements.chinese: 工人们将在今年年底完成新道路的修建。

statements.english: By the end of next year, they will have finished work on the new stadium.
statements.chinese: 到明年年底，他们将完成新体育场的建设工作。

statements.english: The fantastic modern buildings have been designed by Kurt Gunter.
statements.chinese: 这些奇妙的现代化建筑已由库尔特·冈瑟设计。

statements.english: Everybody will be watching anxiously as the new buildings go up.
statements.chinese: 每个人都会焦急地关注这些新建筑的建成。

statements.english: We are all very excited and are looking forward to the Olympic Games because they have never been held before in this country.
statements.chinese: 我们都非常兴奋并期待着奥运会的到来，因为这个国家以前从未举办过奥运会。

courses.title: Lesson 38: Everything Except the Weather
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 11 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 为什么哈里森把房子卖得这么快？
statements.english: Why did Harrison sell his house so quickly?
My old friend, Harrison, had lived in the Mediterranean for many years before he returned to England.
statements.chinese: 我的老朋友哈里森在地中海地区住过多年，然后才回到英国。

statements.english: He had often dreamed of retiring in England and had planned to settle down in the country.
statements.chinese: 他曾常常梦想在英国退休，并计划在乡村安顿下来。

statements.english: He had no sooner returned than he bought a house and went to live there.
statements.chinese: 他刚一回来就买下了所房子住了进去。

statements.english: Almost immediately he began to complain about the weather, for even though it was still summer, it rained continually and it was often bitterly cold.
statements.chinese: 他几乎是立刻就开始抱怨天气了，因为尽管当时仍是夏天，但却一直下雨，而且常常冷得厉害。

statements.english: After so many years of sunshine, Harrison got a shock.
statements.chinese: 在阳光充足的地方生活了那么多年之后，哈里森感到很震惊。
他的举动就好像他以前从未在英国生活过一样。
statements.english: He acted as if he had never lived in England before.

statements.chinese: 最终，他再也忍受不了了。
statements.english: In the end, it was more than he could bear.
He had hardly had time to settle down when he sold the house and left the country.
statements.chinese: 他还没来得及安顿下来，就把房子卖掉离开了英国。
他多年的梦想就这样破灭了。
statements.english: The dream he had had for so many years ended there.

statements.chinese: 哈里森把什么都考虑到了，就是没想到天气。
statements.english: Harrison had thought of everything except the weather.

courses.title: Lesson 39: Am I All Right
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 10 条逐句练习

statements.english: While John Gilbert was in hospital, he asked his doctor to tell him whether his operation had been successful.
statements.chinese: 约翰·吉尔伯特住院期间，他问医生，他的手术是否成功。
但医生拒绝告知。
statements.english: But the doctor refused to do so.

statements.chinese: 第二天，病人要求一个床头电话。
statements.english: The following day, the patient asked for a bedside telephone.
When he was alone, he telephoned the hospital exchange and asked for Dr. Millington.
statements.chinese: 当他独自一人时，他打电话到医院总机并要求找米林顿医生。

statements.english: When the doctor answered the phone, Mr. Gilbert said he was inquiring about a certain patient, a Mr. John Gilbert.
statements.chinese: 当医生接听电话时，吉尔伯特先生说他正在询问一位病人，一位名叫约翰·吉尔伯特的先生。

statements.english: He asked if Mr. Gilbert's operation had been successful, and the doctor told him that it had been.
statements.chinese: 他问吉尔伯特先生的手术是否成功，医生告诉他手术很成功。

statements.english: He then asked when Mr. Gilbert would be allowed to go home, and the doctor told him that he would have to stay in hospital for another two weeks.
statements.chinese: 然后他问吉尔伯特先生何时可以回家，医生告诉他，他将不得不继续住院再住两周。
然后米林顿医生问打电话的人他是否是病人的亲属。
statements.english: Then Dr. Millington asked the caller if he was a relative of the patient.

statements.chinese: “不，”病人回答。
statements.english: "No," the patient answered.

statements.chinese: “我就是约翰·吉尔伯特先生。”
statements.english: "I am Mr. John Gilbert."

courses.title: Lesson 40: Food and Talk
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 14 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 伦布尔德夫人是个好的晚餐伴侣吗？
statements.english: Was Mrs. Rumbold a good companion at dinner?
Last week at a dinner party, the hostess asked me to sit next to Mrs. Rumbold.
statements.chinese: 上周在一个晚宴上，女主人请我坐在伦布尔德夫人旁边。

statements.english: Mrs. Rumbold was a large, unsmiling lady in a tight black dress.
statements.chinese: 伦布尔德夫人是个身材魁梧、不苟言笑的女士，穿着一件紧身黑连衣裙。
我在她身边坐下时，她甚至没有抬头看我。
statements.english: She did not even look up when I took my seat beside her.
Her eyes were fixed on her plate and in a short time, she was busy eating.
statements.chinese: 她的眼睛盯着自己的盘子，不一会儿，她就开始大吃起来。
我试图和她攀谈。
statements.english: I tried to make conversation.
'A new play is coming to "The Globe" soon,' I said. 'Will you be seeing it?'
statements.chinese: “一部新戏很快就要在‘环球剧场’上演了，”我说，“您会去看吗？”
“不，”她答道。
statements.english: 'No,' she answered.

statements.chinese: “今年您会到国外度假吗？”我问。
statements.english: 'Will you be spending your holidays abroad this year?' I asked.

statements.chinese: “不，”她答道。
statements.english: 'No,' she answered.

statements.chinese: “您会留在英格兰吗？”我问。
statements.english: 'Will you be staying in England?' I asked.

statements.chinese: “不，”她答道。
statements.english: 'No,' she answered.

statements.chinese: 绝望中，我问她是否喜欢她的晚餐。
statements.english: In despair, I asked her whether she was enjoying her dinner.
'Young man,' she answered, 'if you ate more and talked less, we would both enjoy our dinner!'
statements.chinese: “年轻人，”她回答说，“如果你多吃点，少说点，我们俩都会享受晚餐的！”

courses.title: Lesson 41: Do You Call That a Hat
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 13 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 你认为作者喜欢哪种购物方式？
statements.english: What kind of shopping does the writer enjoy, do you think?

statements.chinese: “你管那玩意儿叫帽子？”我对妻子说。
statements.english: 'Do you call that a hat?' I said to my wife.
'You needn't be so rude about it,' my wife answered as she looked at herself in the mirror.
statements.chinese: “你没必要这么粗鲁，”妻子对着镜子看着自己，回答道。
我坐在一把带洞的现代椅子上，等着。
statements.english: I sat down on one of those modern chairs with holes in it and waited.

statements.chinese: 我们已经在帽子店里待了半个小时了，妻子还在镜子前面。
statements.english: We had been in the hat shop for half an hour and my wife was still in front of the mirror.

statements.chinese: “我们不该买不需要的东西，”我突然说道。
statements.english: 'We mustn't buy things we don't need,' I remarked suddenly.

statements.chinese: 我几乎立刻就后悔说了这句话。
statements.english: I regretted saying it almost at once.

statements.chinese: “你本没必要说那些话的，”妻子回答道。
statements.english: 'You needn't have said that,' my wife answered.

statements.chinese: “我也没必要提醒你昨天买的那条糟糕的领带。”
statements.english: 'I needn't remind you of that terrible tie you bought yesterday.'

statements.chinese: “我觉得它很漂亮，”我说，“男人永远不嫌领带多。”
statements.english: 'I find it beautiful,' I said. 'A man can never have too many ties.'

statements.chinese: “女人也永远不嫌帽子多，”她回答道。
statements.english: 'And a woman can't have too many hats,' she answered.

statements.chinese: 十分种后，我们一起走出了商店。
statements.english: Ten minutes later we walked out of the shop together.

statements.chinese: 妻子戴着一顶看起来像灯塔一样的帽子！
statements.english: My wife was wearing a hat that looked like a lighthouse!

courses.title: Lesson 42: Not Very Musical
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 9 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 耍蛇人开始演奏爵士乐时发生了什么？
statements.english: What happened when the snake charmer began to play jazz?
As we had had a long walk through one of the markets of old Delhi, we stopped at a square to have a rest.
statements.chinese: 我们在老德里的一处市场走了很长一段路之后，在一个广场停下来休息。

statements.english: After a time, we noticed a snake charmer with two large baskets at the other side of the square, so we went to have a look at him.
statements.chinese: 过了一会儿，我们注意到广场的另一边有位耍蛇人，带着两个大篮子。于是我们走过去看他。

statements.english: As soon as he saw us, he picked up a long pipe which was covered with coins and opened one of the baskets.
statements.chinese: 他一看到我们，便拿起一根盖满硬币的长笛，打开了一个篮子。

statements.english: When he began to play a tune, we had our first glimpse of the snake.
statements.chinese: 当他开始吹奏曲子时，我们第一次瞥见了那条蛇。
它从篮子里钻出来，开始跟着长笛的动作舞动。
statements.english: It rose out of the basket and began to follow the movements of the pipe.
We were very much surprised when the snake charmer suddenly began to play jazz and modern pop songs.
statements.chinese: 当耍蛇人突然开始演奏爵士乐和现代流行歌曲时，我们感到非常惊讶。
然而，那条蛇却继续缓慢地“跳舞”。
statements.english: The snake, however, continued to 'dance' slowly.

statements.chinese: 它显然分辨不出印度音乐和爵士乐的区别！
statements.english: It obviously could not tell the difference between Indian music and jazz!

courses.title: Lesson 43: Over the South Pole
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 9 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 飞机是如何能够越过山脉的？
statements.english: How was the plane able to clear the mountains?
In 1929, three years after his flight over the North Pole, the American explorer, R.E. Byrd, successfully flew over the South Pole for the first time.
statements.chinese: 1929年，在他飞越北极三年后，美国探险家R.E.伯德，首次成功飞越了南极。

statements.english: Though, at first, Byrd and his men were able to take a great many photographs of the mountains that lay below, they soon ran into serious trouble.
statements.chinese: 虽然起初，伯德和他的队员们能够拍摄到许多下方山脉的照片，但他们很快就遇到了严重的麻烦。
有一刻，他们的飞机似乎肯定会坠毁。
statements.english: At one point, it seemed certain that their plane would crash.

statements.chinese: 只有当飞机上升到10,000英尺时，才能越过山脉。
statements.english: It could only get over the mountains if it rose to 10, 000 feet.

statements.chinese: 伯德立即命令他的队员们扔掉两个沉重的食物袋。
statements.english: Byrd at once ordered his men to throw out two heavy food sacks.

statements.chinese: 飞机随后得以升高，并以400英尺的高度越过了山脉。
statements.english: The plane was then able to rise and it cleared the mountains by 400 feet.
Byrd now knew that he would be able to reach the South Pole which was 300 miles away, for there were no more mountains in sight.
statements.chinese: 伯德现在知道他将能够抵达300英里外的南极，因为视线中没有更多的山脉了。
飞机能够毫不费力地飞越无尽的白色平原。
statements.english: The aircraft was able to fly over the endless white plains without difficulty.

courses.title: Lesson 44: Through the Forest
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 10 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 安妮·斯特林夫人没有想到她所冒的风险，当时她追着两个男人跑过一片森林。
statements.english: Mrs. Anne Sterling did not think of the risk she was taking when she ran through a forest after two men.

statements.chinese: 当时她正和孩子们在森林边缘野餐，他们冲上前去，试图偷走她的手提包。
statements.english: They had rushed up to her while she was having a picnic at the edge of a forest with her children and tried to steal her handbag.

statements.chinese: 在搏斗中，包带断了。
statements.english: In the struggle, the strap broke.

statements.chinese: 两个男人拿着包，开始穿过树林跑。
statements.english: And with the bag in their possession, both men started running through the trees.

statements.chinese: 斯特林夫人非常生气，她追了上去。
statements.english: Mrs. Sterling got so angry that she ran after them.

statements.chinese: 她很快就上气不接下气了，但她继续跑。
statements.english: She was soon out of breath, but she continued to run.

statements.chinese: 当她追上他们时，她看到他们已经坐了下来，正在翻看包里的东西。
statements.english: When she caught up with them, she saw that they had sat down and were going through the contents of the bag.

statements.chinese: 于是她直接朝他们跑过去。
statements.english: So she ran straight at them.

statements.chinese: 那些男人吓坏了，扔下包就跑了。
statements.english: The men got such a fright that they dropped the bag and ran away.

statements.chinese: “包带需要修补了，”斯特林夫人后来说，“但他们什么也没偷走。”
statements.english: "The strap needs mending," said Mrs. Sterling later, "but they did not steal anything."

courses.title: Lesson 45: A Clear Conscience
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 9 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 萨姆是怎么把钱找回来的？
statements.english: How did Sam get his money back?

statements.chinese: 整个村子很快就知道一大笔钱丢了。
statements.english: The whole village soon learnt that a large sum of money had been lost.
Sam Benton, the local butcher, had lost his wallet while taking his savings to the post office.
statements.chinese: 当地屠夫萨姆·本顿在去邮局存钱的路上丢了钱包。

statements.english: Sam was sure that the wallet must have been found by one of the villagers, but it was not returned to him.
statements.chinese: 萨姆确信钱包一定是被村里人捡走了，但一直没有还给他。
三个月过去了，一天早上，萨姆在自家门外发现了他的钱包。
statements.english: Three months passed, and then one morning, Sam found his wallet outside his front door.
It had been wrapped up in newspaper and it contained half the money he had lost, together with a note which said: 'A thief, yes, but only 50 per cent a thief!'
statements.chinese: 钱包用报纸包着，里面有他丢失的一半钱，还有一张纸条，上面写着：“我是个小偷，但只算50%的小偷！”

statements.english: Two months later, some more money was sent to Sam with another note: 'Only 25 per cent a thief now!'
statements.chinese: 两个月后，又有一些钱连同另一张纸条寄给了萨姆：“现在我只算25%的小偷了！”
渐渐地，萨姆所有的钱都以这种方式还了回来。
statements.english: In time, all Sam's money was paid back in this way.

statements.chinese: 最后一张纸条写着：“我现在是100%的诚实人！”
statements.english: The last note said: 'I am 100 per cent honest now!'

courses.title: Lesson 46: Expensive and Uncomfortable
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 11 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 这个故事里的男人做了什么？
statements.english: What did the man in this story do?
When a plane from London arrived at Sydney airport, workers began to unload a number of wooden boxes which contained clothing.
statements.chinese: 当一架从伦敦起飞的飞机抵达悉尼机场时，工人们开始卸下一些装有衣服的木箱。
没有人能解释其中一个箱子异常沉重的原因。
statements.english: No one could account for the fact that one of the boxes was extremely heavy.

statements.chinese: 其中一个工人突然想到要打开那个箱子。
statements.english: It suddenly occurred to one of the workers to open up the box.

statements.chinese: 他对自己的发现感到震惊。
statements.english: He was astonished at what he found.

statements.chinese: 一个人躺在箱子里，在一堆羊毛制品上面。
statements.english: A man was lying in the box on top of a pile of woollen goods.

statements.chinese: 他被发现时非常惊讶，甚至没有试图逃跑。
statements.english: He was so surprised at being discovered that he did not even try to run away.
After he was arrested, the man admitted hiding in the box before the plane left London.
statements.chinese: 他被捕后，这个人承认在飞机离开伦敦之前藏进了箱子里。

statements.english: He had had a long and uncomfortable trip, for he had been confined to the wooden box for over eighteen hours.
statements.chinese: 他经历了一次漫长而不舒服的旅行，因为他被关在木箱里超过十八个小时。
这个人被勒令支付3,500英镑作为旅行费用。
statements.english: The man was ordered to pay ￡3, 500 for the cost of the trip.

statements.chinese: 一张机票的正常价格是2,000英镑！
statements.english: The normal price of a ticket is ￡2, 000!

courses.title: Lesson 47: A Thirsty Ghost
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 9 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 有什么证据证明有鬼？
statements.english: What evidence is there of a ghost?

statements.chinese: 伊恩·汤普森先生最近购买的一家酒吧正在出售。
statements.english: A public house which was recently bought by Mr.Ian Thompson is up for sale.

statements.chinese: 汤普森先生打算出售它，因为它闹鬼。
statements.english: Mr.Thompson is going to sell it because it is haunted.
He told me that he could not go to sleep one night because he heard a strange noise coming from the bar.
statements.chinese: 他告诉我，一天晚上他无法入睡因为他听到酒吧里传来奇怪的声音。

statements.english: The next morning, he found that the doors had been blocked by chairs and the furniture had been moved.
statements.chinese: 第二天早上，他发现门被椅子堵住了，家具也被挪动了。

statements.english: Though Mr.Thompson had turned the lights off before he went to bed, they were on in the morning.
statements.chinese: 虽然汤普森先生睡前关了灯，但早上却亮着。

statements.english: He also said that he had found five empty whisky bottles which the ghost must have drunk the night before.
statements.chinese: 他还说他发现了五个空威士忌酒瓶，一定是那个鬼前一天晚上喝光的。

statements.english: When I suggested that some villagers must have come in for a free drink, Mr.Thompson shook his head.
statements.chinese: 当我暗示说一定是一些村民过来免费喝酒时，汤普森先生摇了摇头。

statements.english: The villagers have told him that they will not accept the pub even if he gives it away.
statements.chinese: 村民们告诉他，即使他白送，他们也不会接受那家酒吧。

courses.title: Lesson 48: Did You Want to Tell Me Something
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 10 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 作者为什么变得非常担心？
statements.english: Why did the writer become very worried?

statements.chinese: 牙医总是在你无法回答的时候问问题。
statements.english: Dentists always ask questions when it is impossible for you to answer.

statements.chinese: 我的牙医刚刚拔掉我的一颗牙，并让我休息一会儿。
statements.english: My dentist had just pulled out one of my teeth and had told me to rest for a while.
I tried to say something, but my mouth was full of cotton wool.
statements.chinese: 我试图说些什么，但我的嘴里塞满了棉花。
他知道我收集火柴盒，问我我的收藏是否在增加。
statements.english: He knew I collected match boxes and asked me whether my collection was growing.

statements.chinese: 然后他问我哥哥怎么样，以及我是否喜欢我在伦敦的新工作。
statements.english: He then asked me how my brother was and whether I liked my new job in London.

statements.chinese: 回答这些问题时，我不是点头就是发出奇怪的声音。
statements.english: In answer to these questions I either nodded or made strange noises.

statements.chinese: 同时，我的舌头忙着寻找牙齿拔掉后的那个洞。
statements.english: Meanwhile, my tongue was busy searching out the hole where the tooth had been.

statements.chinese: 我突然感到非常担心，却什么也说不出来。
statements.english: I suddenly felt very worried, but could not say anything.
When the dentist at last removed the cotton wool from my mouth, I was able to tell him that he had pulled out the wrong tooth.
statements.chinese: 当牙医最终从我嘴里取出棉花时，我才得以告诉他他拔错了牙。

courses.title: Lesson 49: The End of a Dream
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 11 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 这个梦是怎样结束的呢？
statements.english: How did the dream end?
Tired of sleeping on the floor, a young man in Teheran saved up for years to buy a real bed.
statements.chinese: 德黑兰有个年轻人，他睡在地板上，感到厌倦，于是积蓄了好几年，买了一张真正的床。

statements.english: For the first time in his life, he became the proud owner of a bed which had springs and a mattress.
statements.chinese: 他生平第一次拥有了一张带弹簧和床垫的床，他为此感到十分自豪。

statements.english: Because the weather was very hot, he carried the bed on to the roof of his house.
statements.chinese: 因为天气很热，他便把床搬到了屋顶上。

statements.english: He slept very well for the first two nights, but on the third night, a storm blew up.
statements.chinese: 头两晚他睡得很好，但第三天晚上，暴风雨突然降临。
一阵狂风把床从屋顶上刮了下来，摔到了下面的院子里。
statements.english: A gust of wind swept the bed off the roof and sent it crashing into the courtyard below.
The young man did not wake up until the bed had struck the ground.
statements.chinese: 那个年轻人直到床撞到地上才醒过来。

statements.english: Although the bed was smashed to pieces, the man was miraculously unhurt.
statements.chinese: 尽管床摔成了碎片，但那个人却奇迹般地没有受伤。
他醒来时，仍然躺在床垫上。
statements.english: When he woke up, he was still on the mattress.
Glancing at the bits of wood and metal that lay around him, the man sadly picked up the mattress and carried it into his house.
statements.chinese: 他看了一眼周围的木头和金属碎片，伤心地抱起床垫，把它搬进了屋里。

statements.english: After he had put it on the floor, he promptly went to sleep again.
statements.chinese: 他把床垫放到地板上，便很快又睡着了。

courses.title: Lesson 50: Taken for a Ride
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 18 条逐句练习

statements.english: I love travelling in the country, but I don't like losing my way.
statements.chinese: 我喜欢在乡村旅行，但我不喜欢迷路。

statements.english: I went on an excursion recently, but my trip took me longer than I expected.
statements.chinese: 我最近去郊游了，但我的行程比我预期的要长。

statements.english: I'm going to Woodford Green, I said to the conductor as I got on the bus.
statements.chinese: 我要去伍德福德格林，我上车时对售票员说。
但我不知道它在哪里。
statements.english: But I don't know where it is.
I'll tell you where to get off, answered the conductor.
statements.chinese: 我会告诉你哪里下车，售票员回答。

statements.english: I sat in the front of the bus to get a good view of the countryside.
statements.chinese: 我坐在公共汽车的前面，以便更好地欣赏乡村景色。
公共汽车停了下来。
statements.english: the bus stopped.
Looking round, I realised with a shock that I was the only passenger left on the bus.
statements.chinese: 环顾四周，我惊讶地发现我是车上唯一剩下的乘客。

statements.english: You'll have to get off here, the conductor said.
statements.chinese: 你必须在这里下车，售票员说。
我们就到这儿了。
statements.english: This is as far as we go.

statements.chinese: 这里是伍德福德格林吗？
statements.english: Is this Woodford Green?

statements.chinese: 我问道。
statements.english: I asked.
Oh dear, said the conductor suddenly.
statements.chinese: 哦，天哪，售票员突然说。
我忘了让你下车了。
statements.english: I forgot to put you off.
It doesn't matter, I said, I'll get off here.
statements.chinese: 没关系，我说，我就在这里下车吧。

statements.english: We are going back now, said the conductor.
statements.chinese: 我们现在要回去了，售票员说。

statements.english: Well, in that case, I prefer to stay on the bus.
statements.chinese: 嗯，既然如此，我宁愿留在车上。
我回答道。
statements.english: I answered.

courses.title: Lesson 51: Reward for Virtue
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 13 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 休的节食为什么没有成功？
statements.english: Why did Hugh's diet not work?
My friend, Hugh, has always been fat, but things got so bad recently that he decided to go on a diet.
statements.chinese: 我的朋友休一直很胖，但最近情况变得如此糟糕，以至于他决定节食。
他一周前开始节食。
statements.english: He began his diet a week ago.

statements.chinese: 首先，他列出了一长串所有被禁止的食物。
statements.english: First of all, he wrote out a long list of all the foods which were forbidden.
The list included most of the things Hugh loves: butter, potatoes, rice, beer, milk, chocolate, and sweets.
statements.chinese: 清单上包括了休喜欢的大部分东西：黄油、土豆、米饭、啤酒、牛奶、巧克力和糖果。
昨天我去看望了他。
statements.english: Yesterday I paid him a visit.

statements.chinese: 我按响了门铃，毫不意外地看到休仍然和以前一样胖。
statements.english: I rang the bell and was not surprised to see that Hugh was still as fat as ever.

statements.chinese: 他把我带进他的房间，然后匆忙地把一个大包裹藏到书桌下。
statements.english: He led me into his room and hurriedly hid a large parcel under his desk.

statements.chinese: 显然他感到非常尴尬。
statements.english: It was obvious that he was very embarrassed.
When I asked him what he was doing, he smiled guiltily and then put the parcel on the desk.
statements.chinese: 当我问他在做什么时，他内疚地笑了笑，然后把包裹放在了书桌上。
他解释说他的节食计划太严格了，所以他偶尔需要奖励一下自己。
statements.english: He explained that his diet was so strict that he had to reward himself occasionally.

statements.chinese: 接着他给我看了包裹里的东西。
statements.english: Then he showed me the contents of the parcel.

statements.chinese: 里面有五大块巧克力和三袋糖果！
statements.english: It contained five large bars of chocolate and three bags of sweets!

courses.title: Lesson 52: A Pretty Carpet
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 13 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 我们刚搬进一所新房子。
statements.english: We have just moved into a new house.

statements.chinese: 我整个上午都在努力工作。
statements.english: And I have been working hard all morning.

statements.chinese: 我一直努力把我的新房间整理好。
statements.english: I have been trying to get my new room in order.

statements.chinese: 这并不容易，因为我拥有一千多本书。
statements.english: This has not been easy because I own over a thousand books.

statements.chinese: 更糟的是，房间相当小。
statements.english: To make matters worse, the room is rather small.

statements.chinese: 所以我暂时把书都放在了地板上。
statements.english: So I have temporarily put my books on the floor.

statements.chinese: 目前，它们占据了每一寸地板空间。
statements.english: At the moment, they cover every inch of floor space.

statements.chinese: 我甚至不得不踩着它们进出房间。
statements.english: And I actually have to walk on them to get in or out of the room.

statements.chinese: 不久前，我妹妹帮我把一个旧书柜搬上了楼。
statements.english: A short while ago, my sister helped me to carry one of my old bookcases up the stairs.

statements.chinese: 她走进我的房间，看到地板上摆满了书，大吃一惊。
statements.english: She went into my room and got a big surprise when she saw all those books on the floor.

statements.chinese: “这是我见过的最漂亮的地毯，”她说。
statements.english: "This is the prettiest carpet I have ever seen," she said.
She gazed at it for some time, then added, "You don't need bookcases at all.
statements.chinese: 她盯着它看了一会儿，然后补充道：“你根本不需要书柜。
你可以在空闲时间坐在这里看地毯。”
statements.english: You can sit here in your spare time and read the carpet."

courses.title: Lesson 53: Hot Snake
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 13 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 火灾是由什么引起的？
statements.english: What caused the fire?

statements.chinese: 消防队员终于扑灭了加利福尼亚州的一场森林大火。
statements.english: At last firemen have put out a big forest fire in California.

statements.chinese: 从那时起，他们一直在努力查明火灾是如何开始的。
statements.english: Since then, they have been trying to find out how the fire began.

statements.chinese: 森林火灾通常是由碎玻璃或人们随意丢弃的烟头引起的。
statements.english: Forest fires are often caused by broken glass or by cigarette ends which people carelessly throw away.
Yesterday the firemen examined the ground carefully, but were not able to find any broken glass.
statements.chinese: 昨天消防队员仔细检查了地面，但没能找到任何碎玻璃。
他们也相当确定不是烟头引起的火灾。
statements.english: They were also quite sure that a cigarette end did not start the fire.

statements.chinese: 然而，今天早上，一名消防队员偶然发现了起火原因。
statements.english: This morning, however, a firemen accidentally discovered the cause.

statements.chinese: 他发现了一条缠绕在16000伏高压电线上的蛇的残骸。
statements.english: He noticed the remains of a snake which was wound round the electric wires of a 16, 000-volt power line.

statements.chinese: 就这样，他解开了这个谜团。
statements.english: In this way, he was able to solve the mystery.

statements.chinese: 解释很简单，但非常不同寻常。
statements.english: The explanation was simple but very unusual.

statements.chinese: 一只鸟从地上抓起这条蛇，然后把它掉到了电线上。
statements.english: A bird had snatched up the snake from the ground and then dropped it on to the wires.

statements.chinese: 然后蛇缠绕在电线上。
statements.english: The snake then wound itself round the wires.

statements.chinese: 当它这样做时，它向地面发出了火花，这些火花立刻引发了一场火灾。
statements.english: When it did so, it sent sparks down to the ground and these immediately started a fire.

courses.title: Lesson 54: Sticky Fingers
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 14 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 早餐后我把孩子们送去学校，然后就去市场了。
statements.english: After breakfast I sent the children to school, and then I went to market.

statements.chinese: 我回到家时还很早。
statements.english: It was still early when I returned home.

statements.chinese: 孩子们在学校，我丈夫在上班，家里一片宁静。
statements.english: The children were at school, my husband was at work, and the house was quiet.

statements.chinese: 于是我决定做些蛋挞当下午茶。
statements.english: So I decided to make some tarts for tea.

statements.chinese: 不一会儿，我便忙着混合黄油和面粉，我的手很快就沾满了黏糊糊的糕点面团。
statements.english: In a short time I was busy mixing butter and flour, and my hands were soon covered with sticky pastry.

statements.chinese: 就在那一刻，电话铃响了。
statements.english: At exactly that moment, the telephone rang.

statements.chinese: 没有什么比这更烦人的了。
statements.english: Nothing could have been more annoying.

statements.chinese: 我用两根黏糊糊的手指拿起听筒，当我认出是贝茨太太的声音时，我感到很沮丧。
statements.english: I picked up the receiver between two sticky fingers, and was dismayed when I recognized the voice of Mrs. Bates.

statements.chinese: 我花了10分钟才说服她稍后再打回来。
statements.english: It took me 10 minutes to persuade her to ring back later.

statements.chinese: 最后，我挂断了听筒。
statements.english: At last, I hung up the receiver.

statements.chinese: 真是一团糟！
statements.english: What a mess!

statements.chinese: 我的手指上、电话上和门把手上都沾着糕点。
statements.english: There was pastry on my fingers, on the telephone, and on the door knobs.

statements.chinese: 我刚回到厨房，门铃就响了，声音大到足以把死人吵醒。
statements.english: I had no sooner got back to the kitchen than the doorbell rang loud enough to wake the dead.

statements.chinese: 这次是邮递员，他要我签收一封挂号信。
statements.english: This time it was the postman, and he wanted me to sign for a registered letter.

courses.title: Lesson 55: Not a Gold Mine
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 11 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 团队发现了什么？
statements.english: What did the team find?

statements.chinese: 最近，寻找失落宝藏的梦想差点成真。
statements.english: Dreams of finding lost treasure almost came true recently.
A new machine called 'The Revealer' has been invented and it has been used to detect gold which has been buried in the ground.
statements.chinese: 一种名为“揭示者”的新机器被发明出来并且它被用来探测埋在地下的黄金。
这台机器被用在海边的一个洞穴里，据说海盗曾在那儿藏匿黄金。
statements.english: The machine was used in a cave near the seashore where--it is said--pirates used to hide gold.

statements.chinese: 海盗们经常把黄金埋在洞穴里，然后却未能取走。
statements.english: The pirates would often bury gold in the cave and then fail to collect it.

statements.chinese: 带着这台新机器，一支搜索队进入洞穴，希望能找到埋藏的宝藏。
statements.english: Armed with the new machine, a search party went into the cave hoping to find buried treasure.

statements.chinese: 当机器显示地下有黄金时，搜索队的队长正在检查洞穴入口附近的泥土。
statements.english: The leader of the party was examining the soil near the entrance to the cave when the machine showed that there was gold under the ground.

statements.chinese: 队员们非常兴奋，挖了一个两英尺深的洞。
statements.english: Very excited, the party dug a hole two feet deep.

statements.chinese: 他们最终发现了一枚几乎毫无价值的小金币。
statements.english: They finally found a small gold coin which was almost worthless.

statements.chinese: 随后，队员们彻底搜查了整个洞穴，但除了一个空锡箱外什么也没找到。
statements.english: The party then searched the whole cave thoroughly but did not find anything except an empty tin trunk.

statements.chinese: 尽管如此，许多人仍然相信，“揭示者”很快会揭示出一些有价值的东西。
statements.english: In spite of this, many people are confident that 'The Revealer' may reveal something of value fairly soon.

courses.title: Lesson 56: Faster Than Sound
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 13 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 获胜的赛车开得有多快？
statements.english: How fast did the winning car go?

statements.chinese: 每年一度，都会举行一次老爷车比赛。
statements.english: Once a year, a race is held for old cars.

statements.chinese: 去年，许多汽车报名参加了这场比赛，比赛开始前气氛异常热烈。
statements.english: A lot of cars entered for this race last year and there was a great deal of excitement just before it began.

statements.chinese: 其中一辆最漂亮的车是劳斯莱斯“银灵”。
statements.english: One of the most handsome cars was a Rolls-Royce Silver Ghost.

statements.chinese: 最不寻常的车是一辆只有三个轮子的奔驰车。
statements.english: The most unusual car was a Benz which had only three wheels.

statements.chinese: 它建于1885年，是参赛车辆中最老的一辆。
statements.english: Built in 1885, it was the oldest car taking part.

statements.chinese: 在一阵阵巨大的轰鸣声之后，比赛开始了。
statements.english: After a great many loud explosions, the race began.

statements.chinese: 许多汽车在赛道上抛锚了，有些司机待在车底的时间比待在车里的时间还长！
statements.english: Many of the cars broke down on the course and some drivers spent more time under their cars than in them!

statements.chinese: 然而，有几辆车完成了比赛。
statements.english: A few cars, however, completed the race.

statements.chinese: 获胜的赛车达到了每小时40英里的速度——比任何竞争对手都要快得多。
statements.english: The winning car reached a speed of forty miles an hour -- much faster than any of its rivals.

statements.chinese: 在比赛结束时，它向下冲刺，司机费了很大的劲才把它停下来。
statements.english: It sped downhill at the end of the race and its driver had a lot of trouble trying to stop it.

statements.chinese: 这场比赛给每个人带来了极大的乐趣。
statements.english: The race gave everyone a great deal of pleasure.

statements.chinese: 它与现代汽车比赛大相径庭，但同样激动人心。
statements.english: It was very different from modern car races but no less exciting.

courses.title: Lesson 57: Can I Help You, Madam
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 12 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 女人得到了她想要的吗？
statements.english: Did the woman get what she wanted?

statements.chinese: 一个穿着牛仔裤的女人站在一家高档商店的橱窗前。
statements.english: A woman in jeans stood at the window of an expensive shop.
Though she hesitated for a moment, she finally went in and asked to see a dress that was in the window.
statements.chinese: 尽管她犹豫了片刻，但她最终还是走了进去，要求看一件陈列在橱窗里的连衣裙。
接待她的店员不喜欢她的穿着打扮。
statements.english: The assistant who served her did not like the way she was dressed.

statements.chinese: 他轻蔑地瞥了她一眼，告诉她那件连衣裙已经卖掉了。
statements.english: Glancing at her scornfully, he told her that the dress was sold.

statements.chinese: 女人气愤地走出商店，决定第二天惩罚那个店员。
statements.english: The woman walked out of the shop angrily and decided to punish the assistant next day.
She returned to the shop the following morning dressed in a fur coat, with a handbag in one hand and a long umbrella in the other.
statements.chinese: 第二天上午，她回到店里，穿了一件裘皮大衣，一只手拿着坤包，另一只手拿着一把长柄伞。

statements.english: After seeking out the rude assistant, she asked for the same dress.
statements.chinese: 找到那个无礼的店员后，她又问起那件连衣裙。
店员没有认出她，这次却殷勤地为她服务。
statements.english: Not realizing who she was, the assistant was eager to serve her this time.

statements.chinese: 他费了很大的劲儿才爬进橱窗去取那件连衣裙。
statements.english: With great difficulty, he climbed into the shop window to get the dress.

statements.chinese: 她一看就说不喜欢。
statements.english: As soon as she saw it, the woman said she did not like it.
She enjoyed herself making the assistant bring almost everything in the window before finally buying the dress she had first asked for.
statements.chinese: 她让店员把橱窗里几乎所有的东西都拿出来，最后才买了她第一次看中的那件连衣裙，以此来取乐。

courses.title: Lesson 58: A Blessing in Disguise
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 11 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 据说，弗林利这个小村庄里有一棵被诅咒的树。
statements.english: The tiny village of Frinley is said to possess a cursed tree.

statements.chinese: 由于这棵树在报纸上被提及，弗林利的游客数量现在增加了。
statements.english: Because the tree was mentioned in a newspaper, the number of visitors to Frinley has now increased.

statements.chinese: 这棵树是50年前种在教堂附近。
statements.english: The tree was planted near a church 50 years ago.

statements.chinese: 但只是在最近几年，它才获得了邪恶的名声。
statements.english: But it is only in recent years that it has gained an evil reputation.

statements.chinese: 据说，如果有人触摸这棵树，他就会遭遇厄运。
statements.english: It is said that if anyone touches the tree, he will have bad luck.

statements.chinese: 如果他摘一片叶子，他就会死去。
statements.english: If he picks a leaf, he will die.

statements.chinese: 许多村民相信这棵树已经夺走了许多受害者的生命。
statements.english: Many villagers believe that the tree has already claimed a number of victims.

statements.chinese: 牧师被要求砍掉这棵树，但到目前为止，他拒绝了。
statements.english: The vicar has been asked to have the tree cut down, but so far, he has refused.

statements.chinese: 他指出，这棵树是一个有用的收入来源，因为游客们从全国各地赶来看它。
statements.english: He has pointed out that the tree is a useful source of income, as tourists have been coming from all parts of the country to see it.

statements.chinese: 尽管如此，游客们仍然摘树叶，并在树干上刻下自己的名字。
statements.english: In spite of all that has been said, the tourists have been picking leaves and cutting their names on the tree trunk.

statements.chinese: 到目前为止，他们中没有一个人因猝死而倒下。
statements.english: So far, not one of them has been struck down by sudden death.

courses.title: Lesson 59: In or Out
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 12 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 雷克斯为什么跑了？
statements.english: Why did Rex run away?

statements.chinese: 我们的狗雷克斯，过去常常坐在前门外面吠叫。
statements.english: Our dog, Rex, used to sit outside our front gate and bark.

statements.chinese: 每次他想进花园时，都会吠叫，直到有人把门打开。
statements.english: Every time he wanted to come into the garden he would bark until someone opened the gate.

statements.chinese: 由于邻居们抱怨噪音，我丈夫花了几周时间训练他用爪子按压门闩，好让他自己进来。
statements.english: As the neighbours complained of the noise, my husband spent weeks training him to press his paw on the latch to let himself in.

statements.chinese: 雷克斯很快就成了开门的专家。
statements.english: Rex soon became an expert at opening the gate.

statements.chinese: 然而，上周我外出购物时，注意到他在花园里，靠近门的地方。
statements.english: However, when I was going out shopping last week, I noticed him in the garden near the gate.

statements.chinese: 这次他在吠叫，好让有人把他放出去！
statements.english: This time he was barking so that someone would let him out!

statements.chinese: 从那时起，他又养成了一个坏习惯。
statements.english: Since then, he has developed another bad habit.

statements.chinese: 他一从外面打开门，就走进花园，然后等着门关上。
statements.english: As soon as he opens the gate from the outside, he comes into the garden and waits until the gate shuts.

statements.chinese: 然后他坐着吠叫，直到有人把他放出去。
statements.english: Then he sits and barks until someone lets him out.

statements.chinese: 之后他立刻自己进来，又开始吠叫。
statements.english: After this he immediately lets himself in and begins barking again.

statements.chinese: 昨天我丈夫把门拆掉了，雷克斯非常生气，从那以后我们就再也没见过他了。
statements.english: Yesterday my husband removed the gate and Rex got so annoyed we have not seen him since.

courses.title: Lesson 60: The Future
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 14 条逐句练习

statements.english: At a village fair, I decided to visit a fortune teller called Madam Belinsky.
statements.chinese: 在一个乡村集市上，我决定去拜访一位算命师，她叫贝林斯基夫人。

statements.english: I went into her tent, and she told me to sit down.
statements.chinese: 我走进她的帐篷，她叫我坐下。

statements.english: After I had given her some money, she looked into a crystal ball and said: “A relation of yours is coming to see you.
statements.chinese: 在我给她一些钱之后，她看着一个水晶球，说：“你的一个亲戚要来看你。

statements.english: She will be arriving this evening and intends to stay for a few days.
statements.chinese: 她将于今晚抵达，并打算逗留几天。

statements.english: The moment you leave this tent, you will get a big surprise.
statements.chinese: 你一走出这个帐篷，你就会得到一个大大的惊喜。

statements.english: A woman you know well will rush towards you.
statements.chinese: 一个你很熟悉的女人会向你跑来。

statements.english: She will speak to you and then she will lead you away from this place.
statements.chinese: 她会和你说话，然后她会带你离开这个地方。

statements.english: That is all.”
statements.chinese: 就是这一切。”

statements.english: As soon as I went outside, I forgot all about Madam Belinsky because my wife hurried towards me.
statements.chinese: 我一出去，我就把贝林斯基夫人的一切都忘了，因为我妻子匆匆向我走来。
“你一直躲在哪里？”
statements.english: “Where have you been hiding?”

statements.chinese: 她不耐烦地问。
statements.english: she asked impatiently.
“Your sister will be here in less than an hour, and we must be at the station to meet her.
statements.chinese: “你妹妹就要来了，不到一个小时，我们必须到车站去接她。
我们已经迟到了。”
statements.english: We are late already.”
As she walked away, I followed her out of the fair.
statements.chinese: 当她走开时，我跟着她离开了集市。

courses.title: Lesson 61: Trouble with the Hubble
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 10 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 望远镜在太空有什么特别的重要性？
statements.english: What is the special importance of a telescope in space?
The Hubble telescope was launched into space by NASA on April 20, 1990 at a cost of over a billion dollars.
statements.chinese: 哈勃望远镜是1990年4月20日由美国宇航局发射升空的，耗资10多亿美元。
哈勃望远镜从一开始就出了毛病。
statements.english: Right from the start there was trouble with the Hubble.

statements.chinese: 它给我们发回的图片非常令人失望，因为它的主镜有缺陷！
statements.english: The pictures it sent us were very disappointing because its main mirror was faulty!
NASA is now going to put the telescope right, so it will soon be sending up four astronauts to repair it.
statements.chinese: 美国宇航局现在将把望远镜修复好，所以它很快将派4名宇航员上去修复它。
“奋进”号航天飞机将把宇航员送往哈勃。
statements.english: The shuttle Endeavour will be taking the astronauts to the Hubble.

statements.chinese: “奋进”号的一个机械臂将抓住望远镜并将其固定住，而宇航员则进行必要的修理。
statements.english: A robot-arm from the Endeavour will grab the telescope and hold it while the astronauts make the necessary repairs.
Of course, the Hubble is above the earth's atmosphere, so it will soon be sending us the clearest pictures of the stars and distant galaxies that we have ever seen.
statements.chinese: 当然，哈勃望远镜处于地球大气层之外，所以它很快将给我们发回我们从未见过的最清晰的恒星和遥远星系的图片。
哈勃望远镜将告诉我们许多关于宇宙的年龄和大小的信息。
statements.english: The Hubble will tell us a great deal about the age and size of the universe.

statements.chinese: 当你读到这里时，哈勃的“鹰眼”将已经给我们发回了成千上万张精彩的图片。
statements.english: By the time you read this, the Hubble's eagle eye will have sent us thousands and thousands of wonderful pictures.

courses.title: Lesson 62: After the Fire
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 10 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 火灾过后，村庄面临的危险是什么？
statements.english: What was the danger to the villages after the fire?

statements.chinese: 消防队员们同那场森林大火搏斗了将近3个星期才把火势控制住。
statements.english: Firemen had been fighting the forest fire for nearly three weeks before they could get it under control.

statements.chinese: 不久前，大树还覆盖着周围几英里长的乡村。
statements.english: A short time before, great trees had covered the countryside for miles around.

statements.chinese: 如今，烟雾依然从荒凉山丘的温暖地面上冉冉升起。
statements.english: Now, smoke still rose up from the warm ground over the desolate hills.
Winter was coming on and the hills threatened the surrounding villages with destruction, for heavy rain would not only wash away the soil but would cause serious floods as well.
statements.chinese: 冬天快到了，这些山丘威胁着周围的村庄，要将它们毁灭，因为大雨不仅会冲走泥土，还会引起严重的水灾。

statements.english: When the fire had at last been put out, the forest authorities ordered several tons of a special type of grass-seed which would grow quickly.
statements.chinese: 大火最终被扑灭后，森林管理机构订购了几吨很快就能生长的特殊草籽。
草籽由飞机大量地撒向地面。
statements.english: The seed was sprayed over the ground in huge quantities by aeroplanes.

statements.chinese: 飞机撒播草籽将近一个月后，天下起了雨。
statements.english: The planes had been planting seed for nearly a month when it began to rain.

statements.chinese: 然而，到那时许多地方的草已经生根了。
statements.english: By then, however, in many places the grass had already taken root.
In place of the great trees which had been growing there for centuries, patches of green had begun to appear in the blackened soil.
statements.chinese: 原本在那里生长了几个世纪的大树，如今在焦黑的泥土上开始出现一片片绿色。

courses.title: Lesson 63: She Was Not Amused
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 13 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 杰弗里·汉姆登的朋友圈很大，在派对上也很受欢迎。
statements.english: Jeffrey Hamden has a large circle of friends and is very popular at parties.

statements.chinese: 大家都因为他出色的幽默感而敬佩他。
statements.english: Everybody admires him for his fine sense of humor.

statements.chinese: 所有人都是如此，除了他六岁的女儿珍妮。
statements.english: Everybody, that is, except his six-year-old daughter, Jenny.

statements.chinese: 最近，杰弗里的一位密友请他在一个婚宴上致辞。
statements.english: Recently, one of Jeffrey's closest friends asked him to make a speech at a wedding reception.

statements.chinese: 这正是杰弗里喜欢做的事情。
statements.english: This is the sort of thing that Jeffrey loves.

statements.chinese: 他仔细准备了演讲稿，然后和珍妮一起去参加婚礼。
statements.english: He prepared the speech carefully and went to the wedding with Jenny.

statements.chinese: 他在演讲中加入了许多有趣的故事，当然，演讲非常成功。
statements.english: He had included a large number of funny stories in the speech, and of course, it was a great success.

statements.chinese: 演讲一结束，珍妮就告诉他她想回家。
statements.english: As soon as he had finished, Jenny told him she wanted to go home.

statements.chinese: 杰弗里对此有点失望，但他还是照他女儿的要求做了。
statements.english: Jeffrey was a little disappointed by this, but he did as his daughter asked.

statements.chinese: 在回家的路上，他问珍妮是否喜欢这次演讲。
statements.english: On the way home, he asked Jenny if she had enjoyed the speech.

statements.chinese: 令他惊讶的是，她说她不喜欢。
statements.english: To his surprise, she said she hadn't.

statements.chinese: 杰弗里问她为什么会这样。
statements.english: Jeffrey asked her why this was so.

statements.chinese: 她告诉他，她不喜欢看到那么多人嘲笑他。
statements.english: And she told him that she did not like to see so many people laughing at him.

courses.title: Lesson 64: The Channel Tunnel
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 12 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 为什么第一条隧道没有建成？
statements.english: Why was the first tunnel not completed?
In 1858, a French engineer, Aime Thome de Gamond, arrived in England with a plan for a 21-mile tunnel under the English Channel.
statements.chinese: 1858年，一位名叫埃梅·托梅·德·加蒙的法国工程师，带着修建一条21英里长的英吉利海峡隧道的计划抵达英国。
他说可以在海峡中央修建一个平台。
statements.english: He said that it would be possible to build a platform in the centre of the Channel.

statements.chinese: 这个平台将作为港口和火车站。
statements.english: This platform would serve as a port and a railway station.

statements.chinese: 如果在海平面以上修建高烟囱，隧道将能很好地通风。
statements.english: The tunnel would be well-ventilated if tall chimneys were built above sea level.

statements.chinese: 1860年，英国人威廉·洛提出了一个更好的方案。
statements.english: In 1860, a better plan was put forward by an Englishman, William Low.

statements.chinese: 他建议修建一条双轨铁路隧道。
statements.english: He suggested that a double railway-tunnel should be built.

statements.chinese: 这将解决通风问题，因为如果火车进入这条隧道，它会从后面吸入新鲜空气。
statements.english: This would solve the problem of ventilation for if a train entered this tunnel, it would draw in fresh air behind it.

statements.chinese: 四十二年后，一条隧道实际开始动工。
statements.english: Forty-two years later a tunnel was actually begun.

statements.chinese: 如果当时英国人没有害怕入侵，它就会建成。
statements.english: If, at the time, the British had not feared invasion, it would have been completed.

statements.chinese: 世界不得不又等了将近100年才等到英吉利海峡隧道。
statements.english: The world had to wait almost another 100 years for the Channel Tunnel.

statements.chinese: 它于1994年3月7日正式开通，最终将英国与欧洲大陆连接起来。
statements.english: It was officially opened on March 7, 1994, finally connecting Britain to the European continent.

courses.title: Lesson 65: Jumbo Versus the Police
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 11 条逐句练习

statements.english: Jumbo versus the Police.
statements.chinese: 巨象对战警察。

statements.english: Last Christmas, the circus owner, Jimmy Gates, decided to take some presents to a children's hospital.
statements.chinese: 去年圣诞节，马戏团老板，吉米·盖茨，决定带一些礼物去一家儿童医院。

statements.english: Dressed up as Father Christmas and accompanied by a guard of honour of six pretty girls, he set off down the main street of the city, riding a baby elephant called Jumbo.
statements.chinese: 打扮成圣诞老人，并由一支仪仗队陪同，由六个漂亮女孩组成，他沿着城市的主干道出发，骑着一头小象，名叫巨象。

statements.english: He should have known that the police would never allow this sort of thing.
statements.chinese: 他应该知道警察绝不会允许这种事情发生。

statements.english: A policeman approached Jimmy and told him he ought to have gone along a side street as Jumbo was holding up the traffic.
statements.chinese: 一名警察走近吉米并告诉他应该走一条小巷因为巨象阻碍了交通。

statements.english: Though Jimmy agreed to go at once, Jumbo refused to move.
statements.chinese: 尽管吉米同意立即离开，巨象却拒绝移动。

statements.english: Fifteen policemen had to push very hard to get him off the main street.
statements.chinese: 十五名警察不得不费力地推，才把他弄下主干道。

statements.english: The police had a difficult time, but they were most amused.
statements.chinese: 警察们费了好大劲，但他们都被逗乐了。

statements.english: "Jumbo must weigh a few tons," said a policeman afterwards, "So it was fortunate that we didn't have to carry him."
statements.chinese: “巨象一定有几吨重，”一名警察事后说道，“所以我们不必抬他真是万幸。”
“当然，我们应该逮捕他。
statements.english: "Of course, we should arrest him.
But as he has a good record, we shall let him off this time."
statements.chinese: 但由于他表现良好，我们就放过他这一次。”

courses.title: Lesson 66: Sweet as Honey
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 13 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 空中骑行。
statements.english: Cycling through the air.

statements.chinese: 赫特菲尔德海鹦号是一架现代飞机。
statements.english: The Hatfield Puffin is a modern aeroplane.
But its designer, Mr. John Wimpenny, is finding it difficult to get it off the ground.
statements.chinese: 但它的设计师，约翰·温彭尼先生，发现让它起飞很困难。
原因是这架飞机也是一辆自行车。
statements.english: The reason for this is that this plane is also a bicycle.

statements.chinese: 它的飞行员必须努力蹬踏板才能让它升空。
statements.english: Its pilot has to pedal hard to get it into the air.
After Mr. Wimpenny had the plane built, it was tested thoroughly.
statements.chinese: 温彭尼先生造好这架飞机后，它被彻底测试了。

statements.english: In 1961, it was the first man-powered aircraft to fly half a mile.
statements.chinese: 1961年，它是第一架飞行了半英里的人力飞机。

statements.english: While being flown by a champion amateur cyclist in 1963, the plane crashed on an airfield.
statements.chinese: 1963年，当它由一位业余自行车冠军驾驶时，这架飞机在机场坠毁了。
从那时起，温彭尼先生让人重建了它。
statements.english: Since then, Mr. Wimpenny has had it rebuilt.
He has had the length of the wings increased, so that they now measure 93 feet.
statements.chinese: 他让人加长了机翼的长度，使它们现在测量为93英尺。
几乎和达科他飞机的机翼一样长。
statements.english: Almost as long as those of a Dakota.

statements.chinese: 许多人对这项新奇而不寻常的运动表现出了兴趣。
statements.english: Many people have shown interest in this new and unusual sport.
But though air cyclists may learn how to fly over short distances, and may eventually even get across the English Channel, it is doubtful whether they will ever cycle across the Atlantic.
statements.chinese: 但是，尽管空中骑行者可能学会短距离飞行，甚至可能最终飞越英吉利海峡，但他们是否能骑自行车横渡大西洋，这是令人怀疑的。

courses.title: Lesson 67: Volcanoes
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 11 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 为什么塔齐耶夫要这样冒生命危险？
statements.english: Why does Tazieff risk his life like this?

statements.chinese: 波兰科学家哈伦·塔齐耶夫一生都在研究世界各地的活火山和深洞。
statements.english: Haroun Tazieff, the Polish scientist, has spent his lifetime studying active volcanoes and deep caves in all parts of the world.

statements.chinese: 1948年，他去了刚果的基伍湖，观察一座新火山，他后来将其命名为基图罗。
statements.english: In 1948, he went to Lake Kivu in the Congo to observe a new volcano which he later named Kituro.

statements.chinese: 塔齐耶夫在火山猛烈喷发时，能够把营地设在离火山很近的地方。
statements.english: Tazieff was able to set up his camp very close to the volcano while it was erupting violently.

statements.chinese: 尽管他设法拍了许多精彩的照片，但他不能在火山附近待太久。
statements.english: Though he managed to take a number of brilliant photographs, he could not stay near the volcano for very long.

statements.chinese: 他注意到一条液态岩石的河流正向他涌来。
statements.english: He noticed that a river of liquid rock was coming towards him.

statements.chinese: 它威胁要将他完全包围，但塔齐耶夫设法及时逃脱了。
statements.english: It threatened to surround him completely, but Tazieff managed to escape just in time.

statements.chinese: 他等到火山平静下来，两天后才得以返回。
statements.english: He waited until the volcano became quiet and he was able to return two days later.

statements.chinese: 这次，他设法爬进了基图罗的火山口，以便拍照和测量温度。
statements.english: This time, he managed to climb into the mouth of Kituro so that he could take photographs and measure temperatures.

statements.chinese: 塔齐耶夫经常以这种方式冒生命危险。
statements.english: Tazieff has often risked his life in this way.

statements.chinese: 他比任何在世的人都能告诉我们更多关于活火山的信息。
statements.english: He has been able to tell us more about active volcanoes than any man alive.

courses.title: Lesson 68: Persistent
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 18 条逐句练习

statements.english: I crossed the street to avoid meeting him, but he saw me and came running towards me.
statements.chinese: 我穿过马路，以免遇见他，但他看见了我，便朝我跑来。

statements.english: It was no use pretending that I had not seen him, so I waved to him.
statements.chinese: 假装没看见他已无用，于是我向他挥手。
我从不喜欢遇见伯特·戴克斯。
statements.english: I never enjoy meeting Bert Dykes.

statements.chinese: 他总是无所事事。
statements.english: He never has anything to do.
No matter how busy you are, he always insists on coming with you.
statements.chinese: 无论你有多忙，他总是坚持要和你一起去。

statements.english: I had to think of a way of preventing him from following me around all morning.
statements.chinese: 我得想个办法，阻止他整个上午都跟着我。
“你好，伯特，”我说，
statements.english: 'Hello, Bert,' I said.

statements.chinese: “真巧在这儿遇见你！”
statements.english: 'Fancy meeting you here!'

statements.chinese: “你好，伊丽莎白，”伯特回答。
statements.english: 'Hello, Elizabeth,' Bert answered.
'I was just wondering how to spend the morning until I saw you.
statements.chinese: “我正想着怎么打发上午的时间呢，直到我看到你。
你没在忙什么事吧？”
statements.english: You're not busy doing anything, are you?'

statements.chinese: “不，一点也不忙，”我回答。
statements.english: 'No, not at all,' I answered.

statements.chinese: “我正要去——你不介意我跟着你吧？”
statements.english: 'I'm going to—would you mind my coming with you?'

statements.chinese: 他在我话还没说完的时候就问道。
statements.english: he asked before I had finished speaking.

statements.chinese: “一点也不介意，”我撒谎道。
statements.english: 'Not at all,' I lied.

statements.chinese: “但我正要去牙医那里。”
statements.english: 'But I'm going to the dentist.'

statements.chinese: “那我跟你一起去，”他回答。
statements.english: 'Then I'll come with you,' he answered.

statements.chinese: “候诊室总有很多东西可以看。”
statements.english: 'There's always plenty to read in the waiting-room.'

courses.title: Lesson 69: But not Murder
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 13 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 你认为作者通过驾照考试了吗？为什么？
statements.english: Do you think that the writer passed his driving test? Why?

statements.chinese: 我第三次参加驾驶执照考试。
statements.english: I was being tested for a driving licence for the third time.

statements.chinese: 我被要求在车辆很多的道路上驾驶，并成功完成了。
statements.english: I had been asked to drive in heavy traffic and had done so successfully.

statements.chinese: 在被指示开出市区后，我开始有了信心。
statements.english: After having been instructed to drive out of town, I began to acquire confidence.

statements.chinese: 确信我已通过，我几乎开始享受我的考试了。
statements.english: Sure that I had passed, I was almost beginning to enjoy my test.

statements.chinese: 考官一定对我的表现很满意，因为他微笑着说：“还有一件事，伊姆斯先生。
statements.english: The examiner must have been pleased with my performance, for he smiled and said, 'Just one more thing Mr. Eames.

statements.chinese: 假设有个孩子突然从你车前跑过。
statements.english: Let us suppose that a child suddenly crosses the road in front of you.

statements.chinese: 我一敲车窗，你必须在五英尺内把车停住。”
statements.english: As soon as I tap on the window, you must stop within five feet.'

statements.chinese: 我继续驾驶，过了一会儿，考官大声敲击车窗。
statements.english: I continued driving and after some time, the examiner tapped loudly.

statements.chinese: 尽管声音听得很清楚，但我过了好一会儿才做出反应。
statements.english: Though the sound could be heard clearly, it took me a long time to react.

statements.chinese: 我猛地踩下刹车踏板，结果我们俩都被猛地向前甩去。
statements.english: I suddenly pressed the brake pedal hard and we were both thrown forward.

statements.chinese: 考官悲伤地看着我。
statements.english: The examiner looked at me sadly.

statements.chinese: “伊姆斯先生，”他用悲哀的声音说，“你刚才把那个孩子撞死了！”
statements.english: 'Mr. Eames,' he said, in a mournful voice, 'you have just killed that child!'

courses.title: Lesson 70: Red for Danger
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 11 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 醉汉是怎样被弄出斗牛场的？
statements.english: How was the drunk removed from the ring?

statements.chinese: 在一场斗牛中，一个醉汉突然晃晃悠悠地走进斗牛场中央。
statements.english: During a bullfight, a drunk suddenly wandered into the middle of the ring.

statements.chinese: 观众开始大叫，但醉汉全然不知危险。
statements.english: The crowd began to shout, but the drunk was unaware of the danger.
The bull was busy with the matador at the time, but it suddenly caught sight of the drunk who was shouting rude remarks and waving a red cap.
statements.chinese: 那时，公牛正忙着对付斗牛士，但它突然发现那个醉汉正在大声说粗话，挥舞着一顶红帽子。

statements.english: Apparently sensitive to criticism, the bull forgot all about the matador and charged at the drunk.
statements.chinese: 显然，公牛对批评很敏感，它把斗牛士忘得一干二净，径直向醉汉冲去。
观众突然鸦雀无声。
statements.english: The crowd suddenly grew quiet.

statements.chinese: 然而，那醉汉好像十分自信。
statements.english: The drunk, however, seemed quite sure of himself.

statements.chinese: 当公牛冲到他身边时，他笨拙地闪到一边，让公牛过去。
statements.english: When the bull got close to him, he clumsily stepped aside to let it pass.

statements.chinese: 观众爆发出阵阵喝彩声，醉汉则鞠躬致意。
statements.english: The crowd broke into cheers and the drunk bowed.

statements.chinese: 就在这时，3个人走进斗牛场，他们迅速把醉汉拖到安全地带。
statements.english: By this time, however three men had come into the ring and they quickly dragged the drunk to safety.
Even the bull seemed to feel sorry for him, for it looked on sympathetically until the drunk was out of the way before once more turning its attention to the matador.
statements.chinese: 好像连公牛都为他感到惋惜，它一直同情地看着，直到醉汉离开场地才再次把注意力转向斗牛士。

courses.title: Lesson 71: A Famous Clock
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 10 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 大本钟出过错吗？
statements.english: Has Big Ben ever gone wrong?
When you visit London, one of the first things you will see is Big Ben, the famous clock which can be heard all over the world on the B.B.C.
statements.chinese: 当你游览伦敦时，首先会看到的是大本钟，这个著名的钟，在BBC广播中全世界都能听到。

statements.english: If the Houses of Parliament had not been burned down in 1834, the great clock would never have been erected.
statements.chinese: 如果议会大厦在1834年没有被烧毁的话，这个大钟就永远不会被建造。
大本钟的名字来源于本杰明·霍尔爵士，他在建造新议会大厦时负责制造这个钟。
statements.english: Big Ben takes its name from Sir Benjamin Hall who was responsible for the making of the clock when the new Houses of Parliament were being built.

statements.chinese: 它不仅体积巨大，而且极其精确。
statements.english: It is not only of immense size, but is extremely accurate as well.

statements.chinese: 格林尼治天文台的官员每天检查这个钟两次。
statements.english: Officials from Greenwich Observatory have the clock checked twice a day.

statements.chinese: 在BBC广播中，当大本钟报时时，你可以听到它的声音，因为麦克风连接到了钟楼。
statements.english: On the B.B.C. you can hear the clock when it is actually striking because microphones are connected to the clock tower.

statements.chinese: 大本钟很少出错。
statements.english: Big Ben has rarely gone wrong.

statements.chinese: 然而，有一次它没能报出正确的时间。
statements.english: Once, however, it failed to give the correct time.

statements.chinese: 一位在钟楼上工作的画家把一罐颜料挂在了其中一根指针上，把它弄慢了！
statements.english: A painter who had been working on the tower hung a pot of paint on one of the hands and slowed it down!

courses.title: Lesson 72: A Car Called Bluebird
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 12 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 犯了什么错误？
statements.english: What mistake was made?

statements.chinese: 伟大的赛车手马尔科姆·坎贝尔爵士是第一个时速超过300英里的人。
statements.english: The great racing driver, Sir Malcolm Campbell, was the first man to drive at over 300 miles per hour.

statements.chinese: 他于1935年9月在犹他州博纳维尔盐滩创造了一项新的世界纪录。
statements.english: He set up a new world record in September 1935 at Bonneville Salt Flats, Utah.

statements.chinese: 他驾驶的赛车“蓝鸟”是专门为他制造的。
statements.english: Bluebird, the car he was driving, had been specially built for him.

statements.chinese: 它长30多英尺，配有2500马力的发动机。
statements.english: It was over 30 feet in length and had a 2, 500-horsepower engine.
Although Campbell reached a speed of over 304 miles per hour, he had great difficulty in controlling the car because a tyre burst during the first run.
statements.chinese: 尽管坎贝尔达到了每小时304英里以上的速度，但他很难控制赛车，因为在第一次行驶时，一个轮胎爆裂了。
尝试结束后，坎贝尔沮丧地得知他的平均速度是每小时299英里。
statements.english: After his attempt, Campbell was disappointed to learn that his average speed had been 299 miles per hour.

statements.chinese: 然而，几天后，他被告知犯了一个错误。
statements.english: However, a few days later, he was told that a mistake had been made.

statements.chinese: 他的平均速度是每小时301英里。
statements.english: His average speed had been 301 miles per hour.

statements.chinese: 从那时起，赛车手已经达到了每小时600英里以上的速度。
statements.english: Since that time, racing drivers have reached speeds over 600 miles an hour.

statements.chinese: 许多年后，马尔科姆爵士的儿子唐纳德也追随父亲的脚步，创造了一项世界纪录。
statements.english: Following in his father's footsteps many years later, Sir Malcolm's son, Donald, also set up a world record.

statements.chinese: 和他父亲一样，他驾驶的也是一辆名为“蓝鸟”的赛车。
statements.english: Like his father, he was driving a car called Bluebird.

courses.title: Lesson 73: The Record-Holder
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 12 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 那个男孩去他想去的地方了吗？
statements.english: Did the boy go where he wanted to?

statements.chinese: 逃学的孩子都缺乏想象力。
statements.english: Children who play truant from school are unimaginative.
A quiet days' fishing, or eight hours in a cinema seeing the same film over and over again, is usually as far as they get.
statements.chinese: 安静地钓上一天鱼，或者在电影院里看8小时的同一部电影，这通常是他们能做到的最大限度了。
然而，一个逃学竟走了1600英里的孩子使他们都相形见绌了。
statements.english: They have all been put to shame by a boy who, while playing truant travelled 1, 600 miles.

statements.chinese: 他搭便车到了多佛，傍晚时分进了一条船想找个地方睡觉。
statements.english: He hitchhiked to Dover and towards evening went into a boat to find somewhere to sleep.

statements.chinese: 第二天早晨醒来时，他发现那条船已行驶到加来。
statements.english: When he woke up next morning, he discovered that the boat had, in the meantime, travelled to Calais.

statements.chinese: 他悄悄溜下船时没人注意到他。
statements.english: No one noticed the boy as he crept off.

statements.chinese: 从那里，他又搭上一辆卡车去了巴黎。
statements.english: From there, he hitchhiked to Paris in a lorry.

statements.chinese: 司机给了他几块饼干和一杯咖啡，在城外把他放下了。
statements.english: The driver gave him a few biscuits and a cup of coffee and left him just outside the city.
The next car the boy stopped did not take him into the centre of Paris as he hoped it would, but to Perpignan on the French-Spanish border.
statements.chinese: 男孩拦的下一辆车并没有像他希望的那样把他带到巴黎市中心，而是带到了法国和西班牙边境上的佩皮尼昂。
在那里他被一个警察发现，然后当地政府把他遣送回了英国。
statements.english: There he was picked up by a policeman and sent back to England by the local authorities.

statements.chinese: 他无疑为成千上万梦想逃学的孩子们创造了一项纪录。
statements.english: He has surely set up a record for the thousands of children who dream of evading school.

courses.title: Lesson 74: Out of the Limelight
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 19 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 一辆老式公共汽车停在一条干涸的河床上，一群著名的男演员和女演员下了车。
statements.english: An ancient bus stopped by a dry river bed, and a party of famous actors and actresses got off.

statements.chinese: 他们戴着墨镜，穿着旧衣服，采取了特殊的预防措施，以免被人认出来。
statements.english: Dressed in dark glasses and old clothes, they had taken special precautions so that no one should recognize them.

statements.chinese: 但他们很快发现，伪装有时可能太完美了。
statements.english: But as they soon discovered, disguises can sometimes be too perfect.
This is a wonderful place for a picnic, said Gloria Gleam.
statements.chinese: 这里是野餐的好地方，格洛丽亚·格利姆说。
“再好不过了，格洛丽亚，”布林克斯利·米尔斯同意道。
statements.english: It couldn't be better, Gloria, Brinksley Meers agreed.

statements.chinese: 没有报社记者，没有影迷。
statements.english: No newspaper men, no film fans.

statements.chinese: 我们为什么不常来呢？
statements.english: Why don't we come more often?

statements.chinese: 同时，另外两名演员，洛克沃尔·斯林格和梅林·格里夫斯，提着两个大食物篮，走到树下的一片阴凉处。
statements.english: Meanwhile, two other actors, Rockwall Slinger and Merlin Greaves, had carried two large food baskets to a shady spot under some trees.

statements.chinese: 当他们都安顿好后，一个陌生人出现了。
statements.english: When they had all made themselves comfortable, a stranger appeared.

statements.chinese: 他看起来非常生气。
statements.english: He looked very angry.

statements.chinese: “你们现在都给我滚出去，所有人！”他喊道。
statements.english: Now you get out of here, all of you, he shouted.

statements.chinese: 我是这里的警长。
statements.english: I'm sheriff here.

statements.chinese: 你们看到那张告示了吗？
statements.english: Do you see that notice?

statements.chinese: 上面写着“禁止露营”，以防你们不识字。
statements.english: It says no camping, in case you can't read.

statements.chinese: “看，警长，”洛克沃尔说，“别对我们太苛刻了。”
statements.english: Look, sheriff, said Rockwall, don't be too hard on us.

statements.chinese: 我是洛克沃尔·斯林格，这是梅林·格里夫斯。
statements.english: I'm Rockwall Slinger, and this is Merlin Greaves.

statements.chinese: “哦，是吗？”警长嗤笑着说。
statements.english: Oh, is it? said the sheriff with a sneer.

statements.chinese: “嗯，我是布林克斯利·米尔斯，我的另一个名字是格洛丽亚·格利姆。”
statements.english: Well, I'm Brinksley Meers, and my other name is Gloria Gleam.

statements.chinese: “现在你们立刻给我滚出去。”
statements.english: Now you get out of here fast.

courses.title: Lesson 75: SOS
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 13 条逐句练习

statements.english: When a light passenger plane flew off course sometime ago, it crashed in the mountains, and its pilot was killed.
statements.chinese: 不久前，一架轻型客机偏离航线时，在山区坠毁，飞行员遇难。

statements.english: The only passengers, a young woman and her two baby daughters, were unhurt.
statements.chinese: 唯一的乘客，一位年轻的妇女和她两个年幼的女儿，都没有受伤。
当时正值隆冬。
statements.english: It was the middle of winter.

statements.chinese: 雪厚厚地覆盖着地面。
statements.english: Snow lay thick on the ground.

statements.chinese: 这位妇女知道最近的村庄在数英里之外。
statements.english: The woman knew that the nearest village was miles away.
When it grew dark, she turned a suitcase into a bed and put the children inside it, covering them with all the clothes she could find.
statements.chinese: 天黑后，她把一个手提箱变成了床，让孩子们睡在里面，用她能找到的所有衣服盖住他们。
夜间，天气变得异常寒冷。
statements.english: During the night, it got terribly cold.
The woman kept as near as she could to the children and even tried to get into the case herself, but it was too small.
statements.chinese: 这位妇女尽可能靠近孩子们，甚至试图自己钻进箱子里，但它太小了。

statements.english: The next morning, she heard planes passing overhead and wondered how she could send a signal.
statements.chinese: 第二天早上，她听到飞机从头顶飞过，疑惑自己如何发出信号。
然后她有了一个主意。
statements.english: Then she had an idea.

statements.chinese: 她在雪中踩出了SOS的字样。
statements.english: She stamped out the letters SOS in the snow.
Fortunately, a pilot saw the signal and sent a message by radio to the nearest town.
statements.chinese: 幸运的是，一名飞行员看到了信号，并通过无线电向最近的城镇发送了信息。

statements.english: It was not long before a helicopter arrived on the scene to rescue the survivors of the plane crash.
statements.chinese: 不久，一架直升机抵达现场，营救坠机幸存者。

courses.title: Lesson 76: April Fools' Day
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 13 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 笑话是什么？
statements.english: What was the joke?
'To end our special news bulletin,' said the voice of the television announcer, 'we're going over to the macaroni fields of Calabria.
statements.chinese: “为结束我们的特别新闻快报，”电视播音员的声音说道，“我们现在转向卡拉布里亚的通心粉田。”
通心粉在这片区域种植已有六百多年了。
statements.english: Macaroni has been grown in this area for over six hundred years.
Two of the leading growers Giuseppe Moldova and Riccardo Brabante, tell me that they have been expecting a splendid crop this year and harvesting has begun earlier than usual.
statements.chinese: 两位主要的种植者朱塞佩·摩尔多瓦和里卡尔多·布拉班特，告诉我他们今年预计会有一个丰收，而且收割比往常开始得早。

statements.english: Here you can see two workers who, between them, have just finished cutting three cartloads of golden brown macaroni stalks.
statements.chinese: 在这里你可以看到两位工人，他们俩，刚砍完了三车金黄色的通心粉茎。
整个村庄昼夜不停地收割和脱粒今年的庄稼，以赶在九月雨季之前。
statements.english: The whole village has been working day and night gathering and threshing this year's crop before the September rains.

statements.chinese: 在右边，你可以看到布拉班特夫人本人。
statements.english: On the right, you can see Mrs. Brabante herself.

statements.chinese: 她已经帮助她的丈夫三十年了。
statements.english: She has been helping her husband for thirty years now.

statements.chinese: 布拉班特夫人正在和当地加工庄稼的工厂经理交谈。
statements.english: Mrs. Brabante is talking to the manager of the local factory where the crop is processed.
This last scene shows you what will happen at the end of the harvest: the famous Calabrian macaroni-eating competition!
statements.chinese: 这最后一幕向你展示了收割结束后将发生的事情：著名的卡拉布里亚通心粉大赛！
现任冠军弗拉特利先生自1991年以来每年都赢得了比赛。
statements.english: Signor Fratelli, the present champion, has won it every year since 1991.

statements.chinese: 今天的特别快报到此结束，今天是4月1日星期四。
statements.english: And that ends our special bulletin for today, Thursday, April 1st.

statements.chinese: 我们现在回到演播室。”
statements.english: We're now going back to the studio.'

courses.title: Lesson 77: A Successful Operation
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 12 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 医生们查出这名妇女是怎么死的了吗？
statements.english: Did the doctors find out how the woman died?

statements.chinese: 一具死于公元前800年的埃及妇女木乃伊刚刚接受了一次手术。
statements.english: The mummy of an Egyptian woman who died in 800 B.C. has just had an operation.

statements.chinese: 这具木乃伊是谢芬姆特的，她曾是底比斯神庙里的一名歌手。
statements.english: The mummy is that of Shepenmut who was once a singer in the Temple of Thebes.
As there were strange marks on the X-ray plates taken of the mummy, doctors have been trying to find out whether the woman died of a rare disease.
statements.chinese: 由于对这具木乃伊X光片上有一些奇怪的印记，医生们一直在设法弄清这名妇女是否死于一种罕见的疾病。
唯一的方法就是进行手术。
statements.english: The only way to do this was to operate.
The operation, which lasted for over four hours, proved to be very difficult because of the hard resin which covered the skin.
statements.chinese: 手术持续了四个多小时，由于木乃伊的皮肤上覆盖着坚硬的树脂，手术做起来非常困难。
医生们取走了木乃伊的一小块，并把它送到了实验室。
statements.english: The doctors removed a section of the mummy and sent it to a laboratory.

statements.chinese: 他们还发现了一些X光片上没有显示出来的东西：一个小的、蜡制的杜穆特夫神像。
statements.english: They also found something which the X-ray plates did not show: a small wax figure of the god Duamutef.

statements.chinese: 这个长着牛头的神像通常被放置在木乃伊里面。
statements.english: This god which has the head of a cow was normally placed inside a mummy.

statements.chinese: 医生们尚未确定这名妇女是如何死亡的。
statements.english: The doctors have not yet decided how the woman died.
They feared that the mummy would fall to pieces when they cut it open, but fortunately this has not happened.
statements.chinese: 他们担心当他们切开木乃伊时，它会碎裂，但幸运的是，这种情况并没有发生。
这具木乃伊成功地经受住了这次手术。
statements.english: The mummy successfully survived the operation.

courses.title: Lesson 78: The Last One
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 14 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 作者戒烟戒了多久？
statements.english: For how long did the writer give up smoking?

statements.chinese: 读了一篇题为《吸烟与健康》的文章后，我点燃了一支香烟来镇定情绪。
statements.english: After reading an article entitled 'Cigarette Smoking and Your Health' I lit a cigarette to calm my nerves.

statements.chinese: 我聚精会神、津津有味地抽着，因为我确信这是我的最后一支香烟了。
statements.english: I smoked with concentration and pleasure as I was sure that this would be my last cigarette.

statements.chinese: 整整一个星期我根本没吸烟，在此期间我妻子可遭了大罪了。
statements.english: For a whole week I did not smoke at all and during this time my wife suffered terribly.

statements.chinese: 我具备了戒烟者的所有常见症状：脾气暴躁，胃口大开。
statements.english: I had all the usual symptoms of someone giving up smoking: a bad temper and an enormous appetite.

statements.chinese: 我的朋友们不断地给我递香烟和雪茄。
statements.english: My friends kept on offering me cigarettes and cigars.

statements.chinese: 每当我从口袋里掏出一包糖果时，他们都毫不掩饰地取笑我。
statements.english: They made no effort to hide their amusement whenever I produced a packet of sweets from my pocket.

statements.chinese: 这样过了7天，我参加了一个聚会。
statements.english: After seven days of this I went to a party.

statements.chinese: 我周围的人都在吸烟，我感到非常不舒服。
statements.english: Everybody around me was smoking and I felt extremely uncomfortable.

statements.chinese: 当我的老朋友布赖恩极力劝我抽一支烟时，我再也忍不住了。
statements.english: When my old friend Brian urged me to accept a cigarette, it was more than I could bear.

statements.chinese: 我内疚地拿了一支，点上，心满意足地抽了起来。
statements.english: I took one guiltily, lit it and smoked with satisfaction.

statements.chinese: 我妻子很高兴一切又恢复了正常。
statements.english: My wife was delighted that things had returned to normal once more.

statements.chinese: 不过，正如布赖恩指出的，戒烟是世界上最容易的事情。
statements.english: Anyway, as Brian pointed out, it is the easiest thing in the world to give up smoking.

statements.chinese: 他自己就戒过好多次了！
statements.english: He himself has done it lots of times!

courses.title: Lesson 79: By Air
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 12 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 飞机为什么返航了？
statements.english: Why did the plane turn back?

statements.chinese: 我小时候经常乘飞机旅行。
statements.english: I used to travel by air a great deal when I was a boy.

statements.chinese: 我父母过去住在南美洲，我放假时常从欧洲飞到那里。
statements.english: My parents used to live in South America and I used to fly there from Europe in the holidays.

statements.chinese: 乘务员会照顾我，我从未有过不愉快的经历。
statements.english: A flight attendant would take charge of me and I never had an unpleasant experience.

statements.chinese: 我习惯了乘飞机旅行，只有一次感到害怕。
statements.english: I am used to travelling by air and only on one occasion have I ever felt frightened.
After taking off, we were flying low over the city and slowly gaining height, when the plane suddenly turned round and flew back to the airport.
statements.chinese: 起飞后，我们低空飞过城市，慢慢爬升，飞机突然掉头飞回了机场。

statements.english: While we were waiting to land, a flight attendant told us to keep calm and to get off the plane quietly as soon as it had touched down.
statements.chinese: 当我们等待降落时，一位乘务员告诉我们要保持冷静，飞机一着陆就安静地下飞机。
飞机上的每个人都很担心，我们都很好奇发生了什么事。
statements.english: Everybody on board was worried and we were curious to find out what had happened.

statements.chinese: 后来我们得知飞机上有一位非常重要的人物。
statements.english: Later we learnt that there was a very important person on board.

statements.chinese: 警方接到报告说飞机上被安放了炸弹。
statements.english: The police had been told that a bomb had been planted on the plane.

statements.chinese: 飞机降落后，被彻底搜查了一番。
statements.english: After we had landed, the plane was searched thoroughly.

statements.chinese: 幸运的是，什么也没发现，五小时后我们得以再次起飞。
statements.english: Fortunately, nothing was found and five hours later we were able to take off again.

courses.title: Lesson 80: The Crystal Palace
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 12 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 有多少人参观了1851年的万国博览会？
statements.english: How many people visited the Great Exhibition of 1851?
Perhaps the most extraordinary building of the 19th century was the Crystal Palace which was built in Hyde Park for the Great Exhibition of 1851.
statements.chinese: 19世纪最不同寻常的建筑，或许就是水晶宫了，它是为1851年的万国博览会在海德公园建造的。
水晶宫与世界上所有其他建筑都不同，因为它是由钢铁和玻璃建造的。
statements.english: The Crystal Palace was different from all other buildings in the world, for it was made of iron and glass.

statements.chinese: 它是迄今为止最大的建筑之一，许多国家的人们都前来参观。
statements.english: It was one of the biggest buildings of all time and a lot of people from many countries came to see it.

statements.chinese: 许多商品从世界各地运到博览会展出。
statements.english: A great many goods were sent to the exhibition from various parts of the world.

statements.chinese: 还有大量机器展出。
statements.english: There was also a great deal of machinery on display.

statements.chinese: 展出的最精彩的机器是纳史密斯蒸汽锤。
statements.english: The most wonderful piece of machinery on show was Nasmyth's steam hammer.
Though in those days travelling was not as easy as it is today, steam boats carried thousands of visitors across the Channel from Europe.
statements.chinese: 尽管在那些日子里旅行不像今天这样容易，汽船还是载着成千上万的游客从欧洲渡过英吉利海峡。
抵达英国后，他们乘火车前往水晶宫。
statements.english: On arriving in England, they were, taken to the Crystal Palace by train.
There were six million visitors in all, and the profits from the exhibition were used to build museums and colleges.
statements.chinese: 总共有六百万游客，博览会的利润被用于建造博物馆和学院。
后来，水晶宫被搬到了伦敦南部。
statements.english: Later, the Crystal Palace was moved to South London.

statements.chinese: 它一直是世界上最著名的建筑之一，直到1936年被烧毁。
statements.english: It remained one of the most famous buildings in the world until it was burnt down in 1936.

courses.title: Lesson 81: Escape
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 15 条逐句练习

statements.english: When he had killed the guard, the prisoner of war quickly dragged him into the bushes.
statements.chinese: 当他杀死看守后，那个战俘迅速将他拖入灌木丛中。

statements.english: Working rapidly in the darkness, he soon changed into the dead man's clothes.
statements.chinese: 在黑暗中迅速行动，他很快换上了死者的衣服。

statements.english: Now, dressed in a blue uniform and with a rifle over his shoulders, the prisoner marched boldly up and down in front of the camp.
statements.chinese: 现在，穿着蓝色制服，肩上扛着步枪，那个战俘大胆地在营地前走来走去。
他能听到营地里传来叫喊声。
statements.english: He could hear shouting in the camp itself.
Lights were blazing, and men were running here and there.
statements.chinese: 灯火通明，人们四处奔跑。
他们刚刚发现一名囚犯越狱了。
statements.english: They had just discovered that a prisoner had escaped.
