At that moment, a large black car with four officers inside it, stopped at the camp gates.
statements.chinese: 就在那时，一辆载有四名军官的黑色轿车，停在了营地大门前。

statements.english: The officers got out, and the prisoner stood to attention and saluted as they passed.
statements.chinese: 军官们下了车，战俘立正敬礼，看着他们走过。

statements.english: When they had gone, the driver of the car came towards him.
statements.chinese: 当他们离开后，汽车司机朝他走来。
这个人显然想说话。
statements.english: The man obviously wanted to talk.

statements.chinese: 他年纪相当大，头发灰白，眼睛湛蓝清澈。
statements.english: He was rather elderly with grey hair and clear blue eyes.
The prisoner felt sorry for him.
statements.chinese: 那个战俘为他感到惋惜。
但他别无选择。
statements.english: But there was nothing else he could do.
As the man came near, the prisoner knocked him to the ground with a sharp blow.
statements.chinese: 当那个人靠近时，战俘用一个猛击把他打倒在地。

statements.english: Then, jumping into the car, he drove off as quickly as he could.
statements.chinese: 然后，他跳进车里，以最快的速度开车走了。

courses.title: Lesson 82: Monster or Fish
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 11 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 那个怪物叫什么名字？
statements.english: What was the monster called?

statements.chinese: 渔民和水手有时声称在海中见过怪物。
statements.english: Fishermen and sailors sometimes claim to have seen monsters in the sea.
Though people have often laughed at stories told by seamen, it is now known that many of these 'monsters' which have at times been sighted are simply strange fish.
statements.chinese: 尽管人们常常嘲笑水手们讲述的故事，但现在已知，这些有时被目击到的“怪物”很多只是奇怪的鱼。
偶尔，不寻常的生物会被冲到岸边，但它们很少在海上被捕获。
statements.english: Occasionally, unusual creatures are washed to the shore, but they are rarely caught out at sea.

statements.chinese: 然而，不久前，一条奇特的鱼在马达加斯加附近被捕获。
statements.english: Some time ago, however, a peculiar fish was caught near Madagascar.

statements.chinese: 当这条强壮的鱼拉扯鱼线时，一艘小渔船被拖离海岸数英里。
statements.english: A small fishing boat was carried miles out to sea by the powerful fish as it pulled on the line.

statements.chinese: 渔民意识到这不是一条普通的鱼，便竭尽全力不损坏它。
statements.english: Realizing that this was no ordinary fish, the fisherman made every effort not to damage it in any way.

statements.chinese: 当它最终被带到岸上时，发现它有十三英尺多长。
statements.english: When it was eventually brought to shore, it was found to be over thirteen feet long.

statements.chinese: 它有一个像马一样的头，大大的蓝眼睛，闪亮的银色皮肤和一条鲜红的尾巴。
statements.english: It had a head like a horse big blue eyes, shining silver skin, and a bright red tail.

statements.chinese: 这条鱼后来被送往博物馆，由科学家进行研究，它被称为皇带鱼。
statements.english: The fish, which has since been set to a museum where it is being examined by a scientist, is called an oarfish.

statements.chinese: 这种生物很少被人类活体发现，因为它们生活在六百英尺深的地方。
statements.english: Such creatures have rarely been seen alive by man as they live at a depth of six hundred feet.

courses.title: Lesson 83: After the Elections
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 14 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 帕特里克为什么一直问同一个问题？
statements.english: Why did Patrick keep on asking the same question?

statements.chinese: 前首相温特沃斯·莱恩先生在最近的选举中失利。
statements.english: The former Prime Minister, Mr. Wentworth Lane, was defeated in the recent elections.

statements.chinese: 他现在正退出政坛，并且已经出国了。
statements.english: He is now retiring from political life and has gone abroad.

statements.chinese: 我的朋友帕特里克一直是莱恩先生激进进步党的狂热反对者。
statements.english: My friend, Patrick, has always been a fanatical opponent of Mr. Lane's Radical Progressive Party.

statements.chinese: 选举结束后，帕特里克去了前首相的家。
statements.english: After the elections, Patrick went to the former Prime Minister's house.

statements.chinese: 当他问莱恩先生是否住在那儿时，值班警察告诉他，自从失利后，这位前首相就出国了。
statements.english: When he asked if Mr. Lane lived there, the policeman on duty told him that since his defeat, the ex-Prime Minister had gone abroad.

statements.chinese: 第二天，帕特里克又去了那所房子。
statements.english: On the following day Patrick went to the house again.

statements.chinese: 还是那个警察，他正慢慢地走过入口，这时帕特里克又问了同样的问题。
statements.english: The same policeman was just walking slowly past the entrance, when Patrick asked the same question.

statements.chinese: 尽管这次有些怀疑，警察还是给了他同样的答案。
statements.english: Though a little suspicious this time the policeman gave him the same answer.

statements.chinese: 第二天，帕特里克又一次去了那所房子，问了完全相同的问题。
statements.english: The day after, Patrick went to the house once more and asked exactly the same question.

statements.chinese: 这次，警察发火了。
statements.english: This time, the policeman lost his temper.
'I told you yesterday and the day before yesterday,' he shouted, 'Mr.Lane was defeated in the elections.
statements.chinese: “我昨天和前天都告诉你了，”他喊道，“莱恩先生在选举中失利了。
他已经退出政坛并出国定居了！”
statements.english: He has retired from political life and gone to live abroad!'

statements.chinese: “我知道，”帕特里克回答说，“但我喜欢听你说！”
statements.english: 'I know,' answered Patrick,' but I love to hear you say it!'

courses.title: Lesson 84: On Strike
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 14 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 下周谁来开公交车？
statements.english: Who will be driving the buses next week?

statements.chinese: 公交车司机们已决定下周举行罢工。
statements.english: Busmen have decided to go on strike next week.

statements.chinese: 罢工定于周二开始。
statements.english: The strike is due to begin on Tuesday.

statements.chinese: 没人知道罢工会持续多久。
statements.english: No one knows how long it will last.

statements.chinese: 公交车司机们声明，罢工将持续到在工资和工作条件方面达成普遍协议为止。
statements.english: The busmen have stated that the strike will continue until general agreement is reached about pay and working conditions.

statements.chinese: 大多数人认为罢工至少会持续一周。
statements.english: Most people believe that the strike will last for at least a week.

statements.chinese: 许多私家车车主将为上班族提供“免费搭车”服务。
statements.english: Many owners of private cars are going to offer 'free rides' to people on their way to work.

statements.chinese: 这将在一定程度上减轻火车的压力。
statements.english: This will relieve pressure on the trains to some extent.

statements.chinese: 同时，一些大学生已志愿在罢工期间驾驶公交车。
statements.english: Meanwhile, a number of university students have volunteered to drive buses while the strike lasts.
All the students are expert drivers, but before they drive any of the buses, they will have to pass a special test.
statements.chinese: 所有学生都是驾驶专家，但在他们驾驶任何公交车之前，他们必须通过一项特殊的考试。
学生们将在两天后参加考试。
statements.english: The students are going to take the test in two days' time.

statements.chinese: 即使如此，人们仍然会发现上班很困难。
statements.english: Even so, people are going to find it difficult to get to work.

statements.chinese: 但到目前为止，公众已通过写信给报社的方式表达了对学生的感激之情。
statements.english: But so far, the public has expressed its gratitude to the students in lettters to the Press.

statements.chinese: 只有一两个人反对，认为学生们会开得太快！
statements.english: Only one or two people have objected that the students will drive too fast!

courses.title: Lesson 85: Never Too Old To Learn
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 10 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 佩奇先生教书多久了？
statements.english: How long has Mr. Page been teaching?

statements.chinese: 我刚收到母校的一封信，通知我我们以前的校长斯图尔特·佩奇先生下周就要退休了。
statements.english: I have just received a letter from my old school, informing me that my former headmaster, Mr. Stuart Page, will be retiring next week.

statements.chinese: 学校的新老学生将送他一份礼物，以示纪念。
statements.english: Pupils of the school old and new, will be sending him a present to mark the occasion.

statements.chinese: 所有为这份礼物捐款的人都将在一个大相册上签名，这个相册将寄到校长家中。
statements.english: All those who have contributed towards the gift will sign their names in a large album which will be sent to the headmaster's home.

statements.chinese: 我们都会记住佩奇先生的耐心和理解，以及当我们不情愿地去上学时他给予我们的亲切鼓励。
statements.english: We shall all remember Mr. Page for his patience and understanding and for the kindly encouragement he gave us when we went so unwillingly to school.

statements.chinese: 许多以前的学生将于下周四出席为他举行的告别晚宴。
statements.english: A great many former pupils will be attending a farewell dinner in his honour next Thursday.

statements.chinese: 巧合的是，在他退休的前一天，佩奇先生教书的总时长将满四十年。
statements.english: It is a curious coincidence that the day before his retirement, Mr. Page will have been teaching for a total of forty years.

statements.chinese: 退休后，他将致力于园艺。
statements.english: After he has retired he will devote himself to gardening.

statements.chinese: 对他来说，这将是一个全新的爱好。
statements.english: For him, this will be an entirely new hobby.

statements.chinese: 但这无关紧要，因为正如他常说的，活到老学到老。
statements.english: But this does not matter, for, as he has often remarked, one is never too old to learn.

courses.title: Lesson 86: Out of Control
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 13 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 危险是什么？
statements.english: What was the danger?

statements.chinese: 当那人试图把快艇转弯时，方向盘脱落在他手中。
statements.english: As the man tried to swing the speedboat round, the steering wheel came away in his hands.

statements.chinese: 他绝望地向他的同伴挥手，他的同伴在过去的15分钟里一直在滑水。
statements.english: He waved desperately to his companion, who had been water skiing for the last fifteen minutes.

statements.chinese: 两名男子还没来得及意识到发生了什么，就被猛地甩进海里。
statements.english: Both men had hardly had time to realize what was happening when they were thrown violently into the sea.

statements.chinese: 快艇撞上了一个浮标，但它仍然在水面上快速行驶。
statements.english: The speedboat had struck a buoy, but it continued to move very quickly across the water.
Both men had just begun to swim towards the shore, when they noticed with dismay that the speedboat was moving in a circle.
statements.chinese: 两名男子刚开始向岸边游去，却沮丧地发现快艇正在画圈行驶。
它现在以惊人的速度径直朝他们冲来。
statements.english: It now came straight towards them at tremendous speed.

statements.chinese: 不到一分钟，它咆哮着从他们身边几英尺的地方冲过。
statements.english: In less than a minute, it roared past them only a few feet away.

statements.chinese: 快艇驶过之后，他们尽力快速向前游，因为他们知道快艇很快就会回来。
statements.english: After it had passed, they swam on as quickly as they could because they knew that the boat would soon return.

statements.chinese: 他们刚来得及游出危险区域，快艇又完成了一圈。
statements.english: They had just had enough time to swim out of danger when the boat again completed a circle.

statements.chinese: 然而，这一次，它已经明显减速了。
statements.english: On this occasion, however, it had slowed down considerably.

statements.chinese: 汽油差不多用完了。
statements.english: The petrol had nearly all been used up.

statements.chinese: 不久，噪音完全消失了，快艇开始在水面上轻轻地漂浮。
statements.english: Before long, the noise dropped completely and the boat began to drift gently across the water.

courses.title: Lesson 87: A Perfect Alibi
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 16 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 这个人的话有什么漏洞？
statements.english: What was wrong with the man's story?

statements.chinese: “在谋杀发生的时候，我正坐8点钟的火车去伦敦。”那人说。
statements.english: 'At the time the murder was committed, I was travelling on the 8 o'clock train to London,' said the man.

statements.chinese: “你总是赶这么早的火车吗？”探长问。
statements.english: 'Do you always catch such an early train?' asked the inspector.

statements.chinese: “我当然是。”那人回答。
statements.english: 'Of course I do,' answered the man.

statements.chinese: “我10点钟必须上班。
statements.english: 'I must be at work at 10 o'clock.

statements.chinese: 我的雇主可以证明我准时到了那里。”
statements.english: My employer will confirm that I was there on time.'

statements.chinese: “晚一点的火车也能让你准时上班吗？”探长问。
statements.english: 'Would a later train get you to work on time?' asked the inspector.

statements.chinese: “我想是的，但我从不赶晚一点的火车。”
statements.english: 'I suppose it would, but I never catch a later train.'

statements.chinese: “你什么时候到车站的？”
statements.english: 'At what time did you arrive at the station?'

statements.chinese: “7点50分。我买了一份报纸，然后等火车。”
statements.english: 'At ten to eight. I bought a paper and waited for the train.'

statements.chinese: “你没注意到什么不寻常的事情吗？”
statements.english: 'And you didn't notice anything unusual?'

statements.chinese: “当然没有。”
statements.english: 'Of course not.'

statements.chinese: “我猜想，”探长说，“你没有说实话。
statements.english: 'I suggest,' said the inspector,' that you are not telling the truth.
I suggest that you did not catch the 8 o'clock train, but that you caught the 8.25 which would still get you to work on time.
statements.chinese: 我猜想你并没有赶上8点钟的火车，而是赶了8点25分的火车，那也能让你准时上班。
你看，在谋杀发生的那天早上，8点钟的火车根本就没有开。
statements.english: You see, on the morning of the murder, the 8 o'clock train did not run at all.

statements.chinese: 它在弗恩格林车站出了故障，被拉下了线路。”
statements.english: It broke down at Ferngreen station and was taken off the line.'

courses.title: Lesson 88: Trapped in a Mine
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 13 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 为什么救援用了这么长时间？
statements.english: Why is the rescue taking so long?

statements.chinese: 六名男子被困在矿井里已经十七个小时了。
statements.english: Six men have been trapped in a mine for seventeen hours.

statements.chinese: 如果他们不尽快被带到地面，他们可能会失去生命。
statements.english: If they are not brought to the surface soon they may lose their lives.

statements.chinese: 然而，救援行动进展困难。
statements.english: However, rescue operations are proving difficult.

statements.chinese: 如果使用炸药，震动将导致矿井顶部坍塌。
statements.english: If explosives are used, vibrations will cause the roof of the mine to collapse.

statements.chinese: 因此，救援人员正在矿井北侧钻一个洞。
statements.english: Rescue workers are therefore drilling a hole on the north side of the mine.

statements.chinese: 他们打算用一个特殊的胶囊将这些人带上来。
statements.english: They intend to bring the men up in a special capsule.
If there had not been a hard layer of rock beneath the soil, they would have completed the job in a few hours.
statements.chinese: 如果土壤下面没有一层坚硬的岩石，他们几个小时就能完成这项工作。
事实上，他们已经钻了16个小时，还有很长的路要走。
statements.english: As it is, they have been drilling for 16 hours and they still have a long way to go.
Meanwhile, a microphone, which was lowered into the mine two hours ago, has enabled the men to keep in touch with their closest relatives.
statements.chinese: 同时，两个小时前被放入矿井的麦克风，使这些男子能够与他们最亲近的亲属保持联系。

statements.english: Though they are running out of food and drink, the men are cheerful and confident that they will get out soon.
statements.chinese: 尽管他们的食物和饮用水即将耗尽，这些男子仍然很乐观，并相信他们很快就能出来。
他们被告知救援行动进展顺利。
statements.english: They have been told that rescue operations are progressing smoothly.

statements.chinese: 如果他们知道钻穿坚硬的岩石有多困难，他们就会灰心丧气。
statements.english: If they knew how difficult it was to drill through the hard rock, they would lose heart.

courses.title: Lesson 89: A Slip of the Tongue
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 10 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 谁在那个晚上讲了唯一一个好笑的笑话，为什么？
statements.english: Who made the only funny joke that evening and why?

statements.chinese: 人们会不惜一切去看免费演出——即使演出很糟糕。
statements.english: People will do anything to see a free show--even if it is a bad one.
When the news got round that a comedy show would be presented at our local cinema by the P. and U. Bird Seed Company, we all rushed to see it.
statements.chinese: 当喜剧表演将在当地电影院上演的消息传开时由P. and U. 鸟食公司在当地电影院呈现时，我们都抢着去看。
我们排了几个小时的队才进去，演出开始前肯定有几百人到场。
statements.english: We had to queue for hours to get in and there must have been several hundred people present just before the show began.

statements.chinese: 不幸的是，这场演出是我们看过的最乏味的一场。
statements.english: Unfortunately, the show was one of the dullest we have ever seen.
Those who failed to get in need not have felt disappointed, as many of the artistes who should have appeared did not come.
statements.chinese: 那些没能进去的人大可不必感到失望，因为许多本应出席的艺人都没有来。
那个晚上我们听到的唯一有趣的事情，来自节目开始时的广告商。
statements.english: The only funny things we heard that evening came from the advertiser at the beginning of the programme.

statements.chinese: 他显然非常紧张，几分钟内尴尬地站在麦克风前。
statements.english: He was obviously very nervous and for some minutes stood awkwardly before the microphone.

statements.chinese: 他一开口，每个人都哈哈大笑起来。
statements.english: As soon as he opened his mouth, everyone burst out laughing.
We all know what the poor man should have said, but what he actually said was: 'This is the Poo and Ee Seed Bird Company. Good ladies, evening and gentlemen!'
statements.chinese: 我们都知道这位可怜人本该说什么，但他实际说的是：“这是噗和咿鸟食公司。女士们，晚上好，先生们！”

courses.title: Lesson 90: What's for Supper
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 10 条逐句练习

statements.english: Brasilia Though Brazil is one of the richest countries in the world, much of it has not yet been developed.
statements.chinese: 巴西利亚尽管巴西是世界上最富有的国家之一，但其中很大一部分尚未得到开发。

statements.english: It was mainly for this reason that the Brazilian government decided to have a new city built 600 miles northwest of Rio de Janeiro.
statements.chinese: 主要就是因为这个原因，巴西政府决定在里约热内卢西北600英里处建造一座新城市。

statements.english: Designed by the great architect Lucio Costa, the new city, Brasilia, replaced Rio de Janeiro as the capital of Brazil Brasilia has been carefully planned for modern living.
statements.chinese: 由伟大的建筑师卢西奥·科斯塔设计，这座新城市，巴西利亚，于1960年取代里约热内卢成为巴西首都。巴西利亚经过精心规划，以适应现代生活。

statements.english: Its wide roads, which can take 14 lanes of traffic, have been kept away from living areas.
statements.chinese: 它的宽阔道路可容纳14车道，并远离居住区。
孩子们上学不必穿过繁忙的街道。
statements.english: Children do not have to cross busy streets to go to school.
Housewives can visit shopping centers on foot, for in these specially designed living areas, cars are unnecessary.
statements.chinese: 家庭主妇可以步行前往购物中心，因为在这些特别设计的居住区，汽车是不必要的。

statements.english: At first, the government had great difficulty in persuading people to leave Rio and to settle in Brasilia.
statements.chinese: 起初，政府在说服人们离开里约并定居巴西利亚方面遇到了很大的困难。

statements.english: Since 1960, however, the population has been growing all the time.
statements.chinese: 然而，自1960年以来，人口一直在增长。
巴西利亚已迅速确立了其作为国家首都的地位。
statements.english: Brasilia has quickly established itself as the capital of the country.
The idea to have the capital moved so far inland will have a great effect on the future of Brazil.
statements.chinese: 将首都迁至如此内陆地区的想法将对巴西的未来产生巨大影响。

courses.title: Lesson 91: Three Men in a Basket
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 14 条逐句练习

statements.english: A pilot noticed a balloon which seemed to be making for a Royal Air Force station nearby.
statements.chinese: 一名飞行员注意到一个气球似乎正飞向附近的一个英国皇家空军基地。
他立即通知了基地。
statements.english: He informed the station at once.

statements.chinese: 但那里没有人能解释这个谜团。
statements.english: But no one there was able to explain the mystery.
The officer in the control tower was very angry when he heard the news because balloons can be a great danger to aircraft.
statements.chinese: 控制塔里的官员听到这个消息时非常生气，因为气球对飞机来说是巨大的危险。
他说可能有人在监视基地。
statements.english: He said that someone might be spying on the station.

statements.chinese: 飞行员奉命追踪这个奇怪的物体。
statements.english: And the pilot was ordered to keep track of the strange object.

statements.chinese: 飞行员设法绕着气球盘旋了一段时间。
statements.english: The pilot managed to circle the balloon for some time.
He could make out three men in a basket under it, and one of them was holding field glasses.
statements.chinese: 他能辨认出气球下面的篮子里有三个人，其中一人拿着望远镜。

statements.english: When the balloon was over the station, the pilot saw one of the men taking photographs.
statements.chinese: 当气球飞到基地上方时，飞行员看到其中一人在拍照。

statements.english: Soon afterwards, the balloon began to descend and it landed near an airfield.
statements.chinese: 随后，气球开始下降，降落在一个机场附近。
警方被召来。
statements.english: The police were called in.

statements.chinese: 但他们无法逮捕任何人。
statements.english: But they could not arrest anyone.
For the basket contained two members of Parliament and the commanding officer of the station.
statements.chinese: 因为篮子里载有两名议员和基地指挥官。

statements.english: As the commanding officer explained later, one half of the station did not know what the other half was doing.
statements.chinese: 正如指挥官后来解释的那样，基地的一半人不知道另一半人在做什么。

courses.title: Lesson 92: Asking for Trouble
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 15 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 警察为什么要叫这位作者到警察局去？
statements.english: Why did the policeman ask the writer to come to the police station?

statements.chinese: 我回到家时，大约是凌晨两点钟。
statements.english: It must have been about two in the morning when I returned home.
I tried to wake up my wife by ringing the doorbell, but she was fast asleep, so I got a ladder from the shed in the garden, put it against the wall, and began climbing towards the bedroom window.
statements.chinese: 我按门铃想叫醒我的妻子，但她睡得很熟，于是我从花园的小屋里搬来一架梯子，把它靠在墙上，开始朝着卧室的窗户爬去。
我快爬到窗户时，下面传来一个挖苦人的声音：
statements.english: I was almost there when a sarcastic voice below said.

statements.chinese: “我认为窗户在夜间这个时候不需要擦洗。”
statements.english: 'I don't think the windows need cleaning at this time of the night.'

statements.chinese: 我向下看去，当看到一个警察时，我差点从梯子上掉下来。
statements.english: I looked down and nearly fell off the ladder when I saw a policeman.

statements.chinese: 我马上后悔不该那样回答，但我还是说：“我喜欢在夜间擦洗窗户。”
statements.english: I immediately regretted answering in the way I did, but I said, 'I enjoy cleaning windows at night.'

statements.chinese: “我也喜欢，”警察用同样的声调回答说。
statements.english: 'So do I,' answered the policeman in the same tone.

statements.chinese: “请原谅我打断你一下。
statements.english: Excuse my interrupting you.

statements.chinese: 我不愿意打断一个正在忙碌的人，但你介意跟我到警察局去一趟吗？”
statements.english: I hate to interrupt a man when he's busy working, but would you mind coming with me to the station?'

statements.chinese: “嗯，我宁愿呆在这儿，”我说。
statements.english: 'Well, I'd prefer to stay here,' I said.

statements.chinese: “您瞧，我忘了带钥匙。”
statements.english: 'You see, I've forgotten my key.'

statements.chinese: “你的什么？”他大声问。
statements.english: 'Your what?' he called.

statements.chinese: “我的钥匙！”我喊道。
statements.english: 'My key,' I shouted.

statements.chinese: 幸运的是，我的喊叫声把妻子吵醒了，她打开窗户，而此时那个警察刚开始向我爬过来。
statements.english: Fortunately, the shouting woke up my wife who opened the window just as the policeman had started to climb towards me.

courses.title: Lesson 93: A Noble Gift
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 10 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 自由女神像是在哪里制造的？
statements.english: Where was the Statue of Liberty made?
One of the most famous monuments in the world, the Statue of Liberty, was presented to the USA in the nineteenth century by the people of France.
statements.chinese: 世界上最著名的纪念碑之一，自由女神像，在十九世纪由法国人民赠送给美国。
这座由雕塑家奥古斯特·巴托尔迪设计的宏伟雕像，花了十年才完成。
statements.english: The great statue, which was designed by the sculptor Auguste Bartholdi, took ten years to complete.

statements.chinese: 实际雕像由铜制成，由埃菲尔专门建造的金属框架支撑。
statements.english: The actual figure was made of copper supported by a metal framework which had been especially constructed by Eiffel.
Before it could be transported to the United States, a site had to be found for it and a pedestal had to be built.
statements.chinese: 在它被运往美国之前，必须为它找到一个地点并建造一个基座。
所选地点是纽约港入口处的一个岛屿。
statements.english: The site chosen was an island at the entrance of New York Harbour.

statements.chinese: 到1884年，一座151英尺高的雕像已在巴黎建成。
statements.english: By 1884, a statue which was 151 feet tall had been erected in Paris.

statements.chinese: 次年，它被拆解并运往美国。
statements.english: The following year, it was taken to pieces and sent to America.
By the end of October 1886, the statue had been put together again and it was officially presented to the American people by Bartholdi.
statements.chinese: 到1886年10月底，雕像已被重新组装，并由巴托尔迪正式赠送给美国人民。

statements.english: Ever since then, the great monument has been a symbol of liberty for the millions of people who have passed through New York Harbour to make their homes in America.
statements.chinese: 从那时起，这座伟大的纪念碑一直是自由的象征，对数百万穿过纽约港来美国安家的人们来说。

courses.title: Lesson 94: Future Champions
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 12 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 孩子们参加的是哪种比赛？
statements.english: What kind of race do the children compete in?

statements.chinese: 实验证明，孩子们可以在很小的时候就被教导游泳。
statements.english: Experiments have proved that children can be instructed in swimming at a very early age.
At a special swimming pool in Los Angeles, children become expert at holding their breath under water even before they can walk.
statements.chinese: 在洛杉矶的一个特殊游泳池里，孩子们甚至在学会走路之前就能熟练地在水下憋气。
两个月大的婴儿似乎并不抵触下水。
statements.english: Babies of two months old do not appear to be reluctant to enter the water.

statements.chinese: 没过多久，他们就非常适应游泳了，甚至能从泳池底部捡起重物。
statements.english: It is not long before they are so accustomed to swimming that they can pick up weights from the floor of the pool.

statements.chinese: 这些小泳者非常喜欢的一项游戏是水下三轮车比赛。
statements.english: A game that is very popular with these young swimmers is the underwater tricycle race.

statements.chinese: 三轮车排成一列，放置在水下七英尺深的泳池底部。
statements.english: Tricycles are lined up on the floor of the pool seven feet under water.

statements.chinese: 孩子们互相竞争，看谁先到达泳池的另一端。
statements.english: The children compete against each other to reach the other end of the pool.

statements.chinese: 许多孩子会蹬他们的三轮车，但大多数人更喜欢推或拖它们。
statements.english: Many pedal their tricycles but most of them prefer to push or drag them.

statements.chinese: 有些孩子甚至可以游完整个泳池的长度而不用浮出水面换气一次。
statements.english: Some children can cover the whole length of the pool without coming up for breath even once.

statements.chinese: 他们将来是否会成为奥运冠军，只有时间能证明。
statements.english: Whether they will ever become future Olympic champions, only time will tell.

statements.chinese: 同时，他们应该鼓励我们中那些游不到五码就气喘吁吁的人。
statements.english: Meanwhile, they should encourage those among us who cannot swim five yards before they are gasping for air.

courses.title: Lesson 95: A Fantasy
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 21 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 为什么大使特别幸运？
statements.english: Why was the Ambassador particularly lucky?

statements.chinese: 当埃斯卡洛皮亚大使回家吃午饭时，他的妻子吓了一跳。
statements.english: When the Ambassador of Escalopia returned home for lunch, his wife got a shock.

statements.chinese: 他脸色苍白，衣服也糟透了。
statements.english: He looked pale and his clothes were in a frightful state.

statements.chinese: “出什么事了？”她问道。
statements.english: 'What has happened?' she asked.

statements.chinese: “你的衣服怎么搞得这么乱？”
statements.english: 'How did your clothes get into such a mess?'

statements.chinese: “灭火器，亲爱的，”大使干巴巴地回答道。
statements.english: 'A fire extinguisher, my dear,' answered the Ambassador drily.

statements.chinese: “今天早上大学生把大使馆点着了。”
statements.english: 'University students set the Embassy on fire this morning.'

statements.chinese: “天哪！”他的妻子惊呼道。
statements.english: 'Good heavens!' exclaimed his wife.

statements.chinese: “那你当时在哪里？”
statements.english: 'And where were you at the time?'

statements.chinese: “我像往常一样在办公室里，”大使回答道。
statements.english: 'I was in my office as usual,' answered the Ambassador.

statements.chinese: “火灾发生在地下室。
statements.english: 'The fire broke out in the basement.
I went down immediately, of course, and that fool, Horst, aimed a fire extinguisher at me.
statements.chinese: 我当然立刻下去了，然后那个傻瓜霍斯特，把灭火器对准了我。
他以为我着火了。
statements.english: He thought I was on fire.

statements.chinese: 我一定要把那个家伙调走。”
statements.english: I must definitely get that fellow posted.'
The Ambassador's wife went on asking questions, when she suddenly noticed a big hole in her husband's hat.
statements.chinese: 大使夫人继续提问，突然她发现丈夫的帽子上有一个大洞。
“那你怎么解释那个？”她问道。
statements.english: 'And how can you explain that?' she asked.

statements.chinese: “哦，那个，”大使说道。
statements.english: 'Oh, that,' said the Ambassador.

statements.chinese: “有人朝我办公室窗户开了一枪。
statements.english: 'Someone fired a shot through my office window.

statements.chinese: 够准的，不是吗？
statements.english: Accurate, don't you think?

statements.chinese: 幸好，我当时没戴着它。
statements.english: Fortunately, I wasn't wearing it at the time.

statements.chinese: 如果我当时戴着，我就不能回家吃午饭了。”
statements.english: If I had been, I would not have been able to get home for lunch.'

courses.title: Lesson 96: The Dead Return
courses.description: 新概念英语第二册 · 10 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 节日结束后，那些灯笼会怎么样？
statements.english: What happens to the lanterns at the end of the festival?

statements.chinese: 日本每年举行一次亡灵节。
statements.english: A Festival for the Dead is held once a year in Japan.
This festival is a cheerful occasion, for on this day, the dead are said to return to their homes and they are welcomed by the living.
statements.chinese: 这个节日是个欢乐的时刻，因为据说在这一天，逝者会回到他们的家园，受到生者的欢迎。
由于他们长途跋涉后会感到饥饿，人们会为他们摆放食物。
statements.english: As they are expected to be hungry after their long journey, food is laid out for them.

statements.chinese: 每家每户外面都挂着特制的灯笼，帮助逝者找到回家的路。
statements.english: Specially-made lanterns are hung outside each house to help the dead to find their way.

statements.chinese: 人们通宵达旦地载歌载舞。
statements.english: All night long, people dance and sing.
In the early morning the food that had been laid out for the dead is thrown into a river or into the sea as it is considered unlucky for anyone living to eat it.
statements.chinese: 清晨，为逝者摆放的食物被扔进河里或海里，因为活人吃了被认为是不吉利的。

statements.english: In towns that are near the sea, the tiny lanterns which had been hung in the streets the night before, are placed into the water when the festival is over.
statements.chinese: 在沿海城镇，头天晚上挂在街上的小灯笼，节日结束后会被放入水中。
数千盏灯笼缓缓地漂向大海，指引逝者返回另一个世界。
statements.english: Thousands of lanterns slowly drift out to sea guiding the dead on their return journey to the other world.
This is a moving spectacle, for crowds of people stand on the shore watching the lanterns drifting away until they can be seen no more.
statements.chinese: 这是一幅感人的景象，因为成群的人们站在岸边，看着灯笼渐渐远去，直到它们完全消失不见。

packs.title: 新概念英语第三册
packs.description: 获授权教材课程 · 培养技能 · 60 课

courses.title: Lesson 1: A Puma at Large
courses.description: 新概念英语第三册 · 14 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 这头美洲狮是从哪里来的呢？
statements.english: Where must the puma have come from?

statements.chinese: 美洲狮是一种体形似猫的大动物，产于美洲。
statements.english: Pumas are large, cat-like animals which are found in America.
When reports came into London Zoo that a wild puma had been spotted forty-five miles south of London, they were not taken seriously.
statements.chinese: 当伦敦动物园接到报告，说在伦敦南面45英里处发现一头野生美洲狮时，他们并没有认真对待。

statements.english: However, as the evidence began to accumulate, experts from the Zoo felt obliged to investigate, for the descriptions given by people who claimed to have seen the puma were extraordinarily similar.
statements.chinese: 然而，随着证据的增多，动物园的专家们感到有必要进行一番调查，因为凡是声称见过美洲狮的人们所描述的情况竟然惊人地相似。
搜捕美洲狮的行动是从一个小村庄开始的，在那里，一位采摘黑莓的妇女看见“一只大猫”离她只有五码远。
statements.english: The hunt for the puma began in a small village where a woman picking blackberries saw 'a large cat'only five yards away from her.
It immediately ran away when she saw it, and experts confirmed that a puma will not attack a human being unless it is cornered.
statements.chinese: 她一看到它，它就立刻跑开了，专家证实，美洲狮除非被逼入绝境，否则是不会伤人的。

statements.english: The search proved difficult, for the puma was often observed at one place in the morning and at another place twenty miles away in the evening.
statements.chinese: 搜寻工作很困难，因为常常是早晨在一个地方发现美洲狮，晚上却在20英里以外的另一个地方发现它。
无论它走到哪里，身后都留下了死鹿及死兔子之类小动物的痕迹。
statements.english: Wherever it went, it left behind it a trail of dead deer and small animals like rabbits.

statements.chinese: 在许多地方都发现了美洲狮的爪印，灌木丛中也发现了美洲狮的毛。
statements.english: Paw prints were seen in a number of places and puma fur was found clinging to bushes.

statements.chinese: 有几个人抱怨说夜里听到了“像猫叫一样的声音”，一位商人在钓鱼时也看见那只美洲狮爬到了一棵树上。
statements.english: Several people complained of 'cat-like noises' at night and a businessman on a fishing trip saw the puma up a tree.
The experts were now fully convinced that the animal was a puma, but where had it come from?
statements.chinese: 专家们现在完全相信那只动物就是美洲狮，可是它是从哪里来的呢？

statements.english: As no pumas had been reported missing from any zoo in the country, this one must have been in the possession of a private collector and somehow managed to escape.
statements.chinese: 由于全国任何一家动物园都没有报道说美洲狮失踪，那么这只美洲狮一定是某个私人收藏者喂养的，且不知怎么设法逃脱了。

statements.english: The hunt went on for several weeks, but the puma was not caught.
statements.chinese: 搜捕进行了数周，但那只美洲狮仍未捕获。
想到在这宁静的乡村里，一只危险的野生动物仍然逍遥在外，真令人不安。
statements.english: It is disturbing to think that a dangerous wild animal is still at large in the quiet countryside.

courses.title: Lesson 2: Thirteen Equals One
courses.description: 新概念英语第三册 · 20 条逐句练习

statements.english: Our vicar is always raising money for one cause or another, but he has never managed to get enough money to have the church clock repaired.
statements.chinese: 我们的牧师总是为一个又一个的缘由筹款，但他从未筹到足够的钱来修理教堂的时钟。

statements.english: The big clock, which used to strike the hours day and night, was damaged during the war and has been silent ever since.
statements.chinese: 那个大钟，过去日夜报时，在战争中受损，从那以后就一直沉默不语。
然而，一天晚上，我们的牧师突然惊醒。
statements.english: One night, however, our vicar woke up with a start.

statements.chinese: 钟声正在报时。
statements.english: The clock was striking the hours.
Looking at his watch, he saw that it was 1 o'clock, but the bell struck 13 times before it stopped.
statements.chinese: 他看了看表，发现是凌晨一点，但钟声在停止前敲响了十三次。
牧师拿着手电筒，爬上钟楼，看看发生了什么。
statements.english: Armed with a torch, the vicar went up into the clock tower to see what was going on.
In the torchlight, he caught sight of a figure whom he immediately recognized as Bill Wilkins, our local grocer.
statements.chinese: 在手电筒的光束下，他看到一个人影，立刻认出是比尔·威尔金斯，我们当地的杂货商。
“比尔，你在这上面做什么？”
statements.english: "Whatever are you doing up here, Bill?"

statements.chinese: 牧师惊讶地问道。
statements.english: asked the vicar in surprise.

statements.chinese: “我正在尝试修理钟，”比尔回答。
statements.english: "I'm trying to repair the bell," answered Bill.

statements.chinese: “我每晚都来这里，已经好几个星期了。
statements.english: "I've been coming up here night after night for weeks now.

statements.chinese: 你看，我本来想给你一个惊喜。”
statements.english: You see, I was hoping to give you a surprise."

statements.chinese: “你确实给了我一个惊喜，”牧师说。
statements.english: "You certainly did give me a surprise," said the vicar.

statements.chinese: “你可能也把村里所有人都吵醒了。
statements.english: "You've probably woken up everyone in the village as well.

statements.chinese: 不过，我很高兴钟又响了。”
statements.english: Still, I'm glad the bell is working again."

statements.chinese: “问题就在这里，牧师，”比尔回答。
statements.english: "That's the trouble, vicar," answered Bill.
"It's working all right, but I'm afraid that at 1 o'clock it will strike 13 times, and there's nothing I can do about it."
statements.chinese: “它确实在工作，但我担心在一点钟时，它会敲响十三次，我对此无能为力。”
“我们会习惯的，比尔，”牧师说。
statements.english: "We'll get used to that, Bill," said the vicar.

statements.chinese: “敲十三下不如敲一下好，但总比什么都没有强。”
statements.english: "13 is not as good as 1, but it's better than nothing."

statements.chinese: “现在我们下楼去喝杯茶吧。”
statements.english: "Now let's go downstairs and have a cup of tea."

courses.title: Lesson 3: An Unknown Goddess
courses.description: 新概念英语第三册 · 18 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 考古学家怎么知道这座雕像是女神？
statements.english: How did the archaeologists know that the statue was a goddess?

statements.chinese: 不久前，考古学家在爱琴海的凯阿岛上有一项有趣的发现。
statements.english: Some time ago, an interesting discovery was made by archaeologists on the Aegean island of Kea.

statements.chinese: 一个美国小组考察了在阿伊亚伊里尼海角的一座古城中的一座神庙。
statements.english: An American team explored a temple which stands in an ancient city on the promontory of Ayia Irini.

statements.chinese: 这座城市曾一度繁荣，因为它享有高度的文明。
statements.english: The city at one time must have been prosperous, for it enjoyed a high level of civilization.

statements.chinese: 房屋——通常有三层楼高——是用石头建造的。
statements.english: Houses -- often three storeys high -- were built of stone.

statements.chinese: 它们有大房间，墙壁装饰精美。
statements.english: They had large rooms with beautifully decorated walls.

statements.chinese: 这座城市甚至配备了排水系统，因为在狭窄的街道下发现了大量的陶土管道。
statements.english: The city was even equipped with a drainage system, for a great many clay pipes were found beneath the narrow streets.

statements.chinese: 考古学家考察的神庙从公元前15世纪一直到罗马时代都被用作礼拜场所。
statements.english: The temple which the archaeologists explored was used as a place of worship from the fifteenth century B.C. until Roman times.

statements.chinese: 在神庙最神圣的房间里，发现了15尊雕像的陶土碎片。
statements.english: In the most sacred room of the temple, clay fragments of fifteen statues were found.

statements.chinese: 每一尊都代表一位女神，并且曾被涂上颜色。
statements.english: Each of these represented a goddess and had, at one time, been painted.

statements.chinese: 一尊雕像的身体是在可追溯到公元前15世纪的遗迹中发现的。
statements.english: The body of one statue was found among remains dating from the 15th century B.C.

statements.chinese: 它缺失的头部碰巧在公元前5世纪的遗迹中。
statements.english: Its missing head happened to be among remains of the fifth century B.C.

statements.chinese: 这个头部一定是在古典时期被发现并精心保存下来的。
statements.english: This head must have been found in Classical times and carefully preserved.

statements.chinese: 即使在当时，它也非常古老而珍贵。
statements.english: It was very old and precious even then.

statements.chinese: 当考古学家重组这些碎片时，他们惊讶地发现这位女神竟然是一个看起来非常现代的女人。
statements.english: When the archaeologists reconstructed the fragments, they were amazed to find that the goddess turned out to be a very modern-looking woman.

statements.chinese: 她身高三英尺，双手叉腰。
statements.english: She stood three feet high and her hands rested on her hips.

statements.chinese: 她穿着一件拖地的长裙。
statements.english: She was wearing a full-length skirt which swept the ground.

statements.chinese: 尽管她年代久远，但确实非常优雅，不过到目前为止，考古学家们还未能发现她的身份。
statements.english: Despite her great age, she was very graceful indeed, but, so far, the archaeologists have been unable to discover her identity.

courses.title: Lesson 4: The Double Life of Alfred Bloggs
courses.description: 新概念英语第三册 · 17 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 如今，从事体力劳动的人挣的钱往往比办公室职员多得多。
statements.english: These days, people who do manual work often receive far more money than clerks who work in offices.
People who work in offices are frequently referred to as white-collar workers, for the simple reason that they usually wear a collar and tie to go to work.
statements.chinese: 办公室职员常被称为白领工人，原因很简单，他们上班时通常会穿衬衫打领带。

statements.english: Such is human nature that a great many people are often willing to sacrifice higher pay for the privilege of becoming white-collar workers.
statements.chinese: 人的天性使然，许多人常常愿意牺牲更高的薪水，以换取成为白领工人的特权。
这可能会导致一些奇怪的情况。
statements.english: This can give rise to curious situations.
As it did in the case of Alfred Bloggs, who worked as a dustman for the Elsmere Corporation.
statements.chinese: 艾尔弗雷德·布洛格斯就是如此，他曾为埃尔斯米尔公司做清洁工。
当他结婚时，艾尔夫太不好意思告诉妻子他的工作。
statements.english: When he got married, Alf was too embarrassed to say anything to his wife about his job.

statements.chinese: 他只是告诉她，他在那家公司工作。
statements.english: He simply told her that he worked for the corporation.

statements.chinese: 每天早上，他都穿着一套漂亮的黑色西装离开家。
statements.english: Every morning, he left home dressed in a fine black suit.

statements.chinese: 然后他换上工作服，接下来八小时都做清洁工。
statements.english: He then changed into overalls and spent the next eight hours as a dustman.
Before returning home at night, he took a shower and changed back into his suit.
statements.chinese: 晚上回家之前，他会洗个澡，然后换回他的西装。
艾尔夫这样做超过两年了。
statements.english: Alf did this for over two years.

statements.chinese: 他的清洁工同事们替他保守了这个秘密。
statements.english: And his fellow dustmen kept his secret.
Alf's wife has never discovered that she married a dustman, and she never will.
statements.chinese: 艾尔夫的妻子从未发现她嫁给了一个清洁工，她也永远不会知道。
因为艾尔夫刚刚找到了另一份工作。
statements.english: For Alf has just found another job.

statements.chinese: 他很快就会在办公室里担任初级职员。
statements.english: He will soon be working in an office as a junior clerk.
He will be earning only half as much as he used to, but he feels that his rise in status is well worth the loss of money.
statements.chinese: 他挣的钱将只有以前的一半，但他觉得他的地位提升非常值得损失的金钱。

statements.english: From now on, he will wear a suit all day, and others will call him Mr. Bloggs, not Alf.
statements.chinese: 从现在起，他将整天穿着西装，别人会叫他布洛格斯先生，而不是艾尔夫。

courses.title: Lesson 5: The Facts
courses.description: 新概念英语第三册 · 14 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 编辑坚持事实和统计数据的后果是什么？
statements.english: What was the consequence of the editor's insistence on facts and statistics?

statements.chinese: 报纸杂志的编辑们常常不厌其烦地向读者提供一些无关紧要的事实和统计数字。
statements.english: Editors of newspapers and magazines often go to extremes to provide their readers with unimportant facts and statistics.

statements.chinese: 去年，一家有名的杂志派一名记者去撰写一篇有关一个非洲新共和国总统府的稿件。
statements.english: Last year a journalist had been instructed by a well-known magazine to write an article on the president's palace in a new African republic.

statements.chinese: 稿件寄来后，编辑看了第一句话就拒绝发表。
statements.english: When the article arrived, the editor read the first sentence and then refused to publish it.

statements.chinese: 文章的开头是这样的：“几百级台阶通向总统府四周的高墙。”
statements.english: The article began:'Hundreds of steps lead to the high wall which surrounds the president's palace.'

statements.chinese: 编辑立即给记者发了一份传真，指示他查明台阶的确切数字和围墙的高度。
statements.english: The editor at once sent the journalist a fax instructing him to find out the exact number of steps and the height of the wall.

statements.chinese: 记者立即动身去搜集这些重要的事实，但过了很久才把材料寄来。
statements.english: The journalist immediately set out to obtain these important facts, but he took a long time to send them.

statements.chinese: 与此同时，编辑等得不耐烦了，因为杂志很快就要付印。
statements.english: Meanwhile, the editor was getting impatient, for the magazine would soon go to press.

statements.chinese: 他又给记者发了两份传真，但没有任何回音。
statements.english: He sent the journalist two more faxes, but received no reply.

statements.chinese: 他又发了一份传真，通知记者说如果再不迅速回复，他就将被解雇。
statements.english: He sent yet another fax informing the journalist that if he did not reply soon he would be fired.

statements.chinese: 记者还是没有回复，编辑只好不情愿地按原样发表了那篇文章。
statements.english: When the journalist again failed to reply, the editor reluctantly published the article as it had originally been written.

statements.chinese: 一周后，编辑终于接到了记者的一份传真。
statements.english: A week later, the editor at last received a fax from the journalist.

statements.chinese: 那可怜的记者不仅被捕了，而且还被送进了监狱。
statements.english: Not only had the poor man been arrested, but he had been sent to prison as well.

However, he had at last been allowed to send a fax in which he informed the editor that he had been arrested while counting the 1, 084 steps leading to the 15th foot wall which surrounded the president's palace.
statements.chinese: 然而，他最终获准发了一份传真，在传真中他告诉编辑，他被捕了，因为他正在数通向总统府的1084级台阶和围绕总统府15英尺高的围墙。

courses.title: Lesson 6: Smash-and-Grab
courses.description: 新概念英语第三册 · 17 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 泰勒先生是怎样试图阻止窃贼的？
statements.english: How did Mr. Taylor try to stop the thieves?

statements.chinese: 靠近皮卡迪利大街的著名拱形建筑里的那些高档商店刚刚开门。
statements.english: The expensive shops in a famous arcade near Piccadilly were just opening.

statements.chinese: 在早晨这个时候，拱形建筑里几乎空无一人。
statements.english: At this time of the morning, the arcade was almost empty.

statements.chinese: 珠宝店店主泰勒先生正在欣赏新布置的橱窗。
statements.english: Mr. Taylor, the owner of a jewellery shop was admiring a new window display.

statements.chinese: 他的两名助手从8点钟就开始忙碌，刚刚才把橱窗布置好。
statements.english: Two of his assistants had been working busily since 8 o'clock and had only just finished.

statements.chinese: 钻石项链和戒指精美地摆放在黑色丝绒的衬托下。
statements.english: Diamond necklaces and rings had been beautifully arranged on a background of black velvet.

statements.chinese: 泰勒先生凝视橱窗几分钟之后，便回到了店里。
statements.english: After gazing at the display for several minutes, Mr. Taylor went back into his shop.

statements.chinese: 正在这时，突然一辆开着车灯、鸣着喇叭的汽车，咆哮着冲进了拱形建筑，打破了寂静。
statements.english: The silence was suddenly broken when a large car, with its headlights on and its horn blaring, roared down the arcade.

statements.chinese: 它在珠宝店门口停了下来。
statements.english: It came to a stop outside the jeweller's.

statements.chinese: 一个人留在驾驶座上，另外两个人则蒙着黑色丝袜跳下车，用铁棍砸碎了商店的橱窗。
statements.english: One man stayed at the wheel while two others with black stockings over their faces jumped out and smashed the window of the shop with iron bars.

statements.chinese: 就在这当儿，泰勒先生正在楼上。
statements.english: While this was going on, Mr. Taylor was upstairs.

statements.chinese: 他和店员开始把家具往窗外扔。
statements.english: He and his staff began throwing furniture out of the window.

statements.chinese: 椅子和桌子飞进了拱形建筑。
statements.english: Chairs and tables went flying into the arcade.
One of the thieves was struck by a heavy statue, but he was too busy helping himself to diamonds to notice any pain.
statements.chinese: 其中一个窃贼被一尊沉重的塑像砸中，但他只顾忙着抢钻石，根本没注意到疼痛。
抢劫在3分钟之内便结束了，因为劫匪们又争先恐后地跳上汽车，汽车以惊人的速度开走了。
statements.english: The raid was all over in three minutes, for the men scrambled back into the car and it moved off at a fantastic speed.
Just as it was leaving, Mr.Taylor rushed out and ran after it throwing ashtrays and vases, but it was impossible to stop the thieves.
statements.chinese: 就在汽车开走的时候，泰勒先生冲了出来，一边追赶汽车，一边扔烟灰缸和花瓶，但根本无法阻止窃贼。
他们已带着价值数千英镑的钻石逃走了。
statements.english: They had got away with thousands of pounds worth of diamonds.

courses.title: Lesson 7: Mutilated Ladies
courses.description: 新概念英语第三册 · 16 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 简为什么要烹调约翰的钱包？
statements.english: Why did Jane cook John's wallet?

statements.chinese: 你有过这种经历吗？
statements.english: Has it ever happened to you?

statements.chinese: 你是否曾经把裤子放进洗衣机里，然后才想起你的后裤袋里有一张大额钞票？
statements.english: Have you ever put your trousers in the washing machine and then remembered there was a large bank note in your back pocket?

statements.chinese: 当你把裤子拿出来时，是否发现那张钞票比雪还白？
statements.english: When you rescued your trousers, did you find the note was whiter than white?

statements.chinese: 在英国居住的人们犯了这种错误不必绝望（而且很多人都会犯这种错误）！
statements.english: People who live in Britain needn't despair when they make mistakes like this (and a lot of people do)!
Fortunately for them, the Bank of England has a team called Mutilated Ladies which deals with claims from people who fed their money to a machine or to their dog.
statements.chinese: 对他们来说幸运的是，英格兰银行有一个名为“残钞处理小组”的团队，处理那些把钱喂给机器或喂给狗的人提出的索赔。
看来狗很喜欢嚼钱！
statements.english: Dogs, it seems, love to chew up money!

statements.chinese: 最近有一件事是关于简·巴特林，她的未婚夫约翰经营着一家成功的家具公司。
statements.english: A recent case concerns Jane Butlin whose fiance, John, runs a successful furniture business.

statements.chinese: 约翰那天生意很好，就把装有3000英镑的钱包放进了微波炉里，以求安全。
statements.english: John had a very good day and put his wallet containing ￡3, 000 into the microwave oven for safekeeping.

statements.chinese: 然后他和简去骑马了。
statements.english: Then he and Jane went horse-riding.

statements.chinese: 他们到家后，简在微波炉里做了晚餐，并且在不知不觉中，也把她未婚夫的钱包给煮了。
statements.english: When they got home, Jane cooked their dinner in the microwave oven and without realizing it, cooked her fiance's wallet as well.

statements.chinese: 想象一下当他们发现一个“烹调精美”的钱包和变成灰烬的钞票时，他们的沮丧！
statements.english: Imagine their dismay when they found a beautifully-cooked wallet and notes turned to ash!
John went to see his bank manager who sent the remains of wallet and the money to the special department of the Bank of England in Newcastle: the Mutilated Ladies!
statements.chinese: 约翰去见了银行经理，经理把钱包和钱的残余部分送到了英格兰银行在纽卡斯尔的特别部门：残钞处理小组！
他们检查了残余物，约翰拿回了他所有的钱。
statements.english: They examined the remains and John got all his money back.

statements.chinese: “只要有可识别的部分，我们就会把钱还给人们，”银行的一位女发言人说。
statements.english: 'So long as there's something to identify, we will give people their money back,' said a spokeswoman for the Bank.

statements.chinese: “去年，我们为21000份索赔支付了150万英镑。”
statements.english: 'Last year, we paid ￡1.5 million on 21,000 claims.'

courses.title: Lesson 8: A Famous Monastery
courses.description: 新概念英语第三册 · 18 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 大圣伯纳德山口连接着瑞士和意大利。
statements.english: The Great St Bernard Pass connects Switzerland to Italy.
At 8,114 feet, it is the highest mountain pass in Europe.
statements.chinese: 海拔8114英尺，它是欧洲最高的山口。

statements.english: The famous monastery of St Bernard, which was founded in the 11th century, lies about a mile away.
statements.chinese: 著名的圣伯纳德修道院，建于11世纪，位于大约一英里之外。
几百年来，圣伯纳德犬拯救了穿越这个危险山口的旅行者的生命。
statements.english: For hundreds of years St Bernard dogs have saved the lives of travellers crossing the dangerous pass.
These friendly dogs, which were first brought from Asia, were used as watchdogs even in Roman times.
statements.chinese: 这些友善的狗，最初是从亚洲带过来的，甚至在罗马时代就被用作看门狗。

statements.english: Now that a tunnel has been built through the mountains, the pass is less dangerous.
statements.chinese: 如今，一条隧道已经穿山而过，这个山口就不那么危险了。

statements.english: But each year the dogs are still sent out into the snow, whenever a traveller is in difficulty.
statements.chinese: 但每年，只要有旅行者遇到困难，狗仍然会被派到雪地里。

statements.english: Despite the new tunnel, there are still a few people who rashly attempt to cross the pass on foot.
statements.chinese: 尽管有了新隧道，仍然有一些人贸然徒步穿越山口。
在夏季，修道院非常繁忙。
statements.english: During the summer months, the monastery is very busy.

statements.chinese: 因为有成千上万驾车穿越山口的人会来参观。
statements.english: For it is visited by thousands of people who cross the pass in cars.
As there are so many people about, the dogs have to be kept in a special enclosure.
statements.chinese: 由于人来人往，那些狗必须被关在一个特殊的围栏里。

statements.english: In winter, however, life at the monastery is quite different.
statements.chinese: 然而，在冬天，修道院的生活则大不相同。

statements.english: The temperature drops to minus 30 degrees, and very few people attempt to cross the pass.
statements.chinese: 气温降至零下30摄氏度，很少有人会尝试穿越山口。

statements.english: The monks prefer winter to summer, for they have more privacy.
statements.chinese: 僧侣们更喜欢冬天而不是夏天，因为他们有更多的隐私。
狗也有更大的自由。
statements.english: The dogs have greater freedom too.

statements.chinese: 因为它们被允许在围栏外自由漫步。
statements.english: For they are allowed to wander outside their enclosure.
The only regular visitors to the monastery in winter are parties of skiers who go there at Christmas and Easter.
statements.chinese: 冬天里修道院唯一的常客是在圣诞节和复活节去那里的滑雪者。

statements.english: These young people, who love the peace of the mountains, always receive a warm welcome at St Bernard's monastery.
statements.chinese: 这些热爱山区宁静的年轻人，总能得到热情的欢迎在圣伯纳德修道院。

courses.title: Lesson 9: Flying Cats
courses.description: 新概念英语第三册 · 20 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 猫从高处跌落时如何保护自己？
statements.english: How do cats try to protect themselves when falling from great heights?

statements.chinese: 猫总是能吸引人类。
statements.english: Cats never fail to fascinate human beings.

statements.chinese: 它们可以对人类友好和亲热，但它们也有自己的神秘生活。
statements.english: They can be friendly and affectionate towards humans, but they lead mysterious lives of their own as well.

statements.chinese: 它们从不像狗和马那样变得顺从。
statements.english: They never become submissive like dogs and horses.

statements.chinese: 结果，人类学会了尊重猫的独立性。
statements.english: As a result, humans have learned to respect feline independence.

statements.chinese: 大多数猫一生都对人类保持警惕。
statements.english: Most cats remain suspicious of humans all their lives.

statements.chinese: 关于猫最吸引我们的一点是，人们普遍认为它们有九条命。
statements.english: One of the things that fascinates us most about cats is the popular belief that they have nine lives.

statements.chinese: 显然，这种说法有相当多的真实性。
statements.english: Apparently, there is a good deal of truth in this idea.

statements.chinese: 猫从高处跌落后幸存的能力是有事实依据的。
statements.english: A cat's ability to survive falls is based on fact.

statements.chinese: 最近，纽约动物医疗中心对132只猫进行了为期五个月的研究。
statements.english: Recently the New York Animal Medical Centre made a study of 132 cats over a period of five months.
All these cats had one experience in common: they had fallen off high buildings, yet only eight of them died from shock or injuries.
statements.chinese: 所有这些猫都有一个共同的经历：它们都从高楼上跌落过，然而只有八只死于休克或受伤。
当然，纽约是进行这项有趣研究的理想地点，因为那里不缺少高楼大厦。
statements.english: Of course, New York is the ideal place for such an interesting study, because there is no shortage of tall buildings.

statements.chinese: 有很多高层窗台可供跌落！
statements.english: There are plenty of high-rise windowsills to fall from!

statements.chinese: 一只名叫萨布丽娜的猫从32层楼高的地方摔下，却只受了牙齿折断的伤。
statements.english: One cat, Sabrina, fell 32 storeys, yet only suffered from a broken tooth.

statements.chinese: “猫的行为就像训练有素的伞兵，”一位医生说。
statements.english: 'Cats behave like well-trained paratroopers,' a doctor said.

statements.chinese: 猫似乎跌落得越远，受伤的可能性就越小。
statements.english: It seems that the further cats fall, the less they are likely to injure themselves.

statements.chinese: 在长距离跌落中，它们的速度可达每小时60英里甚至更高。
statements.english: In a long drop, they reach speeds of 60 miles an hour and more.

statements.chinese: 在高速跌落时，猫有时间放松。
statements.english: At high speeds, falling cats have time to relax.

statements.chinese: 它们像飞鼠一样伸展四肢。
statements.english: They stretch out their legs like flying squirrels.

statements.chinese: 这增加了它们的空气阻力，并减少了它们撞击地面时的冲击。
statements.english: This increases their air-resistance and reduces the shock of impact when they hit the ground.

courses.title: Lesson 10: The Loss of the Titanic
courses.description: 新概念英语第三册 · 15 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 如果16个水密舱室中只有两个被淹没，会发生什么？
statements.english: What'd have happened if only two of the 16 water-tight compartments had been flooded?

statements.chinese: 1912年4月10日，巨轮“泰坦尼克号”从南安普顿启程驶往纽约。
statements.english: The great ship, Titanic sailed for New York from Southampton on April 10th, 1912.

statements.chinese: 船上载有1316名乘客和891名船员。
statements.english: She was carrying 1, 316 passengers and a crew of 891.

statements.chinese: 即使按现代标准来看，46000吨的泰坦尼克号也是一艘巨轮。
statements.english: Even by modern standards, the 46, 000 ton Titanic was a colossal ship.

statements.chinese: 然而，在那个时代，她不仅是当时建造过的最大的船只，而且被认为是永不沉没的，因为她有十六个水密舱室。
statements.english: At that time, however, she was not only the largest ship that had ever been built, but was regarded as unsinkable, for she had sixteen water-tight compartments.

statements.chinese: 即使其中两个舱室被水淹没，她仍然能够漂浮。
statements.english: Even if two of these were flooded, she would still be able to float.

statements.chinese: 这艘巨型邮轮的悲剧性沉没将永远被铭记，因为她在首次航行中就沉没了，造成了大量人员伤亡。
statements.english: The tragic sinking of this great liner will always be remembered, for she went down on her first voyage with heavy loss of life.
Four days after setting out, while the Titanic was sailing across the icy waters of the North Atlantic, a huge iceberg was suddenly spotted by a lookout.
statements.chinese: 启程四天后，当泰坦尼克号航行在北大西洋冰冷的海域时，一名瞭望员突然发现了一座巨大的冰山。
警报发出后，这艘巨轮急剧转向，以避免直接碰撞。
statements.english: After the alarm had been given, the great ship turned sharply to avoid a direct collision.

statements.chinese: 泰坦尼克号及时转向，险些错过了她旁边那堵高出水面100多英尺的巨大冰墙。
statements.english: The Titanic turned just in time, narrowly missing the immense wall of ice which rose over 100 feet out of the water beside her.
Suddenly, there was a slight trembling sound from below, and the captain went down to see what had happened.
statements.chinese: 突然，从下方传来一阵轻微的颤抖声，船长下去查看发生了什么。
声音如此微弱，以至于没有人认为船只受到了损坏。
statements.english: The noise had been so faint that no one thought that the ship had been damaged.
Below, the captain realized to his horror that the Titanic was sinking rapidly, for five of her sixteen watertight compartments had already been flooded!
statements.chinese: 在下方，船长惊恐地意识到泰坦尼克号正在迅速下沉，因为她16个水密舱室中的5个已经进水了！
弃船命令下达，数百人跳入冰冷的水中。
statements.english: The order to abandon ship was given and hundreds of people plunged into the icy water.

statements.chinese: 由于救生艇不足，有1500人丧生。
statements.english: As there were not enough life-boats for everybody, 1, 500 lives were lost.

courses.title: Lesson 11: Not Guilty
courses.description: 新概念英语第三册 · 27 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 过海关是一件麻烦事。
statements.english: Going through the customs is a tiresome business.
The strangest thing about it is that really honest people are often made to feel guilty.
statements.chinese: 最奇怪的是，那些真正诚实的人常常会觉得自己有罪。

statements.english: The hardened professional smuggler, on the other hand, is never troubled by such feelings, even if he has 500 gold watches hidden in his suitcase.
statements.chinese: 而那些老练的职业走私犯，却从不为此感到困扰，即使他的手提箱里藏着500块金表。

statements.english: When I returned from abroad recently, a particularly officious young customs officer clearly regarded me as a smuggler.
statements.chinese: 最近我从国外回来时，一位特别爱管闲事的年轻海关官员，显然把我当成了走私犯。
“你有什么要申报的吗？”
statements.english: "Have you anything to declare?"
he asked, looking me in the eye.
statements.chinese: 他问，眼睛直勾勾地盯着我。

statements.english: "No," I answered confidently.
statements.chinese: “没有，”我自信地回答。
“请你打开这个手提箱好吗？”
statements.english: "Would you mind unlocking this suitcase, please?"
"Not at all," I answered.
statements.chinese: “没问题，”我回答。
官员非常仔细地检查了箱子。
statements.english: The officer went through the case with great care.

statements.chinese: 我精心打包的所有东西很快就变得一团糟。
statements.english: All the things I'd packed so carefully were soon in a dreadful mess.

statements.chinese: 我确信我再也关不上这个箱子了。
statements.english: I felt sure I would never be able to close the case again.
Suddenly, I saw the official's face light up.
statements.chinese: 突然，我看到那位官员的脸上露出了喜色。

statements.english: He had spotted a tiny bottle at the bottom of my case, and he pounced on it with delight.
statements.chinese: 他在我的箱子底部发现了一个小瓶子，他高兴地扑了过去。
“香水，嗯？”
statements.english: "Perfume, eh?"

statements.chinese: 他嘲讽地问道。
statements.english: he asked sarcastically.

statements.chinese: “你应该申报的。
statements.english: "You should have declared that.

statements.chinese: 香水不在免税商品之列。”
statements.english: Perfume is not exempt from import duty."
"But it isn't perfume," I said.
statements.chinese: “但这不是香水，”我说。
“是发油。”
statements.english: "It's hair oil."
Then I added with a smile, "It's a strange mixture I make myself."
statements.chinese: 接着我微笑着补充道，“这是一种我自制的奇怪混合物。”

statements.english: As I expected, he did not believe me.
statements.chinese: 正如我所料，他不相信我。
“试试看！”
statements.english: "Try it!"

statements.chinese: 我鼓励地说。
statements.english: I said encouragingly.

statements.chinese: 官员拧开瓶盖，把瓶子凑到鼻孔前。
statements.english: The officer unscrewed the cap and put the bottle to his nostrils.

statements.chinese: 一股难闻的气味扑鼻而来，这让他相信我说的是实话。
statements.english: He was greeted by an unpleasant smell which convinced him that I was telling the truth.

statements.chinese: 几分钟后，我得以匆匆离去，行李上盖有珍贵的粉笔标记。
statements.english: A few minutes later, I was able to hurry away with precious chalk marks on my baggage.

courses.title: Lesson 12: Life on a Desert Island
courses.description: 新概念英语第三册 · 18 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 那两个人留在荒岛上有什么特别之处？
statements.english: What was exceptional about the two men's stay on the desert island?

statements.chinese: 我们大多数人对荒岛生活形成了一种不切实际的想象。
statements.english: Most of us have formed an unrealistic picture of life on a desert island.

statements.chinese: 我们有时把荒岛想象成一个阳光普照的天堂。
statements.english: We sometimes imagine a desert island to be a sort of paradise where the sun always shines.

statements.chinese: 那里的生活简单而美好。
statements.english: Life there is simple and good.

statements.chinese: 成熟的果实从树上掉下来，你根本不用劳动。
statements.english: Ripe fruit falls from the trees and you never have to work.

statements.chinese: 而另一方面的情况却恰恰相反。
statements.english: The other side of the picture is quite the opposite.

statements.chinese: 荒岛上的生活是悲惨的。
statements.english: Life on a desert island is wretched.

statements.chinese: 你不是饿死，就是像鲁滨逊漂流记一样，苦等一艘永不来临的船。
statements.english: You either starve to death or live like Robinson Crusoe, waiting for a boat which never comes.

statements.chinese: 也许这两种景象都有点真实性，但我们很少有人有机会去证实。
statements.english: Perhaps there is an element of truth in both these pictures, but few of us have had the opportunity to find out.

statements.chinese: 最近，有两个人在一个珊瑚岛上待了五天，他们真希望能在那里待得更久。
statements.english: Two men who recently spent five days on a coral island wished they had stayed there longer.

statements.chinese: 他们正驾驶一艘严重受损的船从维尔京群岛前往迈阿密修理。
statements.english: They were taking a badly damaged boat from the Virgin Islands to Miami to have it repaired.

statements.chinese: 旅途中，他们的船开始下沉。
statements.english: During the journey, their boat began to sink.

statements.chinese: 他们迅速将食物、火柴和几罐啤酒装上一艘小橡皮艇，划行了几英里穿过加勒比海，直到抵达一个微小的珊瑚岛。
statements.english: They quickly loaded a small rubber dinghy with food, matches, and cans of beer and rowed for a few miles across the Caribbean until they arrived at a tiny coral island.

statements.chinese: 岛上几乎没有树木，也没有水，但这并没有成为一个问题。
statements.english: There were hardly any trees on the island and there was no water, but this did not prove to be a problem.

statements.chinese: 两人用橡皮艇收集雨水。
statements.english: The men collected rainwater in the rubber dinghy.

statements.chinese: 由于他们带了一支鱼枪，所以食物很充足。
statements.english: As they had brought a spear gun with them, they had plenty to eat.

statements.chinese: 他们每天都捕捞龙虾和鱼，正如其中一人所说，他们“吃得像国王一样”。
statements.english: They caught lobster and fish every day, and as one of them put it 'ate like kings'.

statements.chinese: 五天后，当一艘过往的油轮救起他们时，两人都真诚地感到遗憾，因为他们不得不离开。
statements.english: When a passing tanker rescued them five days later, both men were genuinely sorry that they had to leave.

courses.title: Lesson 13: It's Only Me
courses.description: 新概念英语第三册 · 17 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 那个男人期望在楼梯下找到什么？
statements.english: What did the man expect to find under the stairs?

statements.chinese: 丈夫去上班后，理查兹夫人把孩子们送去学校，然后上楼到卧室。
statements.english: After her husband had gone to work, Mrs. Richards sent her children to school and went upstairs to her bedroom.

statements.chinese: 那个上午她兴奋得顾不上做家务，因为晚上她要和丈夫一起去参加一个化装舞会。
statements.english: She was too excited to do any housework that morning, for in the evening she would be going to a fancy-dress party with her husband.

statements.chinese: 她打算打扮成一个鬼魂。由于头天晚上她已做好了化装服，所以她迫不及待地想试穿一下。
statements.english: She intended to dress up as a ghost and as she had made her costume the night before, she was impatient to try it on.

statements.chinese: 尽管化装服只是一块床单，但效果却非常好。
statements.english: Though the costume consisted only of a sheet, it was very effective.

statements.chinese: 穿上衣服后，理查兹夫人下了楼。
statements.english: After putting it on, Mrs. Richards went downstairs.

statements.chinese: 她想看看穿上是否舒服。
statements.english: She wanted to find out whether it would be comfortable to wear.

statements.chinese: 理查兹夫人刚走进饭厅，前门就传来了敲门声。
statements.english: Just as Mrs. Richards was entering the dining-room, there was a knock on the front door.

statements.chinese: 她知道肯定是面包师。
statements.english: She knew that it must be the baker.

statements.chinese: 她曾告诉他，如果她没有开门，他就直接进来，把面包放在厨房的桌子上。
statements.english: She had told him to come straight in if ever she failed to open the door and to leave the bread on the kitchen table.

statements.chinese: 理查兹夫人不想吓着那个可怜的人，便迅速躲到了楼梯下的小储藏室里。
statements.english: Not wanting to frighten the poor man, Mrs. Richards quickly hid in the small storeroom under the stairs.

statements.chinese: 她听到前门打开了，走廊里传来沉重的脚步声。
statements.english: She heard the front door open and heavy footsteps in the hall.

statements.chinese: 突然，储藏室的门开了，一个男人走了进来。
statements.english: Suddenly the door of the storeroom was opened and a man entered.

statements.chinese: 理查兹夫人意识到这一定是电力公司的抄表员。
statements.english: Mrs. Richards realized that it must be the man from the Electricity Board who had come to read the metre.
She tried to explain the situation, saying 'It's only me', but it was too late.
statements.chinese: 她试图解释情况，说道：“是我呀”，但为时已晚。
那个男人大叫一声，后退了几步。
statements.english: The man let out a cry and jumped back several paces.

statements.chinese: 当理查兹夫人走向他时，他逃走了，并在身后砰地关上了门。
statements.english: When Mrs. Richards walked towards him, he fled, slamming the door behind him.

courses.title: Lesson 14: A Noble Gangster
courses.description: 新概念英语第三册 · 12 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 霍克伍德在和平时期是怎样赚钱的？
statements.english: How did Hawkwood make money in times of peace?

statements.chinese: 过去，芝加哥的店主和商人们不得不向歹徒支付大笔金钱，以换取“保护”。
statements.english: There was a time when the owners of shops and businesses in Chicago had to pay large sums of money to gangsters in return for 'protection'.

statements.chinese: 如果不及时付款，歹徒就会捣毁店主的店铺，使其很快破产。
statements.english: If the money was not paid promptly, the gangsters would quickly put a man out of business by destroying his shop.

statements.chinese: 敲诈“保护费”并非是现代社会的罪行。
statements.english: Obtaining 'protection money' is not a modern crime.

statements.chinese: 远在14世纪，英国人约翰·霍克伍德爵士就有了惊人的发现，人们情愿支付大笔金钱，也不愿自己的毕生心血毁于歹徒之手。
statements.english: As long ago as the fourteenth century, an Englishman, Sir John Hawkwood, made the remarkable discovery that people would rather pay large sums of money than have their life work destroyed by gangsters.

statements.chinese: 600年前，约翰·霍克伍德爵士率领一队士兵抵达意大利，在佛罗伦萨附近定居下来。
statements.english: Six hundred years ago, Sir John Hawkwood arrived in Italy with a band of soldiers and settled near Florence.

statements.chinese: 他很快就出了名，意大利人称他为乔瓦尼·阿库托。
statements.english: He soon made a name for himself and came to be known to the Italians as Giovanni Acuto.

statements.chinese: 无论意大利城邦之间何时交战，霍克伍德总是将他的士兵雇佣给那些愿意支付他所要求的高价的君主。
statements.english: Whenever the Italian city-states were at war with each other, Hawkwood used to hire his soldiers to princes who were willing to pay the high price he demanded.

statements.chinese: 在和平时期，当生意不好时，霍克伍德和他的手下就会开进一个城邦，烧毁几座农场后，提出如果向他们支付保护费，他们就离开。
statements.english: In times of peace, when business was bad, Hawkwood and his men would march into a city-state, and after burning down a few farms, would offer to go away if protection money was paid to them.

statements.chinese: 霍克伍德就是这样赚取了大笔金钱。
statements.english: Hawkwood made large sums of money in this way.

statements.chinese: 尽管如此，意大利人还是把他看作一个英雄。
statements.english: In spite of this, the Italians regarded him as a sort of hero.

statements.chinese: 他80岁去世时，佛罗伦萨人为他举行了国葬，并绘制了一幅纪念他的画像，画像上写着：“最英勇的士兵和最杰出的领袖，乔瓦尼·霍克伍德先生”。
statements.english: When he died at the age of eighty, the Florentines gave him a state funeral and had a picture painted which was dedicated to the memory of 'the most valiant soldier and most notable leader, Signor Giovanni Haukodue'.

courses.title: Lesson 15: Fifty Pence Worth of Trouble
courses.description: 新概念英语第三册 · 17 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 乔治用他的五十便士买到什么东西了吗？什么东西？
statements.english: Did George get anything for his fifty pence? What?

statements.chinese: 孩子们总是喜欢收到小额的零用钱。
statements.english: Children always appreciate small gifts of money.

statements.chinese: 当然，爸爸妈妈会定期地给零花钱，但叔叔阿姨们总是额外的收入来源。
statements.english: Mum or dad, of course, provides a regular supply of pocket money, but uncles and aunts are always a source of extra income.

statements.chinese: 对有些孩子来说，小数目也能派上大用场。
statements.english: With some children, small sums go a long way.

statements.chinese: 如果五十便士没有换成糖果，它们就会在钱箱里叮当响上好几个月。
statements.english: If fifty pence pieces are not exchanged for sweets, they rattle for months inside money boxes.

statements.chinese: 只有非常节俭的孩子才能把钱箱装满。
statements.english: Only very thrifty children manage to fill up a money box.

statements.chinese: 对于他们中的大多数人来说，五十便士买一大块美味的巧克力是很划算的。
statements.english: For most of them, fifty pence is a small price to pay for a nice big bar of chocolate.

statements.chinese: 我的侄子乔治有一个钱箱，但它总是空的。
statements.english: My nephew, George, has a money box but it is always empty.

statements.chinese: 我给他的五十便士硬币和英镑硬币很少有能存到那里的。
statements.english: Very few of the fifty pence pieces and pound coins I have given him have found their way there.

statements.chinese: 昨天我给了他五十便士，并建议他存起来。
statements.english: I gave him fifty pence yesterday and advised him to save it.

statements.chinese: 结果，他却给自己买来了五十便士的麻烦。
statements.english: Instead, he bought himself fifty pence worth of trouble.

statements.chinese: 在去糖果店的路上，他把五十便士掉了，它沿着人行道跳动，然后掉进了一个下水道。
statements.english: On his way to the sweet shop, he dropped his fifty pence and it bounced along the pavement and then disappeared down a drain.
George took off his jacket, rolled up his sleeves and pushed his right arm through the drain cover.
statements.chinese: 乔治脱下他的夹克，卷起袖子，把右臂伸进了下水道盖子。
他到处都找不到他的五十便士硬币，更糟的是，他抽不出他的胳膊了。
statements.english: He could not find his 50 pence piece anywhere, and what is more, he could not get his arm out.

statements.chinese: 一群人围在他周围，一位女士用肥皂和黄油擦他的胳膊，但乔治被牢牢地卡住了。
statements.english: A crowd of people gathered round him and a lady rubbed his arm with soap and butter, but George was firmly stuck.

statements.chinese: 消防队被叫来了，两名消防队员用一种特殊的润滑脂把乔治解救了出来。
statements.english: The fire brigade was called and two fire fighters freed George using a special type of grease.

statements.chinese: 乔治并没有因为这次经历而太难过，因为糖果店的老板娘听说了他的麻烦，并奖励了他一大盒巧克力。
statements.english: George was not too upset by his experience because the lady who owns the sweet shop heard about his troubles and rewarded him with a large box of chocolates.

courses.title: Lesson 16: Mary Had a Little Lamb
courses.description: 新概念英语第三册 · 18 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 迪米特里向他的邻居道歉对吗？为什么不对？
statements.english: Was Dimitri right to apologize to his neighbour? Why not?

statements.chinese: 玛丽和她的丈夫迪米特里住在希腊南部佩拉霍拉的一个小村庄里。
statements.english: Mary and her husband Dimitri lived in the tiny village of Perachora in southern Greece.

statements.chinese: 玛丽最珍贵的财产之一是她丈夫送给她的一只白色小羊羔。
statements.english: One of Mary's prize possessions was a little white lamb which her husband had given her.

statements.chinese: 白天她把它拴在田野里的一棵树上，每天傍晚都去把它牵回来。
statements.english: She kept it tied to a tree in a field during the day and went to fetch it every evening.

statements.chinese: 然而，一个晚上，那只羊不见了。
statements.english: One evening, however the lamb was missing.

statements.chinese: 绳子被割断了，很明显羊被偷了。
statements.english: The rope had been cut, so it was obvious that the lamb had been stolen.

statements.chinese: 迪米特里从田里回来时，他的妻子把发生的一切告诉了他。
statements.english: When Dimitri came in from the fields, his wife told him what had happened.

statements.chinese: 迪米特里立刻出去寻找小偷。
statements.english: Dimitri at once set out to find the thief.

statements.chinese: 他知道在这样一个小村庄里，找到小偷不会很难。
statements.english: He knew it would not prove difficult in such a small village.
After telling several of his friends about the theft, Dimitri found out that his neighbour, Aleko, had suddenly acquired a new lamb.
statements.chinese: 在把失窃的事告诉他的几个朋友之后，迪米特里发现他的邻居阿列科突然多了一只新羊。
迪米特里立刻去了阿列科家，愤怒地指责他偷了羊。
statements.english: Dimitri immediately went to Aleko's house and angrily accused him of stealing the lamb.

statements.chinese: 他告诉阿列科最好把羊还回来，否则他就报警。
statements.english: He told him he had better return it or he would call the police.

statements.chinese: 阿列科否认偷了羊，并把迪米特里领进了他的后院。
statements.english: Aleko denied taking it and led Dimitri into his backyard.

statements.chinese: 他解释说，他确实刚买了一只羊，但他的羊是黑色的。
statements.english: It was true that he had just bought a lamb he explained, but his lamb was black.

statements.chinese: 迪米特里为自己如此鲁莽的行为感到羞愧，他向阿列科为自己的指责道了歉。
statements.english: Ashamed of having acted so rashly, Dimitri apologized to Aleko for having accused him.

statements.chinese: 他们谈话的时候开始下雨了，迪米特里就在阿列科家里待到雨停。
statements.english: While they were talking it began to rain and Dimitri stayed in Aleko's house until the rain stopped.

statements.chinese: 半小时后，当他出去时，他惊奇地发现那只黑色的小羊几乎是白色的。
statements.english: When he went outside half an hour later, he was astonished to find that the little black lamb was almost white.

statements.chinese: 它的羊毛，原来被染成了黑色，被雨水冲洗干净了！
statements.english: Its wool, which had been dyed black, had been washed clean by the rain!

courses.title: Lesson 17: The Longest Suspension Bridge in the World
courses.description: 新概念英语第三册 · 17 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 这座桥是如何支撑起来的？
statements.english: How is the bridge supported?

statements.chinese: 韦拉扎诺，一位鲜为人知的意大利人，于1524年航行进入纽约港，并将其命名为昂古莱姆。
statements.english: Verrazano, an Italian about whom little is known, sailed into New York Harbour in 1524 and named it Angouleme.

statements.chinese: 他将其描述为“一个非常宜人的地方，坐落在两座小山之间，中间流淌着一条大河。”
statements.english: He described it as 'a very agreeable situation located within two small hills in the midst of which flowed a great river.'
Though Verrazano is by no means considered to be a great explorer, his name will probably remain immortal, for on November 21st, 1964, the longest suspension bridge in the world was named after him.
statements.chinese: 尽管韦拉扎诺绝不被认为是一位伟大的探险家，但他的名字可能会流芳百世，因为在1964年11月21日，世界上最长的吊桥以他的名字命名。
韦拉扎诺大桥由奥斯马·阿曼设计，连接着布鲁克林和史泰登岛。
statements.english: The Verrazano Bridge, which was designed by Othmar Ammann, joins Brooklyn to Staten Island.

statements.chinese: 它有一个4260英尺的跨度。
statements.english: It has a span of 4, 260 feet.

statements.chinese: 这座桥非常长，以至于它的设计师不得不将地球的形状考虑在内。
statements.english: The bridge is so long that the shape of the earth had to be taken into account by its designer.

statements.chinese: 两座巨大的塔架支撑着四根巨大的缆索。
statements.english: Two great towers support four huge cables.

statements.chinese: 这些塔架建在由钢和混凝土制成的巨大水下平台上。
statements.english: The towers are built on immense underwater platforms made of steel and concrete.

statements.chinese: 这些平台延伸到海面以下100多英尺的深度。
statements.english: The platforms extend to a depth of over 100 feet under the sea.

statements.chinese: 仅仅这些就花了16个月来建造。
statements.english: These alone took sixteen months to build.

statements.chinese: 在水面之上，塔架上升到近700英尺的高度。
statements.english: Above the surface of the water, the towers rise to a height of nearly 700 feet.

statements.chinese: 它们支撑着悬挂大桥的缆索。
statements.english: They support the cables from which the bridge has been suspended.

statements.chinese: 四根缆索中的每一根都含有26108股钢丝。
statements.english: Each of the four cables contains 26, 108 lengths of wire.

statements.chinese: 据估计，即使桥上挤满了汽车，它也只承载了其总容量的三分之一。
statements.english: It has been estimated that if the bridge were packed with cars, it would still only be carrying a third of its total capacity.

statements.chinese: 然而，尺寸和强度并不是这座桥唯一重要的方面。
statements.english: However, size and strength are not the only important things about this bridge.
Despite its immensity, it is both simple and elegant, fulfilling its designer's dream to creat 'an enormous object drawn as faintly as possible'.
statements.chinese: 尽管它如此巨大，却既简洁又优雅，实现了设计师创造“一个尽可能轻描淡写地勾勒出的巨大物体”的梦想。

courses.title: Lesson 18: Electric Currents in Modern Art
courses.description: 新概念英语第三册 · 19 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 有些展品是怎样有危险的呢？
statements.english: How might some of the exhibits have been dangerous?

statements.chinese: 现代雕塑已很少令我们感到惊奇了。
statements.english: Modern sculpture rarely surprises us any more.

statements.chinese: 现代艺术只能在博物馆里才能看到这种想法是错误的。
statements.english: The idea that modern art can only be seen in museums is mistaken.

statements.chinese: 即使是对艺术不感兴趣的人，也不会没有注意到在公共场所展出的现代雕塑作品。
statements.english: Even people who take no interest in art cannot have failed to notice examples of modern sculpture on display in public places.

statements.chinese: 花园里、大楼和商店门外都矗立着奇形怪状的雕塑。
statements.english: Strange forms stand in gardens, and outside buildings and shops.

statements.chinese: 我们对它们已习以为常了。
statements.english: We have got quite used to them.

statements.chinese: 有些所谓的“现代”作品已经展出了将近80年了。
statements.english: Some so-called 'modern' pieces have been on display for nearly eighty years.

statements.chinese: 尽管如此，最近举办的一次现代雕塑展览还是使一些人——包括我本人在内——大吃一惊。
statements.english: In spite of this, some people--including myself--were surprised by a recent exhibition of modern sculpture.

statements.chinese: 我走进美术馆时，首先看到的是一块牌子，上面写着：“展品切勿触摸，有些是危险品！”
statements.english: The first thing I saw when I entered the art gallery was a notice which said: 'Do not touch the exhibits, some of them are dangerous!'

statements.chinese: 展出的作品都是动态雕塑。
statements.english: The objects on display were pieces of moving sculpture.

statements.chinese: 悬挂在天花板上随风摆动的奇形怪状的雕塑，大家是相当熟悉的。
statements.english: Oddly shaped forms that are suspended from the ceiling and move in response to a gust of wind are quite familiar to everybody.

statements.chinese: 然而，这些展品却与众不同。
statements.english: These objects, however, were different.

statements.chinese: 靠墙摆放着的是些系有金属球的长长的细电线。
statements.english: Lined up against the wall, there were long thin wires attached to metal spheres.

statements.chinese: 金属球都带磁，因此它们总是互相吸引或排斥。
statements.english: The spheres had been magnetized and attracted or repelled each other all the time.
In the centre of the hall, there were a number of tall structures which contained coloured lights.
statements.chinese: 在展览厅中央，有些高高的建筑物模型，里面装着彩灯。
这些彩灯不停地闪烁，就像发了疯的红绿灯。
statements.english: These lights flickered continuously like traffic lights which have gone mad.

statements.chinese: 小黑盒子里迸出火花，红色灯泡恼怒地闪着。
statements.english: Sparks were emitted from small black boxes and red lamps flashed on and off angrily.

statements.chinese: 这简直是史前电子设备展览。
statements.english: It was rather like an exhibition of prehistoric electronic equipment.

statements.chinese: 这些奇特的造型，似乎不仅要给人以情感上的冲击，还要给人以电击！
statements.english: These peculiar forms not only seemed designed to shock people emotionally, but to give them electric shocks as well!

courses.title: Lesson 19: A Very Dear Cat
courses.description: 新概念英语第三册 · 20 条逐句练习

statements.english: Kidnappers are really interested in animals, but they recently took considerable interest in Mrs. Elena Ramsey's cat.
statements.chinese: 绑匪们对动物并不真正感兴趣，但他们最近对埃琳娜·拉姆齐夫人的猫表现出了相当大的兴趣。

statements.english: Mrs. Elena Ramsey, a very wealthy old lady, has shared a flat with her cat Rastus for a great many years.
statements.chinese: 埃琳娜·拉姆齐夫人，一位非常富有的老妇人，多年来一直和她的猫拉斯特斯住在一起。
拉斯特斯过着有规律的生活。
statements.english: Rastus leads an orderly life.

statements.chinese: 他通常在晚上散步，并且总是在七点钟前回家。
statements.english: He usually takes a short walk in the evenings and is always home by 7 o'clock.

statements.chinese: 然而，一天晚上，他没有回来。
statements.english: One evening, however, he failed to arrive.

statements.chinese: 拉姆齐夫人非常担心。
statements.english: Mrs. Ramsey got very worried.

statements.chinese: 她到处找他，但没有找到。
statements.english: She looked everywhere for him but could not find him.

statements.chinese: 拉斯特斯失踪三天后，拉姆齐夫人收到了一封匿名信。
statements.english: Three days after Rastus's disappearance, Mrs. Ramsey received an anonymous letter.
The writer stated that Rastus was in safe hands and would be returned immediately if Mrs. Ramsey paid a ransom of 1,000 pounds.
statements.chinese: 写信人称拉斯特斯安然无恙，并会立即归还，只要拉姆齐夫人支付一千英镑的赎金。

statements.english: Mrs. Ramsey was instructed to place the money in a cardboard box and to leave it outside her door.
statements.chinese: 拉姆齐夫人被告知将钱放在一个纸板箱里，然后放在门外。
起初，她决定报警。
statements.english: At first, she decided to go to the police.
But fearing that she would never see Rastus again, the letter had made that quite clear, she changed her mind.
statements.chinese: 但她担心再也见不到拉斯特斯，信中已经说得很清楚了，她改变了主意。
她从银行取出了一千英镑，并按照绑匪的指示做了。
statements.english: She drew a thousand pounds from her bank and followed the kidnapper's instructions.

statements.chinese: 第二天早上，箱子不见了。
statements.english: The next morning, the box had disappeared.

statements.chinese: 但拉姆齐夫人确信绑匪会信守诺言。
statements.english: But Mrs. Ramsey was sure that the kidnapper would keep his word.

statements.chinese: 果不其然，拉斯特斯那天晚上七点准时回来了。
statements.english: Sure enough, Rastus arrived punctually at 7 o'clock that evening.
He looked very well, though he was rather thirsty, for he drank half a bottle of milk.
statements.chinese: 他看起来很好，虽然他相当口渴，因为他喝了半瓶牛奶。
当拉姆齐夫人告诉他们她所做的一切时，警察们都惊呆了。
statements.english: The police were astounded when Mrs. Ramsey told them what she had done.

statements.chinese: 她解释说拉斯特斯对她来说非常珍贵。
statements.english: She explained that Rastus was very dear to her.
Considering the amount she paid, he was dear in more ways than one.
statements.chinese: 考虑到她付出的金额，他在不止一方面都很珍贵。

courses.title: Lesson 20: Pioneer Pilots
courses.description: 新概念英语第三册 · 19 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 1908年，诺斯克利夫勋爵设下1000英镑的奖金，奖励第一位飞越英吉利海峡的人。
statements.english: In 1908, Lord Northcliffe offered a prize of 1,000 pounds to the first man who would fly across the English Channel.

statements.chinese: 一年多过去了，才有人首次尝试。
statements.english: Over a year passed before the first attempt was made.

statements.chinese: 1909年7月19日清晨，休伯特·莱瑟姆驾驶他的“安托瓦内特四号”飞机从法国海岸起飞。
statements.english: On July the 19th, 1909, in the early morning, Hubert Latham took off from the French coast in his plane, the Antoinette IV.

statements.chinese: 他只飞越了七英里，发动机就失灵了，他被迫降落在海上。
statements.english: He had traveled only seven miles across the Channel when his engine failed and he was forced to land on the sea.

statements.chinese: “安托瓦内特号”漂浮在水上，直到莱瑟姆被一艘船救起。
statements.english: The Antoinette floated on the water until Latham was picked up by a ship.

statements.chinese: 两天后，路易斯·布莱里奥驾驶一架名为“11号”的飞机抵达加来附近。
