It is only in the study of man himself that the major social sciences have substituted the study of one local variation, that of Western civilization.
statements.chinese: 只有在研究人类自身时，主要的社会科学才将对西方文明这一地方性变体的研究取而代之。

statements.english: Anthropology was by definition impossible, as long as these distinctions between ourselves and the primitive, ourselves and the barbarian, ourselves and the pagan, held sway over people's minds.
statements.chinese: 人类学按定义来说是不可能的，只要我们与原始人、我们与野蛮人、我们与异教徒之间的这些区别仍然主宰着人们的思想。

statements.english: It was necessary first to arrive at that degree of sophistication where we no longer set our own belief against our neighbour's superstition.
statements.chinese: 首先，有必要达到那种成熟程度，即我们不再将自己的信仰与邻居的迷信对立起来。

statements.english: It was necessary to recognize that these institutions which are based on the same premises, let us say the supernatural, must be considered together, our own among the rest.
statements.chinese: 有必要认识到，这些基于相同前提的制度，比方说超自然现象，必须被一并考虑，包括我们自己的。

courses.title: Lesson 45: Of Men and Galaxies
courses.description: 新概念英语第四册 · 28 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 在任何人类社会中，最具影响力的因素是什么？
statements.english: What is the most influential factor in any human society?

statements.chinese: 在人类早期，与其他生物的竞争一定是至关重要的。
statements.english: In man's early days, competition with other creatures must have been critical.

statements.chinese: 但我们发展的这个阶段现在已经结束了。
statements.english: But this phase of our development is now finished.

statements.chinese: 事实上，我们现在缺乏处理原始条件的实践和经验。
statements.english: Indeed, we lack practice and experience nowadays in dealing with primitive conditions.
I am sure that, without modern weapons, I would make a very poor show of disputing the ownership of a cave with a bear, and in this I do not think that I stand alone.
statements.chinese: 我确信，如果没有现代武器，我在与熊争夺洞穴所有权方面会表现得很糟糕，而且我认为我并非孤身一人。
最后一种与人类竞争的生物是蚊子。
statements.english: The last creature to compete with man was the mosquito.

statements.chinese: 但即使是蚊子也因对排水的重视和化学喷雾而被制服了。
statements.english: But even the mosquito has been subdued by attention to drainage and by chemical sprays.
Competition between ourselves, person against person, community against community, still persists, however; and it is as fierce as it ever was.
statements.chinese: 我们彼此之间的竞争，人与人之间，社群与社群之间，仍然存在；而且它和以往一样激烈。
但人与人之间的竞争并不是生物学中设想的简单过程。
statements.english: But the competition of man against man is not the simple process envisioned in biology.
It is not a simple competition for a fixed amount of food determined by the physical environment, because the environment that determines our evolution is no longer essentially physical.
statements.chinese: 这不是一种由物理环境决定的对固定数量食物的简单竞争，因为决定我们进化的环境本质上不再是物理的了。
我们的环境主要由我们所相信的事物所决定。
statements.english: Our environment is chiefly conditoned by the things we believe.
Morocco and California are bits of the Earth in very similar latitudes, both on the west coasts of continents with similar climates, and probably with rather similar natural resources.
statements.chinese: 摩洛哥和加利福尼亚是地球上纬度非常相似的两个地方，都位于大陆西海岸，气候相似，而且可能拥有相当相似的自然资源。

statements.english: Yet their present development is wholly different, not so much because of different people even, but because of the different thoughts that exist in the minds of their inhabitants.
statements.chinese: 然而，它们目前的发展却截然不同，甚至不是因为不同的人，而是因为其居民心中存在的不同思想。
这就是我希望强调的重点。
statements.english: This is the point I wish to emphasize.

statements.chinese: 我们环境中最重要的因素是我们自己的心智状态。
statements.english: The most important factor in our environment is the state of our own minds.
It is well known that where the white man has invaded a primitive culture, the most destructive effects have come not from physical weapons but from ideas.
statements.chinese: 众所周知，当白人侵入原始文化时，最具破坏性的影响并非来自实体武器，而是来自思想。
思想是危险的。
statements.english: Ideas are dangerous.

statements.chinese: 过去的异端裁判所对此心知肚明，因为它曾将异教徒烧死。
statements.english: The Holy Office knew this full well when it caused heretics to be burned in days gone by.

Indeed, the concept of free speech only exists in our modern society because when you are inside a community, you are conditioned by the conventions of the community to such a degree that it is very difficult to conceive of anything really destructive.
statements.chinese: 事实上，言论自由的概念之所以存在于我们的现代社会，是因为当你身处一个社群中时，你被社群的习俗所制约，以至于很难构想出任何真正具有破坏性的事物。
只有旁观者才能注入危险的思想。
statements.english: It is only someone looking on from outside that can inject the dangerous thoughts.

statements.chinese: 我不怀疑有可能向现代世界注入彻底摧毁我们的思想。
statements.english: I do not doubt that it would be possible to inject ideas into the modern world that would utterly destroy us.

statements.chinese: 我想给你们举个例子，但幸运的是我不能。
statements.english: I would like to give you an example, but fortunately I cannot do so.

statements.chinese: 也许提到核弹就足够了。
statements.english: Perhaps it will suffice to mention the nuclear bomb.

Imagine the effect on a reasonably advanced technological society, one that still does not possess the bomb, of making it aware of the possibility, of supplying suffcient details to enable the thing to be constructed.
statements.chinese: 想象一下，对一个相当先进的科技社会，一个尚未拥有核弹的社会，如果让它意识到可能性，并提供足够的细节使其能够被建造出来，那会产生什么影响。

statements.english: 20 or 30 pages of information handed to any of the major world powers around the year 1925, would have been sufficient to change the course of world history.
statements.chinese: 1925年左右，将20或30页信息交给任何一个世界主要大国，足以改变世界历史的进程。

statements.english: It is a strange thought, but I believe a correct one, that twenty or thirty pages of ideas and information would be capable of turning the present-day world upside down, or even destroying it.
statements.chinese: 这是一个奇怪的想法，但我相信它是正确的，即二三十页的思想和信息就足以颠覆当今世界，甚至摧毁它。

statements.english: I have often tried to conceive of what those pages might contain, but of course I cannot do so because I am a prisoner of the present-day world, just as all of you are.
statements.chinese: 我曾多次试图构想那些页面可能包含什么，但我当然做不到，因为我是当今世界的囚徒，就像你们所有人一样。

statements.english: We cannot think outside the particular patterns that our brains are conditioned to, or, to be more accurate we can think only a very little way outside and then only if we are very original.
statements.chinese: 我们无法跳出我们大脑被制约的特定模式进行思考，或者说，更准确地说，我们只能稍微跳出一点，而且只有当我们非常具有原创性时才能做到。

courses.title: Lesson 46: Hobbies
courses.description: 新概念英语第四册 · 39 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 一位有天赋的美国心理学家说过，忧虑是情感的痉挛。
statements.english: A gifted American psychologist has said, worry is a spasm of the emotion.

statements.chinese: 心智抓住某物不肯放手。
statements.english: The mind catches hold of something and will not let it go.

statements.chinese: 在这种情况下，与心智争辩是无用的。
statements.english: It is useless to argue with the mind in this condition.

statements.chinese: 意志越强，任务就越徒劳。
statements.english: The stronger the will, the more futile the task.

statements.chinese: 人们只能轻轻地将其他事物潜入其痉挛的掌控中。
statements.english: One can only gently insinuate something else into its convulsive grasp.

statements.chinese: 如果这其他事物选择得当，如果它真的得到了另一个兴趣领域的启发，那么，渐渐地，而且往往很快地，旧有而适当的抓握就会放松。
statements.english: And if this something else is rightly chosen, if it is really attended by the illumination of another field of interest, gradually and often quite swiftly, the old and due grip relaxes.

statements.chinese: 康复和修复的过程便开始了。
statements.english: And the process of recuperation and repair begins.

statements.chinese: 因此，培养爱好和新的兴趣形式对公众人物来说是首要的策略。
statements.english: The cultivation of a hobby and new forms of interest is therefore a policy of first importance to a public man.

statements.chinese: 但这并非一日之功，也不是仅凭意志就能迅速完成的。
statements.english: But this is not a business that can be undertaken in a day, or swiftly improvised by a mere command of the will.

statements.chinese: 培养替代性精神兴趣是一个漫长的过程。
statements.english: The growth of alternative mental interests is a long process.

statements.chinese: 种子必须精心挑选。
statements.english: The seeds must be carefully chosen.

statements.chinese: 它们必须落在肥沃的土壤上。
statements.english: They must fall on good ground.

statements.chinese: 它们必须勤勉地照料。
statements.english: They must be sedulously tended.

statements.chinese: 如果需要时要有生机勃勃的果实可供取用。
statements.english: If the vivifying fruits are to be at hand when needed.

statements.chinese: 要想真正快乐和真正安全，一个人至少应该有两三个爱好，而且它们都必须是真实的。
statements.english: To be really happy and really safe, one ought to have at least two or three hobbies, and they must all be real.

statements.chinese: 在生命的后期才开始说，我对这个或那个感兴趣，是没有用的。
statements.english: It is no use starting late in life to say, I will take an interest in this or that.

statements.chinese: 这样的尝试只会加剧精神努力的紧张。
statements.english: Such an attempt only aggravates the strain of mental effort.

statements.chinese: 一个人可能获得大量与日常工作无关的知识，但却几乎得不到任何益处或解脱。
statements.english: A man may acquire great knowledge of topics unconnected with his daily work, and yet hardly get any benefit or relief.

statements.chinese: 做你喜欢的事情没有用，你必须喜欢你所做的事情。
statements.english: It is no use doing what you like, you have got to like what you do.

statements.chinese: 广义地说，人类可以分为三类。
statements.english: Broadly speaking, human beings may be divided into three classes.

statements.chinese: 劳累至死的人，忧虑至死的人，以及无聊至死的人。
statements.english: Those who are toiled to death, those who are worried to death, and those who are bored to death.

statements.chinese: 让一个因一周辛勤劳动而精疲力尽的体力劳动者，在周六下午有机会踢足球或打棒球是毫无意义的。
statements.english: It is no use offering the manual laborer, tied out with a hard week's sweat and effort, the chance of playing a game of football or baseball on Saturday afternoon.

statements.chinese: 邀请一个已经工作或为严肃事情担忧了六天的政治家、专业人士或商人，在周末再为琐事工作或担忧，是毫无意义的。
statements.english: It is no use inviting the politician or the professional or businessman, who has been working or worrying about serious things for six days, to work or worry about trifling things at the weekend.

As for the unfortunate people who can command everything they want, who can gratify every caprice and lay their hands on almost every object of desire, For them a new pleasure, a new excitement is only an additional satiation.
statements.chinese: 至于那些不幸的人，他们可以掌控一切想要的东西，可以满足每一个奇想，并几乎可以得到每一个渴望的对象，对他们来说，新的乐趣，新的兴奋，不过是额外的满足。
他们徒劳地四处奔波，试图通过单纯的喧嚣和运动来逃避报复性的无聊。
statements.english: In vain they rush frantically round from place to place, trying to escape from avenging boredom by mere clatter and motion.

statements.chinese: 对他们来说，某种形式的纪律是最有希望的道路。
statements.english: For them, discipline in one form or another is the most hopeful path.

statements.chinese: 也可以说，理性的、勤奋的、有用的_人_类分为两类。
statements.english: It may also be said that rational, industrious, useful human beings are divided into two classes.

statements.chinese: 首先，那些工作是工作，享乐是享乐的人。
statements.english: First, those whose work is work, and whose pleasure is pleasure.

statements.chinese: 其次，那些工作和享乐合二为一的人。
statements.english: And secondly, those whose work and pleasure are one.

statements.chinese: 其中前者是大多数。
statements.english: Of these the former are the majority.

statements.chinese: 他们有自己的补偿。
statements.english: They have their compensations.

statements.chinese: 在办公室或工厂的长时间工作，作为他们的报酬，不仅带来了生计，也带来了对乐趣的强烈渴望，即使是最简单和最适度的形式。
statements.english: The long hours in the office or the factory bring with them as their reward, not only the means of sustenance, but a keen appetite for pleasure, even in its simplest and most modest forms.

statements.chinese: 但命运的宠儿属于第二类。
statements.english: But fortune's favored children belong to the second class.

statements.chinese: 他们的生活是一种自然的和谐。
statements.english: Their life is a natural harmony.

statements.chinese: 对他们来说，工作时间永远不够长。
statements.english: For them, the working hours are never long enough.

statements.chinese: 每天都是假日，而当普通的假日来临时，他们会抱怨这是对沉浸于工作中的被迫中断。
statements.english: Each day is a holiday, and ordinary holidays when they come are grudged as enforced interruptions in an absorbing vocation.

statements.chinese: 然而，对于这两类人来说，改变观念，改变氛围，或转移精力，都是至关重要的。
statements.english: Yet to both classes, the need of an alternative outlook, of a change of atmosphere, or a diversion of effort, is essential.

statements.chinese: 事实上，那些以工作为乐的人，可能正是最需要通过间隔时间将工作从脑海中驱逐出去的人。
statements.english: Indeed, it may well be that those whose work is their pleasure are those who most need the means of banishing it at intervals from their minds.

statements.chinese: 温斯顿·丘吉尔，《绘画的消遣》。
statements.english: Winston Churchill, Painting as a pastime.

courses.title: Lesson 47: The Great Escape
courses.description: 新概念英语第四册 · 32 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 论及国籍时，现代露营的特点之一是什么？
statements.english: What is one of the features of modern camping where nationality is concerned?
Economy is one powerful motive for camping, since after the initial outlay upon equipment, or through hiring it, the total expense can be far less than the cost of hotels.
statements.chinese: 经济是露营的一个强大动力，因为在设备初期投入或租用之后，总费用会远低于住酒店的开销。
但是，与一种普遍的看法相反，这绝非唯一的，甚至也不是最大的动力。
statements.english: But, contrary to a popular assumption, it is far from being the only one, or even the greatest.

statements.chinese: 那个漫不经心地把车开进欧洲无数固定营地之一、仅值20英镑空间的露营者，可能会发现自己的车碰到了宾利。
statements.english: The man who manoeuvres carelessly into his 20 pounds' worth of space at one of Europe's myriad permanent sites may find himself bumping a Bentley.

statements.chinese: 更可能的情况是，福特Escort会和雷诺或梅赛德斯并排停放，但很少会和双人自行车并排。
statements.english: More likely, Ford Escort will be hub to hub with Renault or Mercedes, but rarely with bicycles made for two.
That the equipment of modern camping becomes yearly more sophisticated is an entertaining paradox for the cynic, a brighter promise for the hopeful traveller who has sworn to get away from it all.
statements.chinese: 现代露营设备每年都变得更加精密，这对愤世嫉俗者来说是一个有趣的悖论，对发誓要摆脱一切的满怀希望的旅行者来说则是一个更美好的前景。
它还提供了——某个社会学学生或许会以此现象为基础撰写论文——另一种形式的逃离。
statements.english: It also provides--and some student sociologist might care to base his thesis upon the phenomenon--an escape of another kind.
The modern traveller is often a man who dislikes the Splendide and the Bellavista, not because he cannot afford, or shuns their material comforts, but because he is afraid of them.
statements.chinese: 现代旅行者往往不喜欢“Splendide”和“Bellavista”这样的酒店，不是因为他负担不起或避开它们的物质享受，而是因为他害怕它们。
他可能很富裕，但绝不确定该给门童或女服务员多少小费。
statements.english: Affluent he may be, but he is by no means sure what to tip the doorman or the chambermaid.

statements.chinese: 他在自己家里是个主人，却不知道何时该对酒店经理发号施令。
statements.english: Master in his own house he has little idea of when to say boo to a manager hotel.

statements.chinese: 露营将他从所有这些恐惧中解脱出来。
statements.english: From all such fears camping releases him.
Granted, a snobbery of camping itself, based upon equipment and techniques, already exists; but it is of a kind that, if he meets it, he can readily understand and deal with.
statements.chinese: 诚然，露营本身就存在一种基于装备和技术的势利眼；但如果他遇到这种势利，他也能很容易理解和应对。
没有以管理层和酒店等级制度形式出现的上级“他们”来给他假期蒙上阴影。
statements.english: There is no superior 'they' in the shape of managements and hotel hierarchies to darken his holiday days.

statements.chinese: 除了这些动机，还必须加上另一个。
statements.english: To such motives, yet another must be added.

statements.chinese: 当代汽车崇拜现象，其原因很大程度上在于拥有汽车所带来的独立和自由感。
statements.english: The contemporary phenomenon of car worship is to be explained not least by the sense of independence and freedom that ownership entails.

statements.chinese: 露营为这种乐趣增添了一种精致的升华。
statements.english: To this pleasure camping gives an exquisite refinement.

statements.chinese: 从自家门前到国内或国外的山丘沙滩再返回，一切尽在掌握。
statements.english: From one's own front door to home or foreign hills or sands and back again, everything is to hand.

Not only are the means of arriving at the holiday paradise entirely within one's own command and keeping, but the means of escape from holiday hell (if the beach proves too crowded, the local weather too inclement) are there, outside--or, as likely, part of--the tent.
statements.chinese: 不仅抵达度假天堂的交通工具完全由自己掌控和保管，而且从度假地狱中逃脱的手段（如果海滩过于拥挤，当地天气过于恶劣）就在帐篷外面——或者，更有可能的是，就在帐篷里。

statements.english: Idealists have objected to the practice of camping, as to the package tour, that the traveller abroad thereby denies himself the opportunity of getting to know the people of the country visited.
statements.chinese: 理想主义者反对露营，就像反对跟团游一样，认为出国旅行者因此剥夺了自己了解所访国家人民的机会。
有人认为，与世隔绝和自我封闭是并存的。
statements.english: Insularity and self-containment, it is argued, go hand in hand.

statements.chinese: 但这种观点在体验过一个受欢迎的欧洲大陆露营地后便不攻自破。
statements.english: The opinion does not survive experience of a popular Continental camping place.

statements.chinese: 度假酒店往往特别迎合——有时甚至专门迎合——某一国籍的游客。
statements.english: Holiday hotels tend to cater for one nationality of visitors especially, sometimes exclusively.

statements.chinese: 相比之下，露营地则高度国际化。
statements.english: Camping sites, by contrast, are highly cosmopolitan.
Granted, a preponderance of Germans is a characteristic that seems common to most Mediterranean sites; but as yet there is no overwhelmingly specialized patronage.
statements.chinese: 诚然，德国人占多数似乎是大多数地中海营地的共同特点；但到目前为止，还没有出现压倒性的专业赞助。

statements.english: Notices forbidding the open-air drying of clothes, or the use of water points for car washing, or those inviting 'our camping friends' to a dance or a boat trip are printed not only in French or Italian or Spanish, but also in English, German and Dutch.
statements.chinese: 禁止户外晾晒衣物、禁止使用取水点洗车，或者邀请“我们的露营朋友”参加舞会或乘船游览的告示，不仅用法语、意大利语或西班牙语印制，也用英语、德语和荷兰语印制。
用餐时，酸菜味与大蒜味相互竞争。
statements.english: At meal times the odour of sauerkraut vies with that of garlic.

statements.chinese: 法国人的早餐咖啡与英国人的培根鸡蛋相互抗衡。
statements.english: The Frenchman's breakfast coffee competes with the Englishman's bacon and eggs.

statements.chinese: 有组织的露营的显著增长是否意味着更独立露营方式的最终消亡，这很难说。
statements.english: Whether the remarkable growth of organized camping means the eventual death of the more independent kind is hard to say.

statements.chinese: 市政府自然希望确保露营者的场地费和其他消费。
statements.english: Municipalities naturally want to secure the campers' site fees and other custom.

statements.chinese: 警方对那些无法追溯到已认可营地边界或有四面墙壁的流浪者保持警惕。
statements.english: Police are wary of itinerants who cannot be traced to a recognized camp boundary or to four walls.

But most probably it will all depend upon campers themselves: how many heath fires they cause; how much litter they leave; in short, whether or not they wholly alienate landowners and those who live in the countryside.
statements.chinese: 但最有可能的是，这一切都将取决于露营者自己：他们引发了多少荒地火灾；他们留下了多少垃圾；简而言之，他们是否完全疏远了土地所有者和那些住在乡村的人。
只有良好的童子军精神才可能维护那些永恒的童子军心中珍爱的自由。
statements.english: Only good scouting is likely to preserve the freedoms so dear to the heart of the eternal Boy Scout.

courses.title: Lesson 48: Planning a Share Portfolio
courses.description: 新概念英语第四册 · 19 条逐句练习

statements.chinese: 较年长的投资者在投资方式上与年轻投资者有何不同？
statements.english: How does the older investor differ in his approach to investment from the younger investor?

statements.chinese: 身边不乏提供“快速致富”机会的内幕消息者。
statements.english: There is no shortage of tipsters around offering 'get-rich-quick' opportunities.

statements.chinese: 但如果你是一个认真的私人投资者，就把那种拉斯维加斯的心态留给那些有钱可挥霍的人吧。
statements.english: But if you are a serious private investor, leave the Las Vegas mentality to those with money to fritter.

statements.chinese: 认真的投资者需要一个合适的“投资组合”——一个精心策划的投资选择，具有明确的结构和清晰的目标。
statements.english: The serious investor needs a proper 'portfolio' --a well-planned selection of investments, with a definite structure and a clear aim.

statements.chinese: 但股市新手究竟如何才能做到这一点呢？
statements.english: But exactly how does a newcomer to the stock market go about achieving that?

Well, if you go to five reputable stock brokers and ask them what you should do with your money, you're likely to get five different answers, -- even if you give all the relevant information about your age, family, finances and what you want from your investments.
statements.chinese: 嗯，如果你去找五位声誉良好的股票经纪人，问他们你该如何处理你的钱，你很可能会得到五种不同的答案，——即使你提供了所有关于你的年龄、家庭、财务状况以及你希望从投资中获得什么的相关信息。
结论？没有一个“正确”的方法来构建投资组合。
statements.english: Moral? There is no one 'right' way to structure a portfolio.
However, there are undoubtedly some wrong ways, and you can be sure that none of our five advisers would have suggested sinking all (or perhaps any) of your money into Periwigs.
statements.chinese: 然而，无疑有一些错误的方法，你可以肯定，我们的五位顾问中没有一人会建议你把所有（或者说任何）钱投入到Periwigs公司。
那么你该怎么做呢？
statements.english: So what should you do?

statements.chinese: 我们假设你已经解决了基本问题——比如抵押贷款、养老金、保险和拥有足够的现金储备。
statements.english: We'll assume that you have sorted out the basics--like mortgages, pensions, insurance and access to sufficient cash reserves.

statements.chinese: 然后你应该确立自己的个人目标。
statements.english: You should then establish your own individual aims.

statements.chinese: 这些部分取决于个人情况，部分取决于心理因素。
statements.english: These are partly a matter of personal circumstances, partly a matter of psychology.

statements.chinese: 例如，如果你年龄较大，从任何重大损失中恢复的时间较短，而且你很可能希望增加你的养老金收入。
statements.english: For instance, if you are older you have less time to recover from any major losses, and you may well wish to boost your pension income.

statements.chinese: 因此，保住你的本金并获得额外收入是你的主要优先事项。
statements.english: So preserving your capital and generating extra income are your main priorities.

In this case, you'd probably construct a portfolio with some shares (but not high risk ones), along with gilts, cash deposits, and perhaps convertibles or the income shares of split capital investment trusts.
statements.chinese: 在这种情况下，你可能会构建一个包含一些股票（但不是高风险的）、政府债券、现金存款、也许还有可转换债券或分级资本投资信托的收益股的投资组合。

statements.english: If you are younger, and in a solid financial position, you may decide to take an aggressive approach--but only if you're blessed with a sanguine disposition and won't suffer sleepless nights over share prices.
statements.chinese: 如果你比较年轻，且财务状况稳健，你可能会决定采取激进的策略——但前提是你拥有乐观的性格，并且不会因为股价而彻夜难眠。

statements.english: If you recognize yourself in this description, you might include a couple of heady growth stocks in your portfolio, alongside your more pedestrian investments.
statements.chinese: 如果你认为自己符合这个描述，你可以在你的投资组合中加入几只涨势强劲的成长股，以及一些更稳健的投资。
一旦你确定了你的投资目标，你就可以决定把钱投到哪里。
statements.english: Once you have decided on your investment aims you can then decide where to put your money.
The golden rule here is spread your risk--if you put all of your money into Periwigs International, you're setting yourself up as a hostage to fortune.
statements.chinese: 这里的黄金法则是分散风险——如果你把所有钱都投入到Periwigs国际公司，你就是在把自己置于命运的摆布之下。
